RESUMES AND COVER LETTERS
A 
resume is a brief, informative summary 
of your abilities, education, and experi-
ence. It should highlight your strongest assets 
and skills, and differentiate you from other can-
didates seeking similar positions. Although it 
alone will not get you a job or internship, a good 
resume is an important element toward obtain-
ing an interview. 
Tailor your resume to the type of position you 
are seeking. This does not mean that all of 
your experience must relate directly, but your 
resume should reflect the kind of skills the 
employer would value.

TOP 5 RESUME MISTAKES:
1. Spelling and grammar errors
2. Missing email and phone information
3. Using passive language instead of “action” words
4. Not well organized, concise, or easy to skim
5. Too long
RESUME LANGUAGE SHOULD BE:
• Specific rather than general
• Active rather than passive
• Written to express not impress
• Articulate rather than “flowery”
• Fact-based (quantify and qualify)
• Written for people who scan quickly
DON’T:
• Use personal pronouns (such as I)
• Abbreviate
• Use a narrative style
• Number or letter categories
• Use slang or colloquialisms
• Include a picture
• Include age or sex
• List references
• Start each line with a date
RESUME TIPS
PLAN TO WORK INTERNATIONALLY? 
DO:
• Be consistent in format and content
• Make it easy to read and follow, balancing white
space
• Use consistent spacing, underlining, italics, bold,
and capitalization for emphasis
• List headings (such as Experience) in order of
importance
• Within headings, list information in reverse chron-
ological order (most recent first)
• Avoid information gaps such as a missing summer
• Be sure that your formatting translated properly if
converted to a .pdf
Resume guidelines can vary from country to country.

Write an Effective Cover Letter
RESUMES AND COVER LETTERS
Your cover letter is a writing sample and a part of the screening process. By putting your best foot forward, you can increase your 
chances of being interviewed. A good way to create a response-producing cover letter is to highlight your skills or experiences 
that are most applicable to the job or industry and to tailor the letter to the specific organization you are applying to.

Dear _________:
Opening paragraph: Clearly state why you are writing, name the 
position or type of work you’re exploring and, where applicable, how 
you heard about the person or organization.
Middle paragraph(s): Explain why you are interested in this employer 
and your reasons for desiring this type of work. If you’ve had relevant 
school or work experience, be sure to point it out with one or two key 
examples; but do not reiterate your entire resume. Emphasize skills or 
abilities that relate to the job. Be sure to do this in a confident manner 
and remember that the reader will view your letter as an example of 
your writing skills.
Closing paragraph: Reiterate your interest in the position, and 
your enthusiasm for using your skills to contribute to the work of 
the organization. Thank the reader for his/her consideration of 
your application, and end by stating that you look forward to the 
opportunity to further discuss the position.

• Address your letters to a specific person if you can.
• Tailor your letters to specific situations or organizations by 
doing research before writing your letters.
• Keep letters concise and factual, no more than a single page. 
Avoid flowery language.
• Give examples that support your skills and qualifications.
• Put yourself in the reader’s shoes. What can you write that will 
convince the reader that you are ready and able to do the job?
• Don’t overuse the pronoun “I”.
• Remember that this is a marketing tool. Use lots of action 
words.
• Have an OCS adviser provie feedback, when possible.
• If converting to a .pdf, check that your formatting translated 
correctly.
• Reference skills or experiences from the job description and 
draw connections to your credentials.
• Make sure your resume and cover letter are prepared with the 
same font type and size.

Write an Effective Cover Letter
Your cover letter is a writing sample and a part of the screening process. By putting your best foot forward, you can increase your 
chances of being interviewed. A good way to create a response-producing cover letter is to highlight your skills or experiences 
that are most applicable to the job or industry and to tailor the letter to the specific organization you are applying to.

Dear _________:
Opening paragraph: Clearly state why you are writing, name the 
position or type of work you’re exploring and, where applicable, how 
you heard about the person or organization.
Middle paragraph(s): Explain why you are interested in this employer 
and your reasons for desiring this type of work. If you’ve had relevant 
school or work experience, be sure to point it out with one or two key 
examples; but do not reiterate your entire resume. Emphasize skills or 
abilities that relate to the job. Be sure to do this in a confident manner 
and remember that the reader will view your letter as an example of 
your writing skills.
Closing paragraph: Reiterate your interest in the position, and 
your enthusiasm for using your skills to contribute to the work of 
the organization. Thank the reader for his/her consideration of 
your application, and end by stating that you look forward to the 
opportunity to further discuss the position.
Sincerely,

Use complete

if possible and

a colon.

read your resume. 
Be brief, but

and remember to 
follow up.
Always sign 
letters.
•Address your letters to a specific person if you can.
• Tailor your letters to specific situations or organizations by
doing research before writing your letters.
• Keep letters concise and factual, no more than a single page.
Avoid flowery language.
• Give examples that support your skills and qualifications.
• Put yourself in the reader’s shoes. What can you write that will
convince the reader that you are ready and able to do the job?
• Don’t overuse the pronoun “I”.
• Remember that this is a marketing tool. Use lots of action
words.
• Have an OCS adviser proofread your letter.
• If converting to a .pdf, check that your formatting translated
correctly.
• Reference skills or experiences from the job description and
draw connections to your credentials.
• Make sure your resume and cover letter are prepared with the
same font type and size.

impressed with Great Strategy’s approach to strategy consulting, especially within the Business 
Development and Innovation practice areas. I believe my academic background, business knowledge and 
industry experiences have provided me with the credentials needed to thrive as an Associate.

technology process improvement. I gained solid research, analytical and problem solving skills while 
working in Fortune 500 companies. My background in generating innovative ideas and strategies to 
improve processes has provided me with a deeper understanding of multifaceted problems that companies

Committed to innovation in the field of business operations and endlessly curious to find new and better ways to improve a business’s day-to-day functions and to meet its yearly goals.

 PROFILE SUMMARY: -

Operations and Project Management Professional with experience of 6+ years in Project Management, Corporate Communication, Recruitment, Compliance Tracking and Execution, Delivery Management and Budget & Resource allocation.

Proven track record of Leading and executing extra high voltage electrical substation projects from conception to close-out 

Skilled in providing leadership, direction, strategy and vision in the areas of technology / product development to facilitate and enable growth & business agility

NTT Ltd. Bangalore, India

Technical Resolver Group (TRG) team, Operations and Service Desk on Incidents & Service Request fulfilling, 
develops & nurtures to excellent customer satisfaction.

customer strategic business plan. 
• Manage Performance Metrics, KPI’s, SIP, CSI, Reporting. Ensures performance goals are met follow RACI for 
all in scope services across all towers: identifying & analysing gaps & implementing corrective action plans. 
• Ability to manage risk effectively and proactively for projects/ deliverables. 
• Maintain overall responsibility for delivery in accordance with defined standards, SLA, and catalogue. 
• Presentation of SLM, MBR, QBR meetings with c-level representatives. 
• Management of MSA, Operational BOM & Inventory pertaining to accounts within my charge. 
• Oversee Contract management, Renewals, Tech-refresh, generating revenue & achieving business goals. 
• Manage, address, and resolve escalations, pain points of Clients and stakeholders. 
• Manage team of IT Network & Security (TE) Resident Engineers on Client premises, including role

conversion aspects. 
• Working closely with internal colleagues (Sales, Projects, DevOps, Finance, Legal) on Onboarding, Transition,

• Plan and execute annual Bug Scrub, Preventive Maintenance tasks, Upgrade, Hotfix, Bank wide Activity, 
Patching, RCA Assessments, Authoring of change requests, Implementation plans, Datacentre services, Ad-
hoc requests, etc. 
 
MS Project Manager May 2017 – February 2021 
NTT Ltd. Bangalore, India 
 
Key Responsibilities: 
• Accountable for project management for dedicated HNI Clients; planning, supervising, managing daily 
service deliverables of projects within the limitations of scope, quality, time, and cost. 
• Lead projects from requirements definition through deployment, identifying schedules, scopes, budget 
estimations, and project implementation plans, including risk mitigation. 
• Managing T&M and MACD quotes, SOW, PO, Q&P register, and Invoicing. Includes SLA analysis, collating and 
updating multiple weekly/ monthly reports, Substantiation. 

• Include planning and managing end-to-end Client-based projects/ engagements with multiple stakeholders 
across the globe/ region. 
• Coordinate with internal and external resources, ensuring projects remain within scope, schedule, and 
defined budgets, in collaboration with project staff from various functional departments. 
• Responsible for co-ordinating and requirement gathering sessions with users, translate business needs into 
Project specifications, and communicate technical challenges to the business solutions when needed. 
• Ensure the work tickets were assigned to appropriate team and addressed SLA. 
• Exposure working under strict delivery timelines, managing expectations both internally & externally; with 
emphasis on Client requirements. 
• Report project outcomes and/ or risks to the appropriate management channels as needed—escalating 
issues as necessary based on project work plans. 
• Mentoring the team which involves providing constructive feedback and monitoring the performance and 
provide ongoing support and guidance to strengthen team members capabilities and skill sets. 
• Effectively interacted with Clients regarding timing of work carried out and updates on status of projects, as 
and when required. 
• Effective communication with problem solving abilities and to be able to handle escalations and deep dive 
into the RCAs while handle Client expectations. 
 
Project Coordinator – Client Service August 2016 – April 2017 
Dimension Data | NTT Ltd. Bangalore, India 
 
Key Responsibilities: 
• Actively review daily technical & complex MACD requests raised by Client, coordinate with engineering team 
to ensure the requests are assigned to engineers for timely deliverables of the services and BAU activities 
within SLA limits. 
• Responsible for tracking requests raised via Service Now (ITSM). 
• Ensured the tickets were assigned to appropriate team and addressed within SLA limits. 
• Accountable for keeping a check on processes followed, including relevant documentation and approvals. 
• Interacted with internal Engineering teams to ensure work is done in a timely and efficient manner. 
• Collated inputs and prepared monthly billable reports on all Managed Services tasks, as well as other reports 
as requested by managers. 
• Participate in weekly/ monthly calls with Clients and establish effective working relationship with Client 
representatives, senior management and discuss timely deliveries of services and operational activities. 
• Effectively interacted with Clients regarding timing of work carried out and updates on status of requests, as 
and when required. 
 
Client Service Specialist August 2014 – June 2016 
Envestnet Yodlee Infotech Pvt Ltd Bangalore, India 
 
Key Responsibilities: 
• Owning service delivery & account management contributing growth of Portfolio with large teams. 
• Relationship management and coordination with internal teams for product performance enhancement, 
support & delivery. 
• Manage outages, troubleshoot issues in Yodlee (SaaS) platform web application and environment. 
Collaborate with internal & external stakeholders to restore functionality and determine RCA, documenting 
service restoration details. 
• Respond to user escalations, monitor events, and engage functional/ technical teams required. 
• Liaise with channel partners to resolve and address customer issues, escalate to vendors. 
• Conceptualize and deliver ad-hoc report requirement as per business needs. 
• Documented process flow and set quality parameters for the team to adhere for better customer 
experience. 
• Establish continuous process improvement cycles where the process performance, activities, roles and 
responsibilities, policies, procedures and supporting technology is reviewed and enhanced where applicable. 
• Highly successful in building relationships with senior-level decision makers, seizing control of critical 
problem areas, and delivering on customer commitments and seizing opportunities to maximise business. 
• Consistently exceeded organizational expectations with exceptional planning, analytical, and team leading 
skills and the ability to work in cross-cultural and multi-ethnic environments. 
 

Technical Support Engineer December 2012 - August 2014 
Hewlett Packard | Mphasis Bangalore, India 
 
Key Responsibilities: 
• Responsible to support accounts across the enterprise comprising of multiple Clients and geographies. 
• To work in liaison with various technical/ resolver groups across various geographies and domain, through 
the entire lifecycle of the high priority incident and take suitable steps for a speedy resolution.

• Weekly calls with the onshore and offshore Mangers to know the Client requirements.

• Ensuring review with internal teams and customer reviews for performance reporting. 
• Ownership and management of critical incidents. Align with technology and business groups on critical

stakeholders. 
 
Technical Associate June 2011 to July 2012 
Wipro Ltd. New Delhi, India

P R O F I L E 
Project Manager with over four years of working experience in project management, IT 
project lifecycle, planning projects, service implementation, managing stakeholders and 
project delivery. I have a proven track record in streamlining process to increase efficiency 
and minimalize costs. Have expertly managed teams of 10-15 people across different 
verticals and ensured increase in productivity by 25%. Seeking to leverage my leadership 
expertise as a project manager for the company. 
E X P E R T I S E 
• Stakeholder Management 
• Pricing & Proposal Management 
• Risk Management 
• Requirement Analysis 
• Change Management 
• Release Management 
• Corporate Communication 
• Project Scheduling Management 
• Budgeting & Cost Management 
• Governance & Transparency 
• Status Reporting 
• RAID Management 
• Enterprise-Wide Approach 
E X P E R I E N C E 
 
E D U C A T I O N 
C B R E S O U T H A S I A PV T . LT D . ( M a y , 2022 – S e p t e m b e r , 2022) 
 
 
U P G R A D E D U C A T I O N I N D I A P V T . L T D . ( M a r c h , 2022 – M a y , 2022) 
 
 
A Z U R O B Y S Q U A R E Y A R D S ( M a r c h , 2021 – D e c e m b e r , 2021) 
 
 
 
• Conducted Kick-off call with customers and internal stakeholders (technical designers, 
Business managers) and external stakeholders; maintained and called out risks and issues 
via RAID logs 
• Planned and designated Project resources, prepared budgets, monitored progress, and 
kept stakeholders informed of project status, scheduled cost and assessment of 
risks/issues 
• Reviewed contracts and SOWs, analyzed gaps and presented it to upper management 
• Managed the relationship with senior leaders & cross functional teams through the 
project life cycle. Managed project review meetings and issue minutes 
• Maintained action register (assign & track pending items), timely escalations and sought 
intervention to relevant stakeholders to ensure smooth project progress 
• Generate project planning and project closure report and measure the satisfaction level 
of customer; managed end to end program/project delivery and ensured timely 
deliverables 
• Managed a team of 5-8 people: ensured coordination and communication were 
prioritized during work with Technology department for variety of projects 
• Coordinate with other teams in order to achieve cost reduction targets and enhance 
profitability 
• Designed, launched and grew courses and verticals (comprising multiple courses) to meet 
aspirations of prospective learners, aimed to enhance the profitability 
• Collaborated with and managing external partners like Foreign Universities and vendors 
to ensure smooth coordination 
• Assisted in planning, executing and introducing the company's subscription model in 
Delhi. Monitored its development closely by understanding the market, and helped in 
making necessary upgrades in order to make the product more sustainable 
• Managed a team of 10-15 members: ensured their performance output was maintained, 
communication and coordination were streamlined, and productivity was enhanced. 
• Developed a road-map for implementation of initiatives after managing expectations and 
priorities post discussion with internal and external stakeholders

• Microsoft Office 
• JIRA 
• Excel 
• MS Projects 
• Product Development 
• Microsoft Azure 
• Microsoft 365 
• SQL 
• Python 
• Business and IT Planning 
• Cross-Functional Supervision 
• Effective Communication 
YADAV 
 
S A N A T A N L O G I S T I C S P V T . L I M I T E D ( J u n e , 2017 – M a r c h , 2020) 
 
 
 
• Kept records for the communication hub for a complete periodic duration to figure our 
areas of improvement, submitted the report to management for review and applied 
suggestions 
• Managed a team of 5 members: ensured they recorded data and coordinated with 
internal and external vendors timely and periodically. Verified the data and ensured that 
the quality of communication was maintained 
• Did on ground research and survey to set-up strategic sites for the easy and smooth 
delivery of consignments to the aligned vendors, which helped in making a channelized 
process. Was responsible for maintaining good relationship with the vendors to ensure 
good communication

candidates.rawText:
LAKSHMI NARASIMHAN S R 
 
Summary: - 
Result-driven IT Service Manager, Project Manager and People Leader with 9.5 years of experience working in ITES, 
Telecom and Pharmaceutical Industry. Led 50+successful engagements across Projects and Operations through Effective 
Communication & Collaboration skills and deep domain experience leveraging knowledge in PMP-PMBOK 
/Prince2/ITIL/CSM/SAFe process frameworks. Aiming to continue delighting clients and employers with high levels of 
service. 
Core Competencies: - 
Project Management, IT Service Management, Escalation Management, Team Management, Vendor Co-ordination and 
Management, Client Relations, Stakeholder Engagement, Process Management, Problem Solving and Executive 
documentation. 
Work Experience: - 
ELI LILLY SERVICES INDIA: Manager – IT Service Management ( February 2022 – Present) 
Service/Operations Management: - 
•Lead the IT Service Management capabilities for Global Services (Ethics & Compliance, Legal, Travel & Meeting
Services) & HR Function for a portfolio of 300+ Applications & underlying Infrastructure.
•Responsible for Vendor & Contract Management of contract worth >$8M and manage span of control of 125+ FTE
Supporting Delivery Managers & Engineers.
•Act as the escalation point between Business IT and 3
rd 
party Supplier for any deterioration in Service Levels.
•Serve as thought partner for the Global Services Leadership team in managing multi-disciplinary capabilities such
as Quality, Process Improvements and Governance.
•Communicate Service Status and Health to BU, Functional Leaders at different levels of interest and influence.
•Design, Build and manage Service Management dashboards & Performance reporting (KPI’s/SLA/OLA/Metrics) in
ServiceNow for Senior Management consumption.
•Govern & Prioritize System Retirement activities for the Business Unit & approve billing (~$0.6M).
•Conduct periodic CMDB reviews for the accuracy of the CIs & attributes and engage CI Owners for any updates.
Contract & Financial Management: - 
•Ownership of contracts, including renewals, and amendments.
•Management/Tracking of relevant delivery budget, expenses and chargebacks, adherence to SLAs and KPIs.
AT&T COMMUNICATION SERVICES INDIA: 
IT Service Manager (July 2021 – February 2022) 
•Serve as a customer advocate and point of contact within AT&T for TAO services for 250+ clients.
•Monitor delivery performance metrics and ensure SLAs are always met.
•Responsible for Vendor Management and manage span of control of up to 08 vendors and 100+ Associates providing
Day2/Maintenance Support for AT&T customers.
•Conduct Monthly Governance calls for a pool of customers and ensure customer’s feedback are addressed. • Act as
central communication point for major incidents – Priority 1 and Priority 2 issues as needed.
•Review SLA credit request from customers.
Team Lead - Project Implementation Manager (PIM) (Apr 2018 – June 2021) 
•As a Team Lead, responsible for implementation reporting, carrying weekly and monthly ops review for the PIM
team, provide feedback to the team members and share insights to the management on the overall health of projects.

•In this role some of my regular duties are: to work with internal and external stakeholders (customer & vendors),
develop detailed project plan, schedule estimates, perform project tracking and analysis, produce status reports,
conduct project meetings and handle escalations.
Key Achievement/Projects:- 
•Lead a team of 03 PIM's supporting SDWAN Transformation project worth exceeding $45M. Successfully setup
custom process to support this project from scratch from Service Delivery.
•650+ sites migrated via SDWAN transformation projects with success rate of >95% in first attempt.
•Introduced process improvements leading to the reduction in event failure by 15% & annual savings of $70k/year.
•Recipient of AT&T Connections Award in 2021 and Diplomat Award in 2019.
CGI GROUP: Process Consultant: ITIL Problem Management ( Nov 2016 – Apr 2018) 
•Managing key activities needed to align the Problem Management services of 30+ Accounts for CMMI L5 Audits.
•Authoring process documents (SOP, trackers) & ensuring team adherence to meet the CMMI requirements.
•Providing process consulting services to Business Engineering (Presales) to enable them for RFI/RFP's.
•Responsible for carrying out Reactive/Proactive process implementation to facilitate Root Cause investigations
(RCA) for priority incidents, produce necessary reports and initiate CSI to improve Service Continuity.
ONE CLOUD CONSULTING: IT Project Manager ( June 2016 – Oct 2016) 
•Orchestrate all aspects of the project lifecycle from Initiation to Delivery.
•Responsible for proper definition of scope, communication, planning, effective risk and change management and
successful completion of Cisco UCS, Open Stack Deployment projects.
•In this role some of my regular duties are: to work with internal and external stakeholders (customer & vendors),
develop detailed work plans, schedule estimates, responsible for project tracking and analysis, facilitate Scrum
daily standup meeting, produce status reports, conduct project meetings and handle escalations.
UNISYS GLOBAL SERVICES: Service Management Analyst ( Aug 2013 – June 2016) 
•In this role some of my regular duties are to: Conduct Process Gap Analysis & onboard new clients to Unisys PM
Service, perform Trend Analysis, facilitate RCA Investigations for different priority Incidents, produce necessary
reports and initiate Continual Service Improvements to improve Service Continuity.
Academic Credentials:- 
•Pursuing Post Graduate Diploma in Business Management – NMIMS Global Access School for Continuing
Education (NGASCE) – Batch (2020 – 2022).
•Bachelors of Engineering (Electronics) – Sai Vidya Institute of Technology, Graduated: June 2013.
Certifications:- 
•Prince 2 Foundation and Practitioner
•SAFe 5.1 Product Owner/Product Manager (POPM) from Scaled Agile, Inc
•SAFe 5.1 Scrum Master (SSM) from Scaled Agile, Inc
•ITIL V3 Foundation
•Certified Scrum Master from Scrum Alliance
Declaration:- 
Details mentioned above and written particulars are true to the best of my knowledge. 
Place: - Bangalore

Main Project Features: 
A policy decision was taken in India to inter-connect the five independently operating electrical regions with an ultimate objective of establishment of "National Grid" covering entire length and breadth of the country. The "National Grid" was to be developed in phases taking into account the ground realities of operations. The different regions were operating with varying electrical parameters in terms of wide frequency excursions from nominal value of 50 Hz. Therefore, in the first phase the regions were planned to be inter-connected with HVDC back-to-back links which are quite robust against the varying frequencies in the inter-connected regions. The instant scheme was one of such project in which Eastern region of India were inter-connected with the Southern region with 1000 MW HVDC back-to-back module, on the two sides 

This project has envisaged construction of 1000 MW HVDC back-to-back station at Gazuwaka and a 400 kV Jeypore - Gazuwaka 400 kV D/c line of about 225 Km length. This has enabled transfer of power upto 1000 MW in either direction depending on the power flow requirement.

Client: In-House

Main Project Features: 
This scheme was planned in 1980's. At that time, Indian power system was divided into five regions, all of them operating independently. Through detailed load generation studies, it was found that interconnection of regions shall give various benefits viz. reducing demand-supply gap, improving thermal-hydro mix, reduction of spinning reserves, improvement of operating parameters through transfer of surplus power in surplus region and meeting load demand in deficit region. Detailed studies were carried out by POWERGRID (erstwhile NTPC) for selection of best alternative for inter-connection of Northern and Western regions and, it was decided to connect them through HVDC back-to-back link as both the regions had different operating parameters. 

Vindhyachal HVDC back-to-back link consists of 2x250 MW HVDC modules at Vindhyachal, a major generating complex in Western Region and a 400kV AC D/c line to Singrauli, the major generating complex of Northern Region. Power is exchanged between two regions over this link almost on continuous basis. This inter-connector is operating successfully for last twenty seven years.

Name of the Assignment or Project: 2X500 MW HVDC Back to Back station at Vizag
Year: 1999-2004
Location: India
Client: In-House
Position Held: In-Charge, Project Management Team
Main Project Features:
A policy decision was taken in India to inter-connect the five independently operating electrical regions with an ultimate objective of establishment of "National Grid" covering entire length and breadth of the country. The "National Grid" was to be developed in phases taking into account the ground realities of operations. The different regions were operating with varying electrical parameters in terms of wide frequency excursions from nominal value of 50 Hz. Therefore, in the first phase the regions were planned to be inter-connected with HVDC back-to-back links which are quite robust against the varying frequencies in the inter-connected regions. The instant scheme was one of such project in which Eastern region of India were inter-connected with the Southern region with 1000 MW HVDC back-to-back module, on the two sides
This project has envisaged construction of 1000 MW HVDC back-to-back station at Gazuwaka and a 400 kV Jeypore - Gazuwaka 400 kV D/c line of about 225 Km length. This has enabled transfer of power upto 1000 MW in either direction depending on the power flow requirement.
Project Includes following Components::
Part-A Transmission lines:
Jeypore - Gazuwaka 400 kV D/C AC Transmission Line - 225 Km
Gazuwaka - Vijaywada 400 kV D/C AC Transmission Line - 317 Km with 63 MVAR line reactors at both the ends
Part-B HVDC Station:
2x500 MW HVDC Back-to-Back station at Gazuwaka

Name of the Assignment or Project: 2X250 MW HVDC Back to Back station at Vindhyachal
Year: 1986-1999
Location: India
Client: In-House
Position Held: Part of Project Management Team
Main Project Features:
This scheme was planned in 1980's. At that time, Indian power system was divided into five regions, all of them operating independently. Through detailed load generation studies, it was found that interconnection of regions shall give various benefits viz. reducing demand-supply gap, improving thermal-hydro mix, reduction of spinning reserves, improvement of operating parameters through transfer of surplus power in surplus region and meeting load demand in deficit region. Detailed studies were carried out by POWERGRID (erstwhile NTPC) for selection of best alternative for inter-connection of Northern and Western regions and, it was decided to connect them through HVDC back-to-back link as both the regions had different operating parameters.
Vindhyachal HVDC back-to-back link consists of 2x250 MW HVDC modules at Vindhyachal, a major generating complex in Western Region and a 400kV AC D/c line to Singrauli, the major generating complex of Northern Region. Power is exchanged between two regions over this link almost on continuous basis. This inter-connector is operating successfully for last twenty seven years.
Project Includes following Components::
Part-A Transmission lines:
Singrauli - Vindhyachal 400 kV D/C AC Transmission line - 5 Km
Part-B HVDC Station:
2x250 MW HVDC Back-to-Back station at Vindhyachal

Name of the Assignment or Project: 2X500 MW HVDC Back to Back station at Vizag

Main Project Features:
A policy decision was taken in India to inter-connect the five independently operating electrical regions with an ultimate objective of establishment of "National Grid" covering entire length and breadth of the country. The "National Grid" was to be developed in phases taking into account the ground realities of operations. The different regions were operating with varying electrical parameters in terms of wide frequency excursions from nominal value of 50 Hz. Therefore, in the first phase the regions were planned to be inter-connected with HVDC back-to-back links which are quite robust against the varying frequencies in the inter-connected regions. The instant scheme was one of such project in which Eastern region of India were inter-connected with the Southern region with 1000 MW HVDC back-to-back module, on the two sides
This project has envisaged construction of 1000 MW HVDC back-to-back station at Gazuwaka and a 400 kV Jeypore - Gazuwaka 400 kV D/c line of about 225 Km length. This has enabled transfer of power upto 1000 MW in either direction depending on the power flow requirement.
Project Includes following Components::
Part-A Transmission lines:
Jeypore - Gazuwaka 400 kV D/C AC Transmission Line - 225 Km
Gazuwaka - Vijaywada 400 kV D/C AC Transmission Line - 317 Km with 63 MVAR line reactors at both the ends
Part-B HVDC Station:
2x500 MW HVDC Back-to-Back station at Gazuwaka

Name of the Assignment or Project: 2X250 MW HVDC Back to Back station at Vindhyachal

Main Project Features:
This scheme was planned in 1980's. At that time, Indian power system was divided into five regions, all of them operating independently. Through detailed load generation studies, it was found that interconnection of regions shall give various benefits viz. reducing demand-supply gap, improving thermal-hydro mix, reduction of spinning reserves, improvement of operating parameters through transfer of surplus power in surplus region and meeting load demand in deficit region. Detailed studies were carried out by POWERGRID (erstwhile NTPC) for selection of best alternative for inter-connection of Northern and Western regions and, it was decided to connect them through HVDC back-to-back link as both the regions had different operating parameters.
Vindhyachal HVDC back-to-back link consists of 2x250 MW HVDC modules at Vindhyachal, a major generating complex in Western Region and a 400kV AC D/c line to Singrauli, the major generating complex of Northern Region. Power is exchanged between two regions over this link almost on continuous basis. This inter-connector is operating successfully for last twenty seven years.

Order Management System

There is one Order Management System UI is there through which customers can Buy and Sell Securities, Forex and Stocks and can apply for Loan and Deposits.
This UI is written in Angular 4 and HTML5 and this is connected with Back end though REST API.

Client Output Management System

Julius Bank is private banking which has thousands of HNWI (High Net Worth Individual ) clients.
This system supports functionality of generating Client Advices & Client Statements and sending a printed Copy to Client Home Address.
The full System from Loading data to generating Advices PDF and Printing PDF is fully automated.
All the data is coming from Core Banking Application TEMENOS T24.

Client Advices: 

Client Advice is the details of Transaction done by Client daily to daily.
As a regulation, Bank must generate details of all Transaction done by Client into a PDF and has to send a copy of this Advice PDF to Client Home Address.
Advices are generated on every working day for all transaction and all Products.
There are around 20 Types of Products and Advices generated and every Advice has different template and business logic.
The full System from Loading data to generating Advices PDF and Printing PDF is fully automated.

Client Statement: [ Asset Statement & Account Statement & Security Movement Report ]

Asset Statement has the details and current positions of all Assets [ Shares, Stocks, Loans, Equity, Forex ] owned by Client.It also displays performance report.
Account Statement has the details of Cash Movement of all [ Shares, Stocks, Loans, Equity, Forex ] owned by Client.
Security Movement Report has the details of Security Movement of all Securities owned by Client.
User can generate these Statement directly for any Portfolio at any time.
Every Month End,we generate all Statements for all Clients and send one copy to Client Home Address.This is called Month End Statements.
The full System from Loading data to generating Statements PDF and Printing PDF is fully automated.

This UI is written in Angular 4 and HTML5 and this is connected with Back end though REST API.
Client Output Management System
Julius Bank is private banking which has thousands of HNWI (High Net Worth Individual ) clients.
This system supports functionality of generating Client Advices & Client Statements and sending a printed Copy to Client Home Address.
The full System from Loading data to generating Advices PDF and Printing PDF is fully automated.
All the data is coming from Core Banking Application TEMENOS T24.
Client Advices:
Client Advice is the details of Transaction done by Client daily to daily.
As a regulation, Bank must generate details of all Transaction done by Client into a PDF and has to send a copy of this Advice PDF to Client Home Address.
Advices are generated on every working day for all transaction and all Products.
There are around 20 Types of Products and Advices generated and every Advice has different template and business logic.
The full System from Loading data to generating Advices PDF and Printing PDF is fully automated.
Client Statement: [ Asset Statement & Account Statement & Security Movement Report ]
Asset Statement has the details and current positions of all Assets [ Shares, Stocks, Loans, Equity, Forex ] owned by Client.It also displays performance report.
Account Statement has the details of Cash Movement of all [ Shares, Stocks, Loans, Equity, Forex ] owned by Client.
Security Movement Report has the details of Security Movement of all Securities owned by Client.
User can generate these Statement directly for any Portfolio at any time.
Every Month End,we generate all Statements for all Clients and send one copy to Client Home Address.This is called Month End Statements.
The full System from Loading data to generating Statements PDF and Printing PDF is fully automated.

 +6594658215 dtwabs@gmail.com https://www.linkedin.com/in/dorminewabina/ 

 PROFESSIONAL SUMMARY

Customer-centric, solutions-driven professional. Extensive knowledge in application migration, functional testing (web and mobile applications)

Domain knowledge – healthcare technology, oil and gas, software consulting services, healthcare technology, semiconductor.

Certified Scrum Master (CSM). Agile coach enthusiast. 

In-depth understanding of STLC (Software Testing Life Cycle), SDLC (Software Development Life Cycle), and Defect and Vendor Management. Extensive experience interacting with clients, and coordinating with offshore/onshore BA, Software Developers, and QC teams. 

Detail-oriented. Strong organizational skills. Work with enthusiasm in a collaborative approach with a consultant mindset.

TECHNICAL SKILLS 

•

JIRA, Confluence, HP ALM, Team Foundation Server (TFS), SOAPUI, MySQL.

• 

Software Testing /QA

• 

IT Operations, Support: 

SOP (Standard Operating Procedures), CAB (Change Advisory Board), Production Change Management planning (PCM), Escalation, L2 technical investigation, production incident hotfix planning, and monitoring, status update reporting. 

•

 Software Test Engineer (through Percepts Solutions) 04/2022 – Present 

 ❖ STMicroelectronics, Singapore (through Percept Solutions) 

Pioneer member of EC (Excellence Center) of STMicroelectronics, Singapore.

Responsibly handled testing activities of MES (Manufacturing Electronic System) data migration project. 

Initiated the preparation of reusable pre-requisite documents as well as RTM (Requirement Traceability Matrix) that increase the productivity of the resource assigned. 

Coached teammates on standard test reporting, defect logging as well as STLC.

Initiated in development of best practices in defect logging, test suite creation as well as test activity progress report.

Responsibly reviewed and analyzed installation guide documents for pre-deployment activity. 

Prepared and analyzed the Analysis and Planning document.

Collaborated with Business Analysts, Test Analysts, and Software Developers (both in-house and outsourced) across Asia and Europe STMicroelectronics counterparts (i.e. China, Malaysia, India, Italy, Morocco, Malta, France)

Reported defects and provided high-level analysis to production customers.

Senior System Analyst 06/2021 – 09/2021 

❖ Accenture (Singapore) 

Functional analyst lead, and test lead for API Management portal project. 

Test artifacts reviewer. 

Prepared user stories, and logged bugs using JIRA Software. Conducted user story refinement and led daily scrum with offshore teams. 

Prepared Workplan, and functional design tasks. Conducted interview, and walkthrough to the client. Researched Apigee and Drupal CMS. 

Conducted SOAPUI knowledge exchange (KX). 

A facilitated test case, and scenarios review to the functional analyst team. 

Led requirements analysis, test design, prioritization, test execution, and defect management. 

Facilitated training regarding SDLC (Software Development Life Cycle) as well as STLC (Software Testing Life Cycle). 

Conducted functional requirement analysis and data mapping for LIS (Laboratory Information System) project. 

Client coordination during change request (CR) and TCER (Test Condition and Expected Result) review and follow-up. 

 

Sr. Software Test Analyst 

 ❖ Integrated Health Information System (IHiS) 09/2017 – 05/2021 

Led testing activities for HealthHub’s (HH) Payments, Appointments, Admission, and Financial Counselling modules. 

Led data migration for the Appointments module, from the ePOS system to EPIC systems for NUP (National University Polyclinics) and NHGP (National Health Group Polyclinics). 

Led GBBP (Government Bug Bounty Program) verification activities. 

Facilitated remote knowledge exchange on test design techniques. 

Provided test effort estimates, and resource allocation. Prepared test plans, TCERs, and test approaches. 

Established test metrics (e.g defect detection efficiency, defect age). 

Prepared workflow diagram on ePOS to EPIC data migration. 

Led the Payments testing activities with verification of card number, card expiry date, CVC validity, and accessibility to the Payments gateway.

Managed change requests for the Appointments module. Collaborated with SAP-FI, OAS, and BFE (Bill Format Engine) source system teams. 

Assisted in resolving impediments that prevent test case design or execution and defect triage. 

Conducted test case and test data walkthroughs to assigned POCs (point of contact) and assigned software developers. 

Implemented requirement traceability matrix (RTM). 

Tested eNETS’ cluster-merchant ID implementation, was involved during post-deployment activity, and serves as the QA POC for HealthHub – Payments module. 

Prepared DTP (Detailed Test Plan), MTP (Master Test Plan) for the HealthHub project. 

System Analyst / Business Analyst 

 ❖ Integrated Health Information System (IHiS) 03/2016 – 09/2017 

Prepared data mapping, diagrams, and flowcharts for a weekly client meeting. 

Handled high-level technical investigation (L2) for production incidents. Manage service requests via JIRA SM. 

Conducted weekly meetings with HealthHub (HH) stakeholders for HH updates, enhancements, root cause analysis, and hotfix deployment plan and approval. 

Developed SOP (Standard Operating Procedure) and training to contact center team. 

Reinforced in creating a systematic approach to monitor systems’ health, gather system statistics. 

Collaborated with software developers, business analysts as well as solutions architects to stay current on product features, latest CRs (change requests), and process improvement. 

Managed the HH PCM (Production Change Management) process. 

 

Business Analyst /Test Analyst (SharePoint) 

 ❖ KeppelFELS, Singapore 12/2013 – 12/2015 

Developed new user SharePoint account standard procedure to be utilized within KeppelFELS onshore and offshore users. 

Developed test plans, and test strategy, prepared ST and SIT timelines, and submitted daily status reports, test report summaries, and test closure memos. 

Managed to handle responsibilities of BA/QA and Support for KM portal. 

Responsibly handled defects that required collaboration with the Microsoft team based in Shanghai, China. 

Conducted interviews with key business stakeholders. 

Involved in the prioritization of requirements as well as test cases pertaining to KM portal enhancements. 

Initiated daily scrum and established QA processes tailored for the KM team. 

Responsibly supported the monthly managing director’s review meeting. 

Test Analyst 

 ❖ AIG, (Muntinlupa, Philippines) 12/2012 – 10/2013 

Defect Management - effectively monitored defect status, ensuring compliance with defect process tailored for the project team.

Test lead for file transfer testing activities. POC (Point of Contact) during application migration of advisor portal in a health insurance domain.

Test data management - performed test data gathering through database tools, and coordinated with POCs from integrated systems for data preparation necessary for SIT and UAT test scenarios. Provided test activity estimation and test reports to the Test lead, Project manager (onshore). 

Test coordinator – coordinated with junior test team members, and developers both onshore and offshore, as well as coordinated with the PM and BA for change requests raised for assigned modules. 

Prepared test plans, test scenarios, and RTM (Requirement Traceability Matrix) for SIT.

 Senior Software Engineer (Sr. Test Analyst) 01/2007 – 04/2011 

 ❖ Accenture, (Manila, Philippines) 

Conducted training on SAP R/3 ERP on SD (Sales and Distribution), and MM (Material Management) to internal TCoE (Testing Centre of Excellence) resources. 

Prepared test data and developed test cases for SAP Order-to-Cash (OTC). Involved in test execution for MM module (i.e. PO creation, PO edit, and display, review and release IC PO, Display released PO) 

Executed QTP (Quick Test Pro) test scripts for the Accenture CIO portal. 

Involved during test execution of SAP FI; shadow Test Engineer for SAP HR (Time Management). 

Initiated and led the Defect Management team for the SAP project. 

Responsibly handled application support for European markets. 

Analyzed and translated functional requirements to test scenarios. 

Developed test cases, conducted test case reviews, and prepared testing effort estimates for the Testing team in the SIEBEL platform project for P&G (Procter and Gamble). Involved in regression testing for SAP, and Siebel projects.

Reliance Broadcast Network Ltd (92.7 BIG FM), Delhi as Group Head

Radio (92.7 BIGFM) in Delhi NCR region 
 Revenue generation by selling company IPs, Sponsorships and on-ground activations.

on 
 Driving business through properties/special programs on the channel; driving acquisition of clients on the same 
 Follow up and ensure that monies are collected on time, sending appropriate reminders to clients and agencies for 
payment 
 Competition tracking and monitoring on a daily basis, local print, electronic and digital media tracking to generate new 
prospects. 
 
 

 
 
Info Edge India Ltd. (99acres.com), Bangalore as Senior Manager

 Led a team of sales professionals including Assistant Manager, Business Manager, Area Manager, Sr. Executives so on 
 Managed a portfolio of real estate vertical, promoting digital ad business for 99acare, providing response-oriented 
campaigns and brand solutions on 99acres platform to our esteemed advertisers. 
 Prepared weekly dashboard and arranging monthly review meeting, presentation to the management 
 Working on given portfolio with the team in order to provide a tailored solutions to the clients according to their 
business requirement. 
 Developed sales plan strategies along with the team, starting from monthly, quarterly, and yearly revenues 
 Building and maintaining healthy business relations with the Developers, Channel partners, Agencies and Dealers to 
ensure healthy business with them. 
 
Aug ’17 – Sep ’20: Times of India, Brand Solutions- OMS – Indore as Group Head (MPCG) 
Highlights: 
 Team management, leading, setting direction, training & mentoring the performance of a team to ensure efficiency of 
every individual team member 
 Responsibility includes branch business development, Ad sales, space & content monetization, revenue from 
influencer’s campaign, digital inventories, innovation & events. 
 Designing and executing customized media solutions for clients through content integration in various media vehicles of 
Times Group. Creating innovative avenues & events, mentoring team, work with senior leadership with data driven 
approach to explore created business. 
 Planned revenue models from various sources like: Print, Television, Radio, Digital, Events 
 Develop and execute new business initiatives like; New Activation Ideas that convert to revenue generation opportunities 
 Providing customized BRAND SOLUTIONS to Media agencies and clients. Taking care of all aspects from Client Servicing to 
campaign execution. 
 Managed multiple agencies pertaining to research, creative’s, digital and PR to develop ATL / BTL marketing campaigns 
 
Sep’10 – Aug’17: Times of India Group (Magicbricks.com), Indore as Team Leader 
Highlights: 
 Business Growth: delivery on all critical parameters such as collections, order value, property events 
 Client management: acquisition, retention, up selling and cross selling of products 
 Team management: managed a team of account managers. Working closely with the sales and marketing team to drive 
sales, motivate them to achieve high standards and targets. 
 Assisted the marketing Manager with the coordination of metrics-based reporting (ROI) on key marcoms activities and 
best practice; managed customer database and in-house prospect lists 
 
E D U C A T I O N 
 2023 : Pursuing Masters Diploma Program in Digital Marketing from Digital Gurukul 
 2008 : MBA/PGDBM in Marketing from IITTM, Ministry of HRD, Govt. of India (CAT Allied Institute) 
 2005 : Bachelor of science from Jiwaji University, Gwalior 
 
C E R T I F I C A TI O N 
 2023: Pursuing certification in Google Analytics

WORK EXPERIENCE
 

Alankrit Solutions April 2012 - Till Present
(Interior Designing)
Project Manager

Maintaining customer relationships and ensuring customer loyalty through excellent customer service as well as meeting all client needs appropriate to their business. Monitoring the market changes, competitor pricing and strategy. Writing proposals and specifications. Generating sales, negotiate prices, prepare contracts and close deals. Consulting with the clients to determine their budget and goals for the space, and putting together a team. Regenerated orders and followed up customers for referrals.

Mylocum Ltd (United Kingdom) February 2010 - February 2012
Resource Manager(HR) 

Maintained organization staff by establishing a recruiting, testing, and interviewing program; counselling managers on candidate selection; conducting and analyzing exit interviews; recommending changes. Ensuring legal compliance by monitoring and implementing applicable human resource federal and state requirements; conducting investigations; maintaining records; representing the organization at hearings. Maintained management guidelines by preparing, updating, and recommending human resource policies and procedures.

Mc Donald's (United Kingdom) Sept 2007- December 2009
(Part time with MIB)
Team leader 

Provide leadership to the team, Trained new staff and managed weekly rosters, Delivered customer service as well as performed cash handling. Motivate, support and mentor the staff when needed.
Checking equipment to ensure that it is in proper working order, letting the management team know if there might be a problem. Report and distribute management information highlighting areas for improvement and those of concern and opportunity.

IBM Daksha August 2006- July 2007
Customer Care Executive

Undertook the duties of a Customer Service Adviser as and when required to ensure that a high level of customer service is maintained and to undertake any other duties as required, which are commensurate with the grading of the post. Managed in-bound customer calls, sold & promoted other financial services and added value to business by up selling and cross selling. Ensured appropriate procedures were followed for each service request, including logging, processing and progress chasing enquiries.

SKILLS & STRENGTHS

System Skills:
Competent in all Microsoft Office packages including Outlook, Lotus Notes, Excel, Word, Access, PowerPoint, MS Project and Business databases like EBSCO Host. Good Knowledge around the CCA (Consumer Credit Act) and DPA (Data Protection Act)

Strenghts:
Highly analytical thinker with demonstrated talent for identifying, scrutinizing, improving, and streamlining complex work processes. Resourceful team player who excels at building trusting relationships with customers and colleagues. Able to make decisions, meet targets and work under pressure. A team player with excellent communication and interpersonal skills. A quality conscious individual with appreciable amount of exposure working with people from different cultures.

ADDITIONAL INFORMATION
I believe I understand the trends and am able to design according to the needs of the clients. Very spontaneous, Design driven & like to explore the given medium to the best of its utility. I am a confident, determined and an ambitious person. Highly motivated to learn new things and perform the best to my capabilities. I have a sense of responsibility, maturity, and understanding with my co-workers and superiors and this makes me universally acceptable. I have good communication skills that give me the power to move amicably in a group.
Some of my interests are: Music, films,photography, travel, and an active gym member.
Multilingual- English, Hindi, Punjabi.

References
Available upon request.

Preet Sukhija

Professional Summary

Having 6+Years of IT Experiences in Data Modeling, Data Mart Development & Maintenance of Data Warehousing and Client Server Application Finance, Telecom and Manufacturing. Expertise with SQL Server 2012 of products like (MSBI) Tools SSIS, SSRS and Azure.

Experienced in creating Tables, Stored procedures, Functions and Triggers, Constraints, Indexes, Schemas, Functions, Views.

Expert in writing Complex T-SQL queries Sub-queries and Joins Concepts.

Experience in Query Optimization and performance tuning of stored procedures, functions etc. 

Experienced in ETL (Extracting, Transforming and Loading) development, SSIS for migration of data between legacy systems, ERP to SQL Server 2005/2008.

Experience in Developing ETL Packages using SSIS and Different types of Data Loading (Direct, Incremental, SCD, etc.) implementing using Packages and used Configuration files.

Worked with various tasks such as Control Flow (Execute SQL Task, For Each Loop Container, Data Flow Task and Worked with Transformations such as Aggregate, Sort, Lookup, Merge join, Multicast, Conditional split, Derived column etc.

Experience on Logging, Error handling by using Event Handler in various projects.

Hands on experience on Performance tuning at various levels like source, target, destination, transformations using Row Transformation, Block and Unblock Transformations.

Experience in creating jobs, SQL Mail, Alerts, and schedule SSIS Packages using SQL Server Agent and Implemented Check points at Package level.

Hands on experience on Deployment, Dynamic Configuration, Providing Securities and Scheduling the Packages.

Extensive experience in creating several reports such as Drill down reports, Drill through, parameterized reports, linked reports, sub reports using SQL Server Reporting Services. 

Excellent in subscriptions, creating reports with report builder, report snapshot and report cache.

Designed and developed matrix, tabular and parametric in the SQL Server Reporting Services.

Experience in scheduling and deployment of reports and uploading files to a report server catalog from the report manger.

Knowledge on Azure.

Educational Qualifications 

B. Tech from JNT University, Kakinada

Work Experience

 

Working for ITC INFOTECH, Hyderabad as a Senior Software Engineer from Jan 2022 to April 2023.

Working for Cognizant Technology Solutions, Hyderabad as a Software Engineer from July 2021 to Dec 2021.

Worked for Genex Technologies, Hyderabad as Software Engineer from 2016 Dec to 2021 June.

Technical Synopsis

DBMS : SQL Server 2008R2 and 2012.

OS/Environment : Windows family.

Database Tools : Business Intelligence Development Studio. 

ETL Tools : SSIS (SQL Server Integration Services).

OLAP Tools : SSAS (SQL Server Analysis Services).

Reporting Tools : SSRS (SQL Server Reporting Services).

Visualization Tools : POWER BI

Project Summary

Project#2:

Project Name : THERABREATH

Client : Church and Dwight, USA

Designation : MSBI Developer.

Technology : MSBI 2008R2/2012 (SQL Developer, SSIS, T-SQL).

Description:

SHS Sales & Marketing has become a dominant player within the FMCG marketplace with over twenty-five years’ experience of building brands throughout Great Britain. We are a dynamic and privately owned company who continually invest in our people, brands and business. The main aim of the Project is for extracting the data from different sources and transforms the data by using Integration Services transformations and loading into Data Warehouse. This is a data warehousing application made for the analysis and reporting purpose of the sales and marketing company. The dimensional modeling used in this project is star schema.

Responsibilities:

Involved in designing the process flow for health care domain which includes the Patient, Guarantor, Insurance, and transaction Details.

Extracting the data from various Source systems which include DB2 and various flat files in different formats (.txt, CSV, excel).

Cleansing the patient, guarantor, insurance details involving around 100+ data flow transformations to get the desired results in the staging area and load on to the target tables.

Created mapping using Designer Tool as per the Mapping specification document provided by the client.

I used to design SSIS Packages to connect to Heterogeneous sources and pulling data from source and loading into data warehouse.

After loading the data, I used to generate name type of reports according to the client Requirement

Creation of workflows with Data flow, Execute SQL task, and Execute package tasks And Containers, and Created Configurations to change the package properties dynamically.

Identified the database tables for defining the queries for the reports and defined the Datasets for report generation.

Expert in writing Complex T-SQL queries like stored procedures, functions, indexes.

Building and generating reports with the help of Report Builder in the Report manager.

Project#1:

Project Name : BSC Config

Client : BSC, California.

Designation : MSBI Developer.

Technology : MSBI 2008R2/2012 (SQL Developer, SSIS, SSRS,T-SQL).

Description:

The main aim of the Project is for extracting the data from different sources and transforms the data by using Integration Services transformations and loading into Data Warehouse. This is a data warehousing application made for the analysis and reporting purpose of the sales and marketing company. The dimensional modeling used in this project is star schema. Using this project, we can generate various types of reports like best Employee Report, Best Customer Report, Best Product sold report, Best Promotion report, etc.

Responsibilities:

Creating SSIS Packages by using different data Transformations like Derived Column, Lookup, Conditional Split, Merge Join, Multicast, Union all and Execute SQL Task to load data into Database.

Creating Staging database for temporary processing of data, loading fact and dimension tables into data warehouse using Integration services

Creating the Stored procedures, functions, and Indexes in SQL server.

Expert in writing Complex T-SQL queries like stored procedures, functions, indexes.

Designed and developed the SSIS Packages.

Scheduling the jobs using SQL Agent.

Addressing user issues.

different countries like UAE, Oman and India. My experience includes but not limited to the following: material 
evaluation, supplier evaluation, QMS, SAP – QM, and HSE management systems. When addressing quality my 
goals are always to ensure compliance to specifications, standards and within technical parameters to improve 
processes and procedures in a manner benefiting the organization. In case I have been called upon to develop 
corrective remediation, I have had success delivering compliant solutions which minimized company liabilities. I am 
both a team player and team builder recognized for my ability to establish and maintain solid relationships with co-
workers, management, customers, project principals, and vendors, as well as internal /external stakeholders. The 
contract value of projects I have supervised range from 10 QA engineers and up to 30 QC inspectors/engineers while 
managing testing firms.

and maintained at all levels of the organization. Maintain Quality Management System (QMS), Quality Assurance 
policy, manuals and procedures and ITPs and monitoring its proper implementation, raising and development 
requirements. Preparation of IMS Audit yearly schedules, conducting internal audits of all functional areas with cross 
functional auditors, conducting management review meetings and circulating the minutes of these meetings and 
conducting follow-up actions to ensure the continual improvement of processes is achieved. 
 
I have led varied construction projects-high rise buildings, roads, highways, rail over bridge projects (ROB), 
Metro rail viaduct, cut and cover and airport projects, concrete as well as asphalt mix designs. I establish 
proposed workplan and direct QA/QC Engineers to ensure proper execution in terms of quality and reliability. Site 
visits and/or conduct inspections to ensure work are in compliance with contract requirements, good construction 
practice, only approved materials are used, compliance with contract requirements. Review sub-contractor’s quality 
policy, manual, procedures and ITP, and monitoring its proper implementation and effective maintain via contract 
requirements. Cooperate for final resolution of any non-conformities (NCR) with concerned personnel. Possess strong

Curriculum Vitae 
 
BABU BISWAS 
 
Permanent Address: 
Vill.: Byazra-Bandhaghat, Bagchibagan, Chandannagar 
P.O.: Mankundu 
Dist.: Hooghly 
West Bengal, PIN - 712139 
Mobile: +91-9088777911 / +91-8849172002 
E-Mail: 
babubiswas58@yahoo.com 
 
 
 A dynamic professional with 13 years’ experience in transmission line field. 
 Strategy Planning Budget & Cost Control 
 Material Management Commercial Activity 
 Coordination / Liaison Quality Assurance & Control 
 
VISION & OBJECTIVE: 
 
Looking for a challenging career in a result oriented company in the field of Power Transmission Sector that seeks 
an ambitious and career conscious person where acquired skills and experience will be utilized towards continuous 
growth and advancement so as to achieve self-realization and accomplishment of organizational goals. 
 
EMPLOYMENT HISTORY: 
 
Siddhartha Engineering Limited 
 
Duration: March 2021 to Cont.... 
Designation: Sr. Executive – Planning & Billing 
Working Location: Lungsen, Mizoram. 
 
Responsibility: 
 Planning & Coordination of Transmission Line & Substation for Foundation, Erection & Stringing. 
 Prepare the JMC for Client Billing for Sub-Station & Transmission Line. (Supply & Erection both) 
 Prepare Sub-Contractor monthly billing. 
 Prepare the Accounting, monthly revenue & payment budget. 
 Prepare monthly projection billing for supply & erection for submit to Powergrid. 
 Prepare DPR & sent to HOD (DGM, GM & ED) & Powergrid Engineer, Asst. Manager, GM, Sr.GM & CGM. 
 Coordination of raw materials testing with client approved laboratory 
 Coordination of all materials like Cement, Steel, Tower Materials & Accessories up to site store. 
 Maintain the good relationship & attain meeting with Client & sub-contractor on various project issues. 
 
 
Project Involvement: 
 
1. 132/33kV GIS Sub-Station at Lungsen (PGCIL) 
2. 132/33kV Bay Extn. Work at Khawiva, Lunglei (PGCIL) 
3. 132kV S/c Lungsen to Chawngte and Chawngte to South Bungtlang Tr. Line. (65KM-PGCIL) 
4. 132kV West Phaileng – Zemabawk OPGW Live Line (PGCIL-51 KM) 
5. 132kV Zuangtui to Saitual & Saitual to Khawzual OPGW Live Line (PGCIL-93 KM) 
 
 
Montecarlo Limited 
 
Duration: March, 2019 to March, 2021 (2 Years) 
Designation: Sr. Engineer – Planning –Monitoring & Techno 
Working Location: Halvad (Gujarat) 
 
Responsibility: 
 Design & drawing approval with client for supply materials & erection work. 
 Initiating manufacturing clearance and placing DO. 
 Raising inspection calls & material inspection 

 Plan monitoring and preparation of MIS report. 
 Monthly Work Planning & materials procurement as per budget. 
 Materials Issue Reservation in SAP. 
 Prepare Daily Progress Report & upload to SAP. 
 ROW Record keeping. 
 Client Correspondence (Survey report submission & collect approval, Site visit with railway dept., road 
crossing, collector case submission, Supply Materials inspection report submission etc.) 
 Client Bill (Supply & Erection RA Bill) & Sub-Contractor Bill Preparation thru SAP. 
 Follow up for realization of payment with client. 
 Cost Settlement. 
 
Project Involvement: 
 
1. 400 kV D/c Varsana to Halvad Transmission Line Package – 2 (GETCO - 47KM). 
 
Associated Power Structures Pvt. Ltd. (APS)
 
 
Duration: February, 2013 to February 2019 (6 Years) 
Designation: Officer (Projects) 
Working Location: Vadodara (Gujarat) 
 
Responsibility: 
 Site Execution (Supervision) Foundation, Erection, Stringing. 
 Monthly Work Planning. 
 Prepare DPR & sent to head office. 
 Accounting & Budget through ERP 
 Client Billing (Supply & Erection RA Bill) & Contractor Bill, 
 Project work reporting (Check & Detailed Survey, Foundation, Erection & Stringing) thru ERP. Follow up for 
realization of payment with client. 
 Apart from above, my additional responsibility are to handle all type activity in Store like prepare 
documentation & record keeping with the help of MS Word-Excel & ERP System, reporting to concern 
department regularly for further necessary work. 
 
 
Project Involvement: 
 
1. LILO one circuit of 220kV D/C Kasor - Gavasad line at 220 kV Gotri S/s with ACSR Zebra 
Conductor along with conservation of 132kV D/C Gotri-Dhuvaran-Karamsad line in 220kV M/C & 
D/C line (22.17 KM) & OPGW and dismantling of existing 132kV D/C Gotri - Karamsad Dhuvaran 
Line (20 KM) from Gotri S/s. 
2. 220kV D/C Vadodara – Jambuva (765kV PGCIL) Tr. Line at Vadodara. (34KM) (GETCO) 
3. 132kV D/C Haldarwa- Tralsa DFCC transmission Line at Bharuch (DFCC) 
4. 400kV D/C Jhanor –Navsari & Ukai –Kosamba Inter Connection Tr. Line at KIM. (GETCO) 
5. 132kV D/C Ode – Manjusar Tr. Line at Vadodara (GETCO) 
6. 220kV LILO of D/C & M/C Kosamba – Mobha Tr. Line (56KM) (GETCO) 
 
 
Huma Enterprises & Consultants Pvt. Ltd. 
 
Duration: Mar, 2011 to Jan’2013 (1 Year 10 Months) 
Designation: Project Officer 
Working Location: Pasighat (Arunachal Pradesh) 
 
Responsibility: 
Handle all types of site activity (Foundation & Erection) along with Store handling with record keeping & 
progress reporting to concern department for further necessary work & reporting to higher management 
regularly. 
 
Project Involvement: 
 
1. 132kV S/c T/L Along to Pasighat Transmission Line (PGCIL) 
Gammon India Limited 
 
Duration: Apr, 2010 to Mar, 2011 (1 Year) 
Designation: Store Asst. 
Working Location: Ajitmal, Etawah. 

 
Responsibility: 
Firstly involved in Store activity for Transmission Line Project then gathered basic knowledge in field activity in Store 
& learnt variour documents keeping under the experience Store Keeper & Tower materials stacking & shorting, H/W 
Fitting unloading & checking, Steel bending asper drawing etc. work. 
 
Project Involvement: 
 
1. 400kV D/c Parichha to Mainpuri Tr. Line. 
 
 
ACADEMIC PROFILE: 
 
 Diploma in Civil Engineering from Janardan Rai Nagar Rajasthan Vidyapeeth University from 2015-2018 (66.11%) 
 10

 from Khalisani Vidyamandir, Chandannagar under W.B.B.S.E. in 2007 (51%) 
 
OTHER EXPERIENCE: 
 
MS Word & Excel, MS Project, Light House ERP-9 & SAP.

Feedback Infra Pvt. Ltd (June 2021 - Till Date) (Senior Engineer, Electrical, Ranchi)
World Bank (WB) is supporting Jharkhand Urja Sancharan Nigam Limited (JUSNL) with a loan of US$310 million to achieve the 24/7 Power for All goal of the Government of the Jharkhand (GOJ). JUSNL is using the fund to construct substations and transmission lines to evacuate power from upcoming generation plants of 4.3 GW capacity and to support the availability of the electricity in all corners of the state of the Jharkhand. This World Bank Funded Transmission Project of JUSNL under JPSIP has been divided into 16 Packages, which includes 8 Nos of 132/33 Grid Substation Packages having capacity of 2*50 MVA each and 8 Nos of Transmission Lines Packages having total length of 2244 CKM. The overall project is divided into Package-1 as zone-1 (Ranchi) & zone-2 (Dumka) and Package-2 as zone- 3 (Jamshedpur) and zone-4 (Daltonganj) in Jharkhand District.
M/s Feedback Infra Pvt. Ltd. has been appointed as PMC for Package-1. The scope of work of Project Management Consultant of Package 1 is to deliver Project Management Consultancy services for Transmission Projects consisting of 12 Grid Substations of 2X50 MVA capacity each and 1030 CKM of 132 kV Transmission Lines.

Coordination with PIU (Project Implementation Unit) at Ranchi (JUSNL, HQ) for monitoring of the project and support the officials for its faster & quicker resolution. Preparation of MPR/QPR/CPTD/Forest and other statutory Reports with GTP/MQP, vendor approvals and all Site related activities.
