candidates.rawText:
Executive Summary 
 
 
Highly competent Civil Engineer with 25 Years of extensive experience in managing civil works for major Power 
and water projects in Middle East, Africa and India. Expertise includes independently handing civil construction 
works, coordination with civil subcontractor, civil designer, and client. Civil works estimation for tendering, civil 
works planning, Handling of civil document / drawing in PIRS, review of material submittals, method statement, 
following up the drawing and submitting for approval. Maintaining civil works quality records like RFI, MIR, MCC 
and Test Reports as per PQP and ITP. Civil works measurement certification / settlement of extra works quantity 
and rate. Prequalification and Evaluation of sub-contractors offer for civil works. 
Qualification 
 
 
Diploma in Civil Engineering, Bachelor of Technology Civil 
Well versed with Windows, MS office tools, PIRS- Document Management, Project Scheduling and 
AutoCAD 
 
Areas of Expertise 
 
Civil work execution 
 Civil work for substations (GIS & AIS), Solar Plant substation and Transmission Line 
 Civil work for Pumping station and pipeline (Under Ground and above ground), underground valve chamber 
 Civil work for Industrial buildings, DG Building, Pump House, Control Building and staff quarters 
 Heavy Equipment foundations, Pile foundations, ground improvement, Tower foundations, pipe support 
foundations, cable support foundations Surge vessel foundations 
 Oil pit, water storage tanks, Cable Laying Underground and Overhead, Pipe trench, cable gallery 
 
Site Management 
 Civil work coordination with subcontractor, consultant, and client. 
 Monitoring of civil works quality and keeping record of quality documents as per PQP / ITP. 
 Inspection of materials and works based on specification and approved documents 
 Resolving and closing of NCR received from the client. 
 Schedule monitoring of civil works and cautioning subcontractor about the delay in the works progress and 
giving advance information about critical items. 
 Preparation of Weekly and monthly civil work schedule and coordination with other discipline engineers for 
interference. 
 Attending weekly review meeting with client and consultant. 
 Civil contract management via certification of work progress, verification of additional claims, and initiation of 
scope change order. 
 Preparation of civil work progress measurement sheet and getting certification of MS by client/ consultants. 
 Daily, weekly and monthly reports to head office. 
 Preparation of MCC documents and punch list. 
 
Design coordination 
 Coordination with civil designer and other discipline engineer for timely delivery of civil drawings. 
 Review of layout and GA drawings before submitting for approval. 
 Review of method statements and material submittal before submitting for approval. 
 Processing and Handling of civil documents in PIRS system. 
 Distribution of approved RFC drawings to site. 
 Preparation of Red mark drawings and checking of As Build drawings. 
 Initiation of Field change request if required. 
 
Tendering Support 
 Site visit and evaluation of risk/ additional work involved for the civil works. 
 Estimation of civil works quantity based on the tender drawings. 
 Preparation of civil works BOQ. 
Victor Johnraj 
 
Mobile : +255686376425 
Watssup -+918825992512 
Email : victorjohn@rediffmail.com / Victorjohnraj@gmail.com 

DPS Durg October 2020 – Aug 2021 
ABB Ltd / Linxon Abu Dhabi, UAE June 2008 – SEP2020 
SIEMENS Ltd, India March 2006- June 2008 
ETA, PPD, Dubai, UAE Feb 2004- March 2006 
 Evaluation of civil works offer by civil sub-contractor 
 Post contract award supporting in sub-contractor selection via preparation of detail BOQ, evaluation of sub- 
contractor quotations and credential. 
Career Highlights 
 
As Construction Manager (Project In charge for TL JNHPP 80 KM Section) 
Independently handling the project works. Responsible for completion of project in time and budget. Co- 
ordination with contractors, design team, procurement team client and consultant. Preparing/ Monitoring weekly 
and monthly plan. Coordinating with SCM for supply of materials, Identifying contractor / supplier, negotiation, 
and finalization of contractor / supplier. Initiation of Procurement, camp/Store/Office setup/ Management. 
Managing project team. Identifying the cause of delay and mitigating the same. Approval of sub-contractor bills, 
follow up with client for bill certification. 
 
As Civil Manager 
Responsible for Construction of New School block, Coordination with civil designer for timely delivery of civil 
document, Review of civil documents. Selection of civil works sub contractors, preparation of BOQ, floating of 
civil work enquire, evaluation of Offers and selection of civil contractor. Civil works planning and execution. 
Certification of sub contractor bills. 
 
As Sr Site Manager ( Civil ) 
1) Civil works for 400 KV and 132KV Substations (GIS) / Solar Plant Substations 
2) Civil works for pumping stations and pipeline including power supply. 
Independently handled the project site civil works. Responsible for Progress and Quality. Co-ordination with civil 
contractor, designer, client and consultant. Preparing weekly and monthly plan, Civil works supervision, major 
activity and Material Inspection. Maintaining all civil records like RFI, MRIR, MCC, Test results and other records 
as per PQP/ ITP. Involved in tendering of new Substation projects and via Site visit, Estimation of quantity based 
on tender drawing, and preparing BOQ. Preparing method of statement / monthly progress measurement 
sheet/RFI/MRIR/ MCC etc. Before submission reviewing of civil documents. Handling of civil documents in PIRS 
system. Preparation of Red mark drawings and review of As Build drawings. Initiation of FCR and NCR. 
Resolving and closing NCR issued by consultants. 
 
As Project Executive (Kolkata regional Office) 
1) MRSS and Transmission Line works at Bokaro Steel Plan and Durgapur Steel Plant ( SAIL ) 
2) 132KV Switchyard for DPCL & TATA and MRS for IGI Airport Delhi 
Responsible for the eastern regional civil works. Civil works cost input for tendering, post job award preparation 
of detail BOQ, floating of inquire for civil works, evaluation of civil works offer and selection of civil contractor. 
Coordination with civil designer and other discipline engineer for timely delivery of civil document. Civil works 
planning and execution from regional office. Coordination with client, consultants and project team. Civil contract 
administration. Review of extra works quantity and cost. Coordination with client for timely approval of documents 
and civil measurement approval. Pretender and post tender site visit for accessing risk involved in civil works. 
Administering of claims and Change Orders. 
 
As Site ENGINEER 
132/ 11 KV DEWA Substation(GIS) 
 
Independently handled the project responsible for Progress, Quality. Co-ordinate with Project office and Client 
(DEWA). Preparing weekly and monthly plan. Coordination with client for getting approval of civil activity. 
Arranging 3rd party inspection for major pours. Inspection of material and works based on specification and 
approved documents. Daily and weekly reporting to Project manager. Preparation and maintaining all civil works 
records like RFI, MRIR, Daily manpower reports and test reports. Progress monitoring based on the civil works 
plan and reporting the delays. Verification and finalizing of progress measurement, final bills and extra items of 
subcontractor. Maintaining all the civil records as per FQP. Involved in tendering of new Substation projects and 
Power Plant project via site visit, Estimation of quantity based on tender drawing, and preparing BOQ. 
comparison of sub contactors rate and market rate. 
L&T, PT&D (AFRICA OPERATION) SEP 2021 – MAR 2023 

SIEMENS Ltd, India May 1999 – June 2003 
VED Prakash Gupta, India Nov 1997- April 1999 
BHEL , India Nov 1996- Oct 1997
 
As Site ENGINEER 
132/ 11 KV Substation for KPTCL 
Independently handles the project responsible for Progress, Quality and Safety. Co-ordinate with head 
office and Client. Preparing weekly and monthly plan. Preparing monthly civil bills. Handling civil 
subcontractors and certifying monthly bills. Handling of site store (Steel cement, structures and electrical 
equipment etc.), Handling site cash and maintaining site accounts. Maintaining necessary site /store 
records as per FQP. 
As Site ENGINEER 
 Various 400, 220 and 132 KV Substations and Transmission Line for KPTCL, GRIDCO, SAIL 
1) Power Supply project for Ladle furnace 
2) Staff Quarters for GRIDCO 
Independently handled the project civil job responsible for Progress, Quality and Safety. Co-ordinate 
with head office and Client. Preparing weekly and monthly plan. Preparing Bill of Quantity for new 
project scope, evaluation of civil contractor and offer. Civil contract management via checking claims. 
Settlement of Extra Items and certification of claims. 
As Site Supervisor 
1) Various Projects for Bhilai Steel Plant 
2) 540 MW Power Plant, Bhilai 
Site Supervision and handling the Machine and Manpower. Responsible for site progress. Estimating 
the quantities of each item, market surveying and finalizing of sub vendors/ Suppliers. Preparing bills 
and co-ordination with client. Market rate analysis and quoting the tender. 
As Technical Apprentice 
1) 400KV and 132 KV Substation and cabling for SAIL Bhilai 
 
Independently handled the project civil job responsible for Progress, Quality and Safety. Co-ordinate 
with head office and Client. Preparing weekly and monthly plan. Preparing Bill of Quantity for new 
project scope, evaluation of civil contractor and offer. Civil contract management via checking claims. 
Settlement of Extra Items and certification of claims. 
Achievements 
 
 Independently managed all 5 projects civil works of Eastern region from Tendering to close out while working 
in SIEMENS. 
 Independently coordinated and completed civil works for 132KV Substation, Staff Quarters, MRSS and 
Pumping Station project including handling of civil documents in PIRS system and design coordination. 
 DEWA Approved Civil Engineer, Transco / ADDC approved Competent Person 
 TL line 80 KM inside National Forest Terrain and hilly terrine 
 
Trainings 
 
 Project Management and Planning training, ABB Site Management Certification Training 
 FQP & Material Handling workshop at ABB India. 
 Construction Safety Management 
 IOSH Managing Safety, 35 Hrs PMP Training 
 
Personal Details 
 
 
Marital status : Married 
Date of Birth : 19-Jan-1978 
Language Known : Hindi, English and Tamil 
Nationality : Indian 
Driving License : Valid UAE / India Driving license 
Passport No : V0642865 valid 24/08/2031 
References will be given upon request. 
 
ABB LTD, India July 2003- Jan 2004

To serve in a dynamic and growth oriented organization where I can make use of my knowledge as well as personal attributes to achieve organization goal and to revolve around learning and acquiring knowledge for the developing sustainable technologies for better environment management.

Hard working,

Location- Ranchi Project Office

Position Level- Project Level

Job Profile

Assist the PIUs in ensuring that all activities are in compliance with national/ state and ADB’s requirements,

Support respective PIU in the preparation of environmental monitoring reports.

Support respective PIU and the contractors in best environmental practices for responding to environmental issues involved with implementation of the projects on a sustainable basis.

Record findings in quarterly progress reports and submit to PMU for consolidation and submission to ADB. 

Assist the PIU in the preparation of Corrective Action Plan for closure of the Findings of the safeguards audit.

Environment and Social Screening report of Angada, Silli, Irba, Chainpur Grid sub station

Location: District Project Management Unit, RWSS-LIS (NNP), JSWSMS, Garhwa Jharkhand

Position Level: District Level

Job Profile

Ensure that all legal and regulatory provisions relevant to the environmental safeguards and World Bank safeguards policies are satisfactorily met through the project processes in each scheme and project villages.

Promote governmental bodies for NABL accreditation of state and district level water quality lab and water safety plan to implement in state level.

Ensure that environmental assessment is an integral part of planning and preparation of the proposed schemes of water supply and sanitation.

Report to the SPMU and the World Bank on Environment Management Framework/Plan (EMF/EMP) compliance progress as part of regular program reporting requirements. Support in the implementation of EMF/EMP for the projects.

Support in environmental sanitation activities as per the project design.

Support in implementing communication and capacity building activities relevant to environmental safeguards.

Support water quality program of project in terms of planning, capacity building, implementation, surveillance, monitoring and data analysis.

Timely submission of all relevant project progress reports, budget and utilization certificates

Support in other relevant tasks as assigned.

Organization- Drinking Water & Sanitation Department (DWSD), Govt of Jharkhand, Ranchi,

Designation: Lab Assistant

Location: State Level Water Testing Laboratory Ranchi, Jharkhand

Position Level: State Level

Job Profile

Ensuring laboratory compliance with ISO 17025 requirements.

Assisting the laboratory supervisor to meet the testing schedule

Supporting operations with regard to maintenance, allocation, and procurement to test equipment and laboratory supplies.

Preparation and oversight of any off-site testing necessary.

Preparing facilities, fixtures and documentation for customer testing.

Leading test failure analysis and reporting activities.

Providing engineering support on assigned projects.

3. From 01-Aug-2013 to 31-Aug-2015

Organization- Drinking Water & Sanitation Department (DWSD), Govt of Jharkhand, Ranchi,

Designation: Lab Analyst

Location: District Level Water Testing Laboratory Garhwa, Jharkhand

Position Level: District Level

Job Profile

Supervise, organize, and review the work of assigned staff involved in laboratory operations.

Establish schedules and methods for providing laboratory analysis and quality assurance program services; identify resource needs; review needs with appropriate management staff; allocate resources accordingly.

Supervise, prioritize, schedule and/or perform the collection and analysis of source water, potable water.

Wash, clean, sterilize, calibrate, and maintain equipment apparatus, and glassware used in all tests and analysis; keep laboratory facilities in a clean and orderly condition.

Operate and maintain a variety of lab equipment including but not limited to pH meter, analytical and top- loading balances, and field test kits.

Perform related duties as required.

4. From 08-11-2012 to 08-05-2013

Organization- Drinking Water & Sanitation Department (DWSD), Govt of Jharkhand, Ranchi,

Designation: Circle Coordinator. Location: Garhwa, Jharkhand Position Level: District Level

Job Profile

Operations, services, and activities of Training regarding Field Test Kit.

Principles of supervision, training, and performance evaluation.

Coordinate and direct the Training programme.

Collect water testing parameter data and online entry in IMIS portal.

COMPUTER SKILLS

MS-Office & Internet.

Hindi & English Typing.

Hardware and Software Installation.

HOBBIES

Listen Music.

Travelling.

Plantation.

TRAINING PARTICIPATION

Two day Awareness Training Program on ISO17025:2005 requirements conducted by “Anubrata Quality Management & Consultancy Services Private Limited”. Between 02 March to 03 March 2016.

Successful participation in the Hands-on Training on Testing of Analytical Parameters of Water Samples, conducted by ND International (NABL Accredited laboratory) in collaboration with ND Research & Survey Pvt. Ltd. Between 14th –18th April of 2016.

Participation in Water Quality Monitoring and Analysis sponsored by Ministry of Drinking Water and Sanitation, GOI, New Delhi held at CSIR-NEERI, Nagpur during March 21-24, 2017.

5 days Participation training on SUJAL & SWACHH GAON at VISHWA , Ranchi Jharkhand conducted by Ministry of Drinking Water & Sanitation Department.

1 month Participation training in solid waste management at A to Z waste management , Ranchi

1 month Participation training in water testing at Hatia Water treatment plant, Dhurwa.

1 Month participation training in Soil testing at Birsa Agriculture University, Ranchi.

Experience in Brief

 Have 38 years of rich experience in electrical utility/ consulting industry in both domestic and international projects focusing on feasibility studies, detailed project report, technical performance, techno-economic clearances, regulatory clearances, power system studies; design and engineering, budgeting, planning, scheduling, contracts and project management of super thermal of 2000 MW capacity /hydro power projects of 1200 MW capacity, 500 kV, 400 kV, 220 kV, 132 kV AC substation /transmission line/ HVDC project, EMS-SCADA/communication projects. Have executed Bulk Power Transmission Agreements (BPTA), Transmission Service Agreements, Implementation Agreements & Interconnection Agreements, Power Purchase Agreements. Carried out real time grid operation at Regional Load Dispatch Centre (RLDC) & synchronous operation of three regional grids. Formulated availability based tariff, short term, medium term& long term open access, bilateral power trading. Implemented two-part /three-part generation tariff, generation unit based & monthly fixed charged based transmission tariff as well as Point of Connection (POC) based tariff. Have also experience in financial closure, funding by domestic & international financial institutions namely Consortium of Indian Banks, World Bank, Asian Development Bank etc, loan agreement, equity infusion & loan disbursement and loan restructuring for power project. Extensively handled various petitions in State/Central Regulatory Commissions on generation/transmission tariff and dispute resolution between power utilities. 
 
 Have a strong understanding of the emerging power market in India and the region, including long term contracts for sale and purchase of electricity through the negotiated route as well as through competitive bidding, fuel availability and pricing issues and rules governing market operations with in-depth experience of three & half decades in the Indian electricity sector across the entire spectrum of ownership namely Public Sector, Public- Private Partnerships (PPPs) and the Private Sector. Have strong backround/ exposure on electricity regulatory affairs. 

Major Responsibilities
 
 Finalisation of Transmission Systems & Reactive Power
 Compensation associated with Farakka STPP, Kahalgaon STPP, Talcher 
 STPP, Vindhyachal STPP, Rihand STPP of 2000 MW capacity each 
 
 Design, engineering, project management, commissioning &

 Siliguri- Purnea, Purnea - Muzaffarpur, Muzaffarpur- Gorakhpur, 
 Gorakhpur- Lucknow, Bareilly- Mandola and 220 kV Muzaffarpur- 
 Muzaffarpur Double Circuit Transmission Lines
 
 Finalisation of Route Alignment and Detailed Survey of 220 kV 
 Budge Budge- Kasba and Subhasgram- Kasba double circuit transmission 
 lines

 Design, engineering, tendering, construction, project management 
 of 132 kV transmission lines associated with Manana II Hydro Electic 
 Project 
 
 Design & engineering of 400/ 220 kV Gorakhpur, Kaiga, Kankrauli, 
 Raibareilly and Pithoragarh substations

 Design & engineering of 275 kV transmission sysytems associated with 
 Liwagu Hydro Electric Projects in Malaysia 

 Design & engineering of 380/ 230 / 115/ 34.5 kV Arar, Hafar-Al-Batin, 
 Al-Jouf, Al-Harad and Al-Dahiah Substations in Saudi Arabia

 of 400 kV Quadripule Moose Double Circuit Transmission Lines in

Experience in Details 
 
 Transmission Planning and Design Studies 

 He has conducted numerous system studies on large scale interconnected 
 power system with installed generation capacity of 25000 MW, peak load 
 demand of 18000 MW, 6000 kilometers of 800 kV, ±500 kV DC, 400 kV, 220 
 kV,132 kV and 66 kV AC transmission systems:

Load flow studies for development of economical alternative of transmission requirements of a new generating station and sizing of grid transformer

 loading of generators, transformer tap changer requirement, sizing and 
 location of shunt reactor/ shunt capacitor under different contingent 
 operating conditions 

 * Transient stability and power swing studies for single phase and three phase 
 faults - insulator failure, conductor snapping, tower collapse, closing of 
 earth switch of energized feeder and thereby finalization of power 
 evacuation systems 

 * Steady state state, dynamic and transient stability studies to determine 
 size, location and characteristics of static var compensator and series 
 capacitor 

 * Studies for extinction of arc in circuit breaker during single phase auto 
 reclosing and thereby determination of size of neutral grounding reactor 

 * Short circuit studies for determination of network fault level under 
 different operating conditions 

 * Long Term Open Access for power transmission

+91-8800091691 / 011-41025237 

sbhatta212@gmail.com 

43-T, Sector-8, Jasola Vihar, New Delhi-110025 Subroto Bhattacharjee 

Versatile, result oriented engineering professional with extensive business background of over 3 decades

EXPERT IN: Contracts Administration & Claims Management | Contract Documentation & Correspondence| Contracts Variations/ Claims/ Conflicts |Project Management Expertise | Project Planning, Coordination & Monitoring | Tender Cost & Risk Assessment | Cost & Effort Estimation | Forecasting & Budgeting | Client/Consultant Liaison | Legal & Regulatory Compliance | Procurement & Cost Control | Material & Manpower Mobilization | Client & Stakeholder Management | Negotiation & Contract Finalization | Resource/Sub-Contractor Management | Site Visits & Supervision | Team Leadership | Training & Development | Vendor Management

Industrial Exposure: Power Transmission/ Distribution/ Generation Industry
History of association with well-known public & private sector undertakings namely like Power Grid Corporation of India Ltd., National Thermal Power Corporation Ltd., Reliance Infrastructure Ltd. and KEC International Ltd.
Experienced in procurement of capital goods for 400 /220 KV Extra High Voltage (EHV) AC and HVDC transmission lines and substation equipments 

Professional Overview 

Pioneering experience in providing professional engineering expertise to the business, translating the vision into actionable plans and implementing the same to overcome complex challenges thereby meeting the Business, Safety, Environmental, Financial and Operational objectives at minimum cost and in the safest manner. Efficiently handled global contracting process and prepared bidding document for 400 KV / 765 KV AC and HVDC transmission lines and substation equipment for the World Bank, Asian Development Bank & Domestic funded packages.

Expertise in managing all aspects of Contract Management (i.e. Tendering, Evaluation, Negotiation, placement of award and post award contract administration of Electrical and Telecom Equipments for Transmission line and Telecom projects); familiar with FIDIC, World Bank and ADB bidding documents
Delivering value-oriented decisions for project management including procurement, techno-commercial evaluation, scheduling and negotiating with the client for service level agreements / terms, conducting quality assurance and project progress monitoring as per quality, time and budgetary norms
Skilled in developing project schedule, monitoring project performance, performing project cost analysis, material take-off, managing real-time adjustments to projects/financial and leading performance review; excellence in conceptualizing and implementing supply strategies and purchasing directions, contingency plans and ensuring that plans are aligned with project requirements
A staunch believer of continuous improvement with an innate ability to identify, analyze, organize, and lead scalable operational development opportunities to flawlessly execute business vision, generate process enhancements, and influence and drive change to instill a powerful collaborative culture 

Professional Highlights

Major Capital Goods Procurement for Transmission Projects 

+ 500 KV 1500 MW Rihand - Delhi HVDC Terminal Package executed by ABB, Sweden under bilateral funding; the project cost of Indian Rupees 10 billions
+ 500 KV 2000 MW Talcher- Kolar HVDC Terminal Package executed by Siemens, Germany under Suppliers Credit funding; the Project cost of Indian Rupees 14 billions
+ 500 KV 500 MW Sasaram Talcher HVDC Terminal Package executed by Alstom, UK under World Bank funding; the Project cost of Indian Rupees 2.5 billions
Powergrid's Diversification into Telecommunication Project under World Bank funding; project cost of Indian Rupees 11 B
800 KV EHV Transmission Line and substation equipment for Kishenpur-Moga Transmission System under World Bank funding; the project cost of Indian Rupees 4 billions
765 KV Transmission Line and substation equipment for 765 KV Sipat Transmission System under Asian Development Bank funding; the project cost Indian Rupees 8 billions
+ 500 KV 2500 MW Balia-Bhiwadi HVDC Transmission System under the World Bank funding; the project cost was around Indian Rupees 30 billions

Work Experience

Since Jan 2012 till 31.12.2018 with KEC International Ltd., Gurgaon
As General Manager (Contracts Services) 
Directing Contracts Division for South Asia Business Unit stationed at Gurgaon and looking after the Contract & Claim Management with client and sub-contractors for all domestic projects including SAARC. 
Heading a team of seven contract administration professionals for controlling contract administration for various projects in south asia division.
Development and rolling out of contract management module for post award contract and claim management for project teams and pre-tender contractual risk analysis for tendering team.
Formulating contractual check list and procedures for implementation at various sites and engaging in standardisation of sub-contractor contract agreements and award letters for various activities like substation civil works, substation erection wors, Tower foundation, Tower erection and Transmission line stringing activities.
Developing and institutionalizing sub-contractor selection criteria based on technical and financial parameters for substation and transmission line sub-contractors.
Maintaining coordination with consultants, contractors and clients; undertaking Rate Analysis of cost schedule of rate items and extra items as per prevailing market prices
Preparing documents for invitation of bids for projects including specifications, finalisation of requirements & BOQ and handling negotiation, review and award of contracts as per contract regimes
Executing & evaluating the ongoing projects, interpreting contractual obligations/ rights and evaluating techno-financial problems followed by furnishing reports to the management

CURRICULUM VITAE 
 
Shivnandan Kumar Mahto 
E-Mail: shivnandankumarmahto@gmail.com 
 
Phone No: 7004510467, 9955449043 
 
 
CAREER OBJECTIVE 
Updating skills to deliver the best of my knowledge and professional work experience to the organization 
or place of work 
RESUME SUMMERY: 
More than 10 years of professional work experience in Civil Engineering (World Bank, AIIB & CTUIL) in the 
field of Power Transmission & Substation sector in Tamilnadu, Karnataka, Assam and Jharkhand state. 
 
JOB PROFILE 
 Project Management Consultant of Total Civil Work for Transmission Line & Sub-Station. 
 Civil Drawing study and approval for 765/400/220/132/33KV Substation and Transmission line. 
 Construction supervision and preparation of MIS. 
 Detailed supervision as per FQP for Transmission Line & Sub-Station. 
 Civil related documents verification like Cube Test Report, Construction Material & Source 
approval. 
 Preparing feasibility reports, for Sub-Station and Transmission lines etc. 
 Preparation of DPR, MPR supporting to project team. 
 As site in charge taking care of Planning, Scheduling. 
 Coordinating between clients, contractor, regional office for progress of project, conducting 
daily, weekly, and monthly meetings with client, contractor and executing staff at site and 
review with designer at HO for problems resolution. 
 Checking the erection plans material availability as per AFC Drawings and QAP. 
 Conducting site inspections. 
 Job supervision of 765/400/220/132/33 KV Transmission Line & Sub-Station of civil portions. 
Like Power Transformer & Reactor Foundation, equipment foundation, Tower foundation, RCC 
road Bitumen road, Retaining Wall and residential buildings. 
 Verification of Joint Measurement sheet for Substation and Transmission Line. 
 Project Billing- (Clint/Contractor/Sub Contractor) like Erection, supply, Freight and PV Bill. 
 Monitoring compliance of contractor’s legal requirements. 
 Site audit to check civil compliance status of contractors as per project required. 
 Plan and organize works of civil construction including employee enforcement of construction 
procedures. 
 Check the compliance of work permit with the work methods. 
 Deal with client and consultant in the purpose of their requirements. 
 Provided necessary help to work force in maintaining good housekeeping & proper waste 
disposal. 

 
 
EMPLOYMENT NARRATION: 
 
Present Company 
 
TATA CONSULTING ENGINEERS LIMITED. 
July 2023 – Till Working as Independent Engineer Civil, for consultancy service under 
Central Transmission Utility of India Ltd (CTUIL) where looking 765 KV Transmission 
lines (320 KM New Narendra GIS To Pune GIS) with 765 KV GIS at Vijayapura (Karnataka) & 
Pune (Maharashtra). 
 
PROJECT: - Engagement of Independent Engineer for transmission scheme under “ISTS 
Network Expansion scheme in Western Region & Southern Region for export of surplus power 
during high RE scenario in Southern Region” (Spec. No. CTUIL/IE/2022-23/05) 
 
OWNER: - Central Transmission Utility of India Limited (CTUIL) 
Developer/TSP:- WRSR POWER TRANSMISSION LIMITED 
 
About Tata Consulting Engineers Limited. 
 Tata Consulting Engineers Limited is India’s leading infrastructure services company with 
interests across various sectors like transportation, energy, and urban infrastructure. It 
provides consulting, engineering, project management, operations, and EPC services for new 
and existing projects. Client: CTUIL 
 
Previous Company 
 
FEEDBACK INFRA PVT. LTD. 
Jan 2020 – July 2023 – Worked as Assistant Manager Civil, for consultancy service under 
Jharkhand Urja Sancharan Nigam Ltd (JUSNL, Govt. of Jharkhand) and Assam 
Electricity Grid Corporation Ltd. (AEGCL, Govt. of Assam) where looking 132 KV 
Transmission lines (566.9 KM) with 132/33 KV sub-stations (12 No’s of new GSS and 4 No’s

CAREER OBJECTIVE

To work in challenging atmosphere, in which I will pay my attention and my ability for the advancement of the Organization and provides opportunity to me for learning & growth.

EDUCATIONAL QUALIFICATION

Completed PGDM-Executive in Operations Management from Institute of Management Technology, Ghaziabad in 2022.

Currently working in Jyoti Structures Ltd as Manager – Quality in Sterlite Power 400/220 KV Goa-Tamnar Transmission Project Ltd (GTTPL) in Goa & Karnataka since Nov 2022 till date.

Completed KPTCL’s 220/66KV GIS Substation & associated 220KV Transmission lines in Bengaluru, Karnataka from April 2021 – Nov 2022.

Previously successfully completed PGCIL’s 400KV Tumkur Pool (Pavagada)-Devanahalli Transmission Line from July 2019 – Mar 2021 & PGCIL’s 400 KV D/C Quad Edamon–Kochi Transmission Line from Feb 2018 – July 2019.

Worked in TATA PROJECTS LIMITED as an Engineer – Quality Services in PGCIL’s 765KV & 400 KV Power Transmission Lines from April 2017 to February 2018.

Worked in SMEC INDIA as Transmission Line Quality Engineer in 765KV & 400 KV Power Transmission Line (SEUPPTCL-ISOLUX BOOT) from June 2016 to April 2017.

Worked in MEGHA ENGINEERING & INFRASTRUCTURES LIMITED, Ghaziabad, Uttar Pradesh as a Project Engineer in 765 & 400 KV Power Transmission Line & Substation Construction (WUPPTCL-MEIL BOOT) from May-2011 to June-2016.

Job Profile:

Ability to study and understanding all types of Transmission line & Substation drawings, BOQ, drawing calculations. 

Monitoring of execution works w.r.t Quality requirements in all activities: Foundation, Erection and Stringing, pre- commissioning of Transmission Lines.

Excellent interface and Co-ordination skills with client & site team. 

Ability to check and clear vendors works on site in compliance with approved Drawing, Specification and BOQ.

Preparation of Daily Field Quality report, issuance of Non-Conformity Report (NCR), Quality Violation Memo & to ensure time closure of the same.

Analyze all products and non-conformance processes and evaluate all documents to ensure the maintenance of optimal quality and prepare monthly reports to evaluate performance.

Monthly MIS Report, Kaizens Implementation, 5S Audit.

Location wise Field Quality Dossier (Upon completion of project).

Maintaining all type of FQP records as per IS, Client specifications & SFQP.

Ensuring various source/brand approval for construction materials, inspection of inward materials & timely submission to third party testing agency for required test as per SFQP. 

Vendor Factory Inspections for approval of materials with respect to project requirements as part of FAT procedure.

Job Responsibilities:

Committed to achieve Zero Punch points, Zero Complaints from Customer.

Responsible for monitoring/checking Foundation, Erection & Stringing activities as per respective drawings to ensure proper & smooth execution. 

Responsible for inspection and clearances for all construction activities.

Quality Inspection & Quality assurance monitoring as per Technical Specification & Standardized Field Quality Plan (SFQP).

Conducting of day-to-day quality meetings with project team and contractors.

Preparation of all quality documents as per Field Quality Planning.

Interactions with various Vendors for quality clearance of Materials.

CURRICULUM VITAE

SAMEER GOEL 

 CAREER OBJECTIVE 

To work in challenging atmosphere, in which I will pay my attention and my ability for the advancement of the Organization and provides opportunity to me for learning & growth.

 EDUCATIONAL QUALIFICATION 

Completed PGDM-Executive in Operations Management from Institute of Management Technology, Ghaziabad in 2022.

Completed Bachelor of Technology in Electronics & Communication Engineering

from UTTAR PRADESH TECHNICAL UNIVERSITY, Lucknow in 2011.

Completed Class 12th from L.N. Public School (CBSE), Hapur, India in 2006.

Completed Class 10th from L.N. Public School (CBSE), Hapur, India in 2004.

 PROFESSIONAL EXPERIENCE 

Currently working in Jyoti Structures Ltd as Manager – Quality in Sterlite Power 400/220 KV Goa-Tamnar Transmission Project Ltd (GTTPL) in Goa & Karnataka since Nov 2022 till date.

Worked in KEC INTERNATIONAL LIMITED since Feb 2018 as Sr. Engineer Quality:

Completed KPTCL’s 220/66KV GIS Substation & associated 220KV Transmission lines in Bengaluru, Karnataka from April 2021 – Nov 2022.

Previously successfully completed PGCIL’s 400KV Tumkur Pool (Pavagada)- Devanahalli Transmission Line from July 2019 – Mar 2021 & PGCIL’s 400 KV D/C Quad Edamon–Kochi Transmission Line from Feb 2018 – July 2019.

Worked in TATA PROJECTS LIMITED as an Engineer – Quality Services in PGCIL’s

765KV & 400 KV Power Transmission Lines from April 2017 to February 2018.

Worked in SMEC INDIA (Part of Surbana-Jurong Group) as Transmission Line Quality Engineer in 765KV & 400 KV Power Transmission Line (SEUPPTCL-ISOLUX BOOT) from June 2016 to April 2017.

Worked in MEGHA ENGINEERING & INFRASTRUCTURES LIMITED, Ghaziabad, Uttar Pradesh as a Project Engineer in 765 & 400 KV Power Transmission Line Construction (WUPPTCL-MEIL BOOT) from May-2011 to June-2016.

Job Profile:

Ability to study and understanding all types of Transmission line & Substation drawings, BOQ, drawing calculations.

Monitoring of execution works w.r.t Quality requirements in all activities: Foundation, Erection and Stringing, pre- commissioning of Transmission Lines.

Excellent interface and Co-ordination skills with client & site team.

Ability to check and clear vendors works on site in compliance with approved Drawing, Specification and BOQ.

Preparation of Daily Field Quality report, issuance of Non-Conformity Report (NCR), Quality Violation Memo & to ensure time closure of the same.

Analyze all products and non-conformance processes and evaluate all documents to ensure the maintenance of optimal quality and prepare monthly reports to evaluate performance.

Monthly MIS Report, Kaizens Implementation, 5S Audit.

Location wise Field Quality Dossier (Upon completion of project).

Maintaining all type of FQP records as per IS, Client specifications & SFQP.

Ensuring various source/brand approval for construction materials, inspection of inward materials & timely submission to third party testing agency for required test as per SFQP.

Vendor Factory Inspections for approval of materials with respect to project requirements as part of FAT procedure.

Job Responsibilities:

Committed to achieve Zero Punch points, Zero Complaints from Customer.

Responsible for monitoring/checking Foundation, Erection & Stringing activities as per respective drawings to ensure proper & smooth execution.

Responsible for inspection and clearances for all construction activities.

Quality Inspection & Quality assurance monitoring as per Technical Specification & Standardized Field Quality Plan (SFQP).

Conducting of day-to-day quality meetings with project team and contractors.

Preparation of all quality documents as per Field Quality Planning.

Interactions with various Vendors for quality clearance of Materials.

 KEY SKILLS 

Quality Assurance, Quality Control, Project Operations & Management, Project Coordination, Quality Consultant

 TRAINING EXPERIENCE 

Witnessed 765 & 400 KV Tower Testing at L&T Tower Testing Facility, Chennai in 2012 as Engineer representing Megha Engineering & Infrastructures Limited.

 STRENGTHS 

Optimistic, Hardworking, Multitasking, Keep focus on task, Analytical, Good Learner

 PERSONAL DETAILS

Summary:

A dynamic professional with 12 plus years of rich experience in Project Planning, Management, Supply Bought Out items, Erection, Commissioning, and Man Management of Large Power Transmission line Supply and Turnkey Projects. Self-motivated with strong leadership, planning, organizational, and motivational skills. Capable of translating complex engineering concepts into actionable data and information. High on delivery focus, individual ownership, and accountability. Critical thinker for complex business strategies with new opportunities.

At-Kishore Chandra Palli Po-Jagamohan

Job Profile

GUPTA POWER INFRASTRUCTURE LIMITED- June 2020 to till date

PROJECT- SUPPLY, ERECTION AND COMMISION OF 132 KV D/C LINE FROM 132/33 KV CHANDBALI GRID TO 220/132/33 KV GRID DHAMARA, ODISHA.

Client: Odisha Power Transmission corporation Limited

TotalLength:27.373 KM

Position/Designation as per Company Profile :Asst.Manager(Projects) Responsibilities

Initiation of project.

Contribute in preparing project charters.

Preparation of Zero Cost Budget (ZBC), Revenue plan, Project Completion schedule, Identification of resources.

Setting of project execution plan based on scope, requirement, activities and resource

scheduling.

Mobilization of Sub-contractor for each activity.

Submitting and obtaining approvals from client such as land schedule, tower schedule, foundation drawings, railway crossing, PTCC etc.

Monitor and control direct Project work. Manage project development phases from beginning to end.

Preparation of Measurement sheet, Variation Order, amendment of BOQ, Certification of sub-contractor invoices.

Efficiently deal with commercial (Billing, AB & MB passing from Regional Office etc.) and store activity.

Deal with client related to all technical issues.

Ensure proper Utilization of Asset.

Preparation Conductor & OPGW drum Schedule.

Preparation of Bar Bending Schedule (BBS).

GUPTA POWER INRASTRUCTURE LIMITED-December 2019 to May 2020

UPGRADATION OF EXISTING ACSR PANTHER CONDUCTOR BY HTLS CONDUCTOR IN EHT LINES O OPTCL (132 KV MENDHASAL- KHURDHA S/C AND JODA-BARBIL S/C)

Client:Odisha Power Transmission corporation Limited

Total Length:17km(OHTL)+19km(OHTL)

Position/Designation as per Company Profile: Assistant Manager(Projects)

Responsibilities

Preparation of Walk over Survey of this particular Project.

Initiation of project.

Co-coordinating with different department manager for preparing operational control procedures.

Mobilization of Sub-contractor for each activity.

Handling the site team and monitoring the execution of Site Activity.

Preparation of Measurement Sheet and Certification of sub-contractor invoices.

Attending meeting with client.

Planning for shutdown, reconductoring and hand over of dismantled materials.

Witness of quality during preparation of midspan joint and dead end fittings.

Assured carefully handling of HTLS conductor.

GUPTA POWER INRASTRUCTURE LIMITED-January 2017 to November 2019

SUPPLY, ERECTION AND COMMISION OF 132 KV D/C LINE FROM 220/132/33 KV BHADRAK GRID TO 132/33 KV GRID ANANDAPUR WITH CONSTRUCTION OF 02 NOS ASSOCIATED BAYS AT BOTH END, ODISHA.

Client:Odisha Power Transmission corporation Limited

Total Length:43 KM

Position/Designation as per Company Profile :SR.ENGINEER(Projects)

Role in the project: Project Management

Responsibilities

Engaging the subcontractors/local parties to operate a risk-free business.

Managing relationships with third party developers and co-developers.

Checking and inspecting for the finalization of the route survey for preparing the final tower spotting details and finalizing the tree cutting buffers.

Reviewing of the plans and profiles w.r.t the actual site situation to develop accurate surveying data for the execution of the transmission line.

Checking and finalization of construction drawings and design details.

Planning and executing the project through optimum utilization of the equipment and manpower to reduce the execution cost without compromise the QA/QC & EHS of the construction process.

Update Project Status by monitoring WPR,DPR and Field technical inquiries

Monitoring construction of Foundation, Erection & Stringing with zero LTI. Efficiently deal with commercial (Billing, AB, and MB Passing from Regional Office etc.)And store activity.

Carrying out the substation civil works such as various equipment foundations, erection, bus-bar stringing, cable trench, cable laying and termination, fencing and earth-mat etc.

Carrying out the project (including its civil works) as per the client Standard.

Successfully testing and commissioning as per the requirement of the project technical specification /client/ consultant for energizing the lines.

Carrying out site stabilization, mitigation measures, and all kinds of punch-list closures as per the requirement of the Project Technical Specification.

GUPTA POWER INRASTRUCTURE LIMITED- July 2013toDecember2016

SUPPLY,ERECTION AND COMMISION OF 132 KV D/C LINE FROM 132/33 KV PATNAGARH GRID TO 132/33 KV GRID PADAMPUR,ODISHA.

Client: Odisha Power Transmission corporation Limited

Consultant: Power Grid Corporation of India Limited

Total Length:47km(OHTL)

Position/Designation as per Company Profile: Sr. Engineer

Responsibilities

Started the execution of Project.

Participate in survey, tower spotting and pit marking.

Ensure Template fixing, steel binding quality, concrete quality during foundation casting.

Checking of tower erection and conductor rough sag and final tension.

Update Project Status by monitoring WPR,DPR and Field technical inquiries

Monitoring construction of Foundation, Erection & Stringing with zero LTI. Efficiently deal with commercial (Billing, AB,MB & Passing from Regional Office etc.) and store activity.

Maintaining the hindrance register for project extension purpose.

Deal with Power Grid Corporation Industries Ltd. & Odisha Power Transmission Corporation Limited related to all technical issues.

Ensure proper Utilization of Asset.

GUPTA POWER INRASTRUCTURE LIMITED- February 2009 to July 2013

Project: Rajiv Gandhi Grameen VidyutKaran Yojana

Project Location : Kandhamal,Odisha

Client: Orissa small Industries Corporation

Consultancy–National Hydroelectric Power Corporation (NHPC)

Position: Site Engineer

Responsibilities

Site Engineer of the project where I used to Schedule the day-to-day Erection & Stringing activity.

Survey, erection and commission of HT lines, LT lines and Distribution Transformers with stringing of conductor and A.B Cables.

Provide Project Status updates by continuously monitoring WPR, DPR & Field Technical

Inquiries etc.

Arrange sub-contractor and gangs as per progress requirement.

Ensure gang outputs for Erection and Stringing by monitoring ‘gang productivity’.

Create check list for Erection & Stringing Activity etc.

Create Joint Measurement Certificate (JMC) of Erection and Stringing.

Preparation of bill of quantity (BOQ) for the surveyed line.

Preparation of final amendment of the project with client.

Augmentation of 33/11 kV Substation.

Final Reconciliation of material.

Degree : Bachelor of Technology

Indian School Certificate (12th Standard) Institute/University : C.H.S.E Board,Odisha Discipline : Science

Year of completion 2003

MS Office(Word,Excel,Powerpoint)

I hereby declare that all the statements made above are true with best of my knowledge and belief. If any statement being found false or incorrect, my candidature or appointment may be cancelled.

candidates.rawText:
SMRUTI SAGAR SWAIN

An enthusiastic & high energy driven professional targeting challenging assignments in Project Management/RE/EPC with a reputed organisation in the Electrical industry

Location Preference: Anywhere in India

Profile

Summary

A goal-oriented professional with nearly 10 years of experience in Switchyard & Transmission line construction /Project Management in the Electrical industry

Presently associated with EMPHORIA WORKS PVT LTD as Project manager in JSW , 132 Kv DC line project barbil

Comprehensive knowledge of Switchyard Operations and maintenance

Exposure in planning, executing as well as leading site engineering, installation and commissioning projects in compliance with quality standards 

Recognised for developing defected parts in-house and decreasing maintenance & manufacturing cost with less wear & tear to reduce over times & less breakdown 

Received Best Engineer for successfully completing the project 132KV DC line from Kuchei to Jaleswar, & 132/33KV S/S and DC line at chikiti under Orissa Power Transmission And Corporation Limited.

An enterprising leader with proven expertise in leading and directing the personnel towards the accomplishment of a common goal

Proficient in maintaining the flow of work among departments & resolving departmental conflicts

CORE COMPETENCIES

Construction ,Erection, Stringing , Testing & Commissioning 

Project Management 

Contract Management 

Cost Control 

Operations & Maintenance

ORGANIZATIONAL EXPERIENCE

EMPHORIA WORKS PVT LTD OCTOBER 2021- PRESENT

ASSISTANT GENERAL MANAGER

Working in 132 Kv DC JSW project Barbil under Odisha Power Transmission & corporation LTD. Odisha.

KEY RESULT AREAS:

 Professional Synopsis

all the equipment's to ensure its run under safe and systematic working condition. 
 
 Planning & implementing the preventive & breakdown maintenance schedules for improving overall 
reliability and safety.

 Supervising and monitoring all the project related activities.

controlled manner.

• Testing, commissioning, peration and Maintenance of 220/66 KV GIS & 132/33 KV S/S

major equipment's suppliers.

• Planning of shutdown work & execution within time limit and with proper manpower 
handling.

 Preparing & maintaining documents related to Engineering Dept, IMS, BCMS and attending Audits. 
 
 Material Management, Material Indenting & PM activities (MM & PM Module) through SAP. 
 
 Responsible for Providing the Utility to the Production Units on Time. 
 
 Effective implementation of various Standard Operating Processes (SOP). 
 
 Analyzing and rectification of Troubleshooting and Problems in Power Circuit and Control Circuit. 
 
 Familiar with Relays-MI COM P444, 7SD61, P543, 7SA61, PCM 600. 
 
 Operation, Maintenance and troubleshooting of Utility equipment's like CT Pump, Compressor, Soft 
Starter and CT Fan. 
 
 Following and Monitoring Safety Procedures such as 5S, PTW, JSA, SRFA, VSA and HIRA. 
 
 
 
 
 
 

The Key Deliverables -Testing 
 
 In process & Final Testing of Power & Distribution Transformers of rating 50 to 125,000 KVA, 
220/66 KV class. 
 In process & Final Testing of Protection & metering CT, PT, CB, LA, CVT. 
 Battery Capacity Test, Earthing System Adequacy. 
 Co-ordinate with Third party inspection agency. 
 Maintaining required project wise test and inspection reports in line with approved QAP.

 H.S.C, 2009

 S.S.C, 2007

Training’s 
 
 Completed training on “Testing of Outdoor Equipment’s” by Hitachi-ABB 
 
 Completed training in Advance Excel conducted by Adani Transmission Limited. 
 
 
 Completed various behavioral training conducted by Adani Transmission Limited. 
 
 
 
 
 
Accolades

 Achieved Par-Excellent award for Quality Circle case study Presentation by our team “IGNITER” on

Career Objectives:
A self motivated Remote Sensing Professional with project handling/managing skills for efficient and quality oriented project execution. Intend to build a career with committed and dedicated people who will realize my potential, enhance my skill, make the most effective and use of my knowledge. I am interested in studies of Environmental aspects of various natural processes using GIS and Remote Sensing techniques.

RESUME

 Managing new, retrofitting projects and had overcome key challenges such as commissioning before 
deadline, planning of required materials, manpower management. 
 
 
2. Operation & Maintenance works :- 
 
 Planning and effecting predictive & preventive maintenance schedules for various equipment / lines to 
increase machine up-time & equipment reliability 
 Implementing maintenance schedules and performing periodic checks to ensure performance of various 
equipment and maintaining requisite documents for the same 
 Coordinating with maintenance of equipment for smooth functioning of operations 
 Operating rolling line equipment as per the work standards & monitoring the same 
 Conducting failure investigation analysis to identify gaps and taking corrective measures so as to reduce 
equipment downtime & maximize plant availability 
 Allocating equipment, managing breakdown, scheduling & planning of maintenance and coordinating with 
other Service Department 
 Monitoring the productivity plan and ensuring completion of productivity targets 
 Anchoring the erection and commissioning of the equipment; conducting tests & inspections to ensure 
operational effectiveness of equipment 
 Reviewing engineering drawings, layouts, diagrams, technical specifications and cost estimates for erection & 
commissioning of the plant; performing overhauling work of equipment, modifications, and major repairs to 
improve equipment efficiency by fault-finding

Dear Mr. Amar Sha 
 
Greetings! 
 
Further to your interview and subsequent discussions, we are pleased confirm your 
appointment in VSPL Energy Pvt. Ltd (‘VSPL’ or the Company) . Your 
joining date is being taken in our records as Wednesday, 1st November, 2017. 
 
Further details of the assignment including terms & conditions and compensation have 
already been shared with you and are also attached as Annexure “A” and “B” respectively. 
 
We welcome you to the VSPL Family and wish you success in your career with us. 
 
Thanking you, 
 
Yours sincerely, 
 
Anuja Sinha 
Head –HR 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
Encl. Annexure A, B 
as 'Trainee Engineer'

 
Annexure “A” 
SERVICE TERMS AND CONDITIONS 
 
The terms and conditions of your appointment will be as mentioned hereunder: 
 
1. Date & Place of work 
 
Your date of joining in our records is Wednesday, 1st Nov 2017. Your place of joining is Patna. 
You would however be required to work and travel to all places / sites where VSPL has ongoing 
projects or may acquire projects in future. 
 
2. Salary 
 
Your Gross Annual Salary would be Rs. 1,80,000/ per annum (Rupees one Lac Eighty Thousand 
Per Annum Only) , as per detailed break-up given below. Your Salary shall be subject to Income 
tax as per the provisions of the Income Tax Act 1961. 
 
You are required to maintain strict confidentiality of your compensation details. 
 
3. Work Responsibilities 
• Complete In-charge of The Project Store in terms of all incoming and outgoing of project 
material. Issuance of material based on approved requisition. 
• Prepare all necessary MIS as per schedule. 
• Coordinate with the Project Team in regards to their material requirement. 
• Prepare total requirement keeping in mind the delivery time keeping in mind the project 
deadlines. 
• Report to the Project Head / In-charge with final tally of all materials. 
 
4. Medical fitness 
 
You are required to declare that your existing health condition or past medical history does not in 
any manner render you unfit for the role being offered to you. In the event of any deviation from 
this, the Company reserves the right to get you medically examined by a medical practitioner 
nominated by the Company either at the time of joining or during the course of the contract and 
your further engagement may depend on your being found fit. 
 
 
5. Travel 
 
Your services may be transferred from one job or location to another depending on needs of the 
Company. In such event, you may be required to be governed by the policies applicable to the 
establishment to which you are transferred. During the course of employment you may be 
required to undertake business travel. 
 
6. Leave 
 
You shall be entitled to leave as per existing Leave policy of the Company. All leaves of absence 
shall require prior sanction of the concerned authority. In case of leave taken for unforeseen 
circumstances for which prior approval is not possible, immediate information shall be required to 
be sent to the sanctioning authority. In the event of failure to do so, Company shall have the right 
to take disciplinary action against you as deemed necessary. 
 

In case you absent yourself from office continuously for 7 days or more without prior sanction, you 
may be deemed to have relinquished your contract with the Company. In such case, the 
Company reserves the right to take disciplinary action as necessary. 
 
7. Probation 
 
You shall be on probation for a period of six months from the date of commencement of your 
duties. Subject to your performance during this period, the Company will either confirm you, or 
take a decision to extend your probation period. On completion of probation, your services will be 
deemed as confirmed unless intimated otherwise of an extension of probation. During probation 
period, you will not be entitled to any leave. During the probation period or extended probation 
period, this appointment can be terminated by either party by giving 7 (seven) days notice or 7 
(seven) days salary in lieu of it. 
 
8. Performance Appraisal 
 
Your next performance appraisal will be covered in November 2018 in accordance with the policy 
of the Company. 
 
9. Separation 
 
During the employment with us, either party may terminate the service by giving one-month notice 
in writing or one-month salary in lieu thereof. The Company reserves the right to terminate your 
service without any compensation or notice thereof, if you are found to be in moral breach of your 
responsibilities and/or following a code of conduct not in line with the Company’s standards of 
conduct. 
 
 
10. Retirement 
 
Your age of retirement will be 58 years and you shall stand relived on retirement at the end of the 
month in which you attain the age of 58 years. 
 
 
 
11. Other Details 
 
- You will conform to all rules and regulations in force from time to time in the Company. 
 
- The Company believes on the representations made by you as true and correct. The 
Company reserves the right to conduct your reference check at any point before or after your 
joining. 
 
- During the period of your employment, you will devote your whole time exclusively for the 
work as may be assigned to you by the Company from time to time. Also, you will not engage 
yourself in any business/profession, part-time work or employment either directly or otherwise 
without written permission of the management. 
 
- During the period of your employment with us or thereafter, you will not divulge to any third 
party or use against the interest of the Company, any information, data or documents that 
may come to your knowledge. 
 
- You shall promptly upon request by the Company and in any other event upon termination of 
your employment, deliver to the Company all correspondence and other documents, paper 
and records in whatever form including and not limited to the electronically held data 
containing of referring to any trade secret or confidential information concerning the business 
of the Company and any Group Company which may have been prepared by you or came to 

your possession, custody or control in the course of your employment including any prior 
employment with any Group Company. 
 
- You will not start directly or indirectly through any of your relatives any business, which is in 
direct competition with VSPL.

The terms and conditions of your appointment will be as mentioned hereunder:
1. Date & Place of work
Your date of joining in our records is Wednesday, 1st Nov 2017. Your place of joining is Patna.
You would however be required to work and travel to all places / sites where VSPL has ongoing
projects or may acquire projects in future.
2. Salary
Your Gross Annual Salary would be Rs. 1,80,000/ per annum (Rupees one Lac Eighty Thousand
Per Annum Only) , as per detailed break-up given below. Your Salary shall be subject to Income
tax as per the provisions of the Income Tax Act 1961.
You are required to maintain strict confidentiality of your compensation details.
3. Work Responsibilities
Complete In-charge of The Project Store in terms of all incoming and outgoing of project
material. Issuance of material based on approved requisition.
Prepare all necessary MIS as per schedule.
Coordinate with the Project Team in regards to their material requirement.
Prepare total requirement keeping in mind the delivery time keeping in mind the project
deadlines.
Report to the Project Head / In-charge with final tally of all materials.
4. Medical fitness
You are required to declare that your existing health condition or past medical history does not in
any manner render you unfit for the role being offered to you. In the event of any deviation from
this, the Company reserves the right to get you medically examined by a medical practitioner
nominated by the Company either at the time of joining or during the course of the contract and
your further engagement may depend on your being found fit.
5. Travel
Your services may be transferred from one job or location to another depending on needs of the
Company. In such event, you may be required to be governed by the policies applicable to the
establishment to which you are transferred. During the course of employment you may be
required to undertake business travel.
6. Leave
You shall be entitled to leave as per existing Leave policy of the Company. All leaves of absence
shall require prior sanction of the concerned authority. In case of leave taken for unforeseen
circumstances for which prior approval is not possible, immediate information shall be required to
be sent to the sanctioning authority. In the event of failure to do so, Company shall have the right
to take disciplinary action against you as deemed necessary.
In case you absent yourself from office continuously for 7 days or more without prior sanction, you
may be deemed to have relinquished your contract with the Company. In such case, the
Company reserves the right to take disciplinary action as necessary.
7. Probation
You shall be on probation for a period of six months from the date of commencement of your
duties. Subject to your performance during this period, the Company will either confirm you, or
take a decision to extend your probation period. On completion of probation, your services will be
deemed as confirmed unless intimated otherwise of an extension of probation. During probation
period, you will not be entitled to any leave. During the probation period or extended probation
period, this appointment can be terminated by either party by giving 7 (seven) days notice or 7
(seven) days salary in lieu of it.
8. Performance Appraisal
Your next performance appraisal will be covered in November 2018 in accordance with the policy
of the Company.
9. Separation
During the employment with us, either party may terminate the service by giving one-month notice
in writing or one-month salary in lieu thereof. The Company reserves the right to terminate your
service without any compensation or notice thereof, if you are found to be in moral breach of your
responsibilities and/or following a code of conduct not in line with the Company s standards of
conduct.
10. Retirement
Your age of retirement will be 58 years and you shall stand relived on retirement at the end of the
month in which you attain the age of 58 years.

- The Company believes on the representations made by you as true and correct. The
Company reserves the right to conduct your reference check at any point before or after your
joining.

work as may be assigned to you by the Company from time to time. Also, you will not engage
yourself in any business/profession, part-time work or employment either directly or otherwise
without written permission of the management.

party or use against the interest of the Company, any information, data or documents that
may come to your knowledge.

your employment, deliver to the Company all correspondence and other documents, paper

Monitoring project progress and creating project status reports for project managers and stakeholders
to streamline project efficiency and maximize deliverable outputs.

Analyzing all suppliers in order to select the most suitable suppliers who are able to deliver high quality

Coordinating with vendors for required Quotations/documents/drawings/design for approvals.

candidates.rawText:
Name : Y. K. SEHGAL

DOB : 29.04.1957

Educational/ professional qualification (along with the name of Institutions)

B.Sc(Engg) in Electrical Engineering, Delhi College of Engineering, Passed out in 1979

Nature of Experience (1)

Vast experience in various facets of Strategic Planning for overall development of power sector in general and transmission sector in particular

Developed the plan for national grid for scheme to achieve a target of 1,00,000 MW inter-regional capacity by 2016-17. These led to integration of NER, ER, WR and NR into one grid. This made the transfer of power more flexible and promoted trading of power from one corner of the country to the other.

Planning, development and implementation of high capacity Green Energy corridor 1 and Green Energy Corridor 2 for integration of Solar and Wind generation in the state of Tamil nadu, Gujarat, Rajasthan, Andhra pradesh , Maharashtra and Karnatka 

Planning & design studies for evaluation of techno-economical transmission systems for the entire capacity addition in the central sector and IPPs connected to ISTS.

Preparation of feasibility and detail project report including cost estimate for different transmission system involving high capacity AC lines and substaions. 

Contributed in efficient operation of transmission network and its high availability by active involvement in

Grid Operation Congestion Analysis

High Voltage and Under Voltage Analysis and remedial measures

Remedial measures for voltage and current unbalances on different phases

Voltage induction on de-energized circuits and means to control so as to perform maintenance works

Replacement of Circuit breaks with higher short circuit ratings to cater to increased fault levels under R&M policy

Switching Problems of 400kV Bus reactors & Swichable Line Reactors, Re-Setting of Distance Protection relays due to modified configuration of network on account of Series Compensation, System growth etc.

Relay Protection Setting of Transmissions Lines and Transformers.

Responsible for providing vital inputs for charging of new transmission networks

Reponsible for granting of Connectivity, Medium Term Open Access and Long Term Access to ISTS

Actively involved in implementation of smart grid

Actively involved in monitoring of pre-award implementation and corporate level management of all transmission schemes through close interaction with Region and Management.

Interaction with govt. departments/agencies , co-ordination with generating agencies for matching implementation of associated transmission system.

Coordination with CEA, Ministry of Power, STUs and other stakeholders for development and O&M related issues of transmission network.

Active participation in energy cooperation initiatives between India and neighboring countries like Nepal, Bhutan, Bangladesh, Pakistan, Afghanistan, Myanmar, Sri Lanka, etc.

Participated in meetings of BIMSTEC countries regarding harmonization of Grid Standards, formulation of Grid-interconnection Master Plan, drafting of MOU for implementation of Regional Power Trade Operating Agreement and establishment of BIMSTEC center of energy.

Provided inputs for tariff regulations, formulation of Indian Electricity Grid Code, Grid Standards, Open Access Regulations and Procedure.

Responsible for providing vital inputs for charging of new transmission networks

Responsible for granting of Long Term Access, Medium Term open access to ISTS system of CTU

Actively involved in implementation of smart grid

Co-ordination and interaction with different agencies related with power sector viz. MOP, CEA, CERC,SERCs,SEB, and IPPs for settlement of various transmission system related issues.

Actively associated with initiatives taken towards planning of interlinks and energy cooperation between India and neighbouring countries like Nepal, Bhutan, Bangladesh, Pakistan, Afghanistan, Myanmar, Sri Lanka, Thailand etc.

.

Actively involved in formulation of open Access regulations, sharing regulations, tariff regulations, formulation of Indian Electricity Grid Code, Grid Standards, Open Access Regulations Procedures. 

Involved in evolving POC mechanism for sharing regulation and also its amendment in 2016.

Preparation and analysis of report for PSDF funding of NER – Agra High capacity HVDC link on the direction of CERC.

PUBLICATIONS

1. “Development of 1200kV Transmission System in India”, International Conf. for Development of 1200kV UHV AC Technology in India, 2010

2. “Planning and design studies for +800kV, 6000 MW HVDC system” CIGRE, Paris, 2008

3. “Testing of TCSC Damping Controller installed in a Tie Line Interconnecting Two Large Areas – A Case Study”, CIGRE, Paris 2006.

4. “Optimisation of Neutral Grounding Reactor Parameters – An Analysis for a Double circuit EHV line” IEEE Power India Conference, 2006.

5. “EHV Transmission Line Capacity Enhancement through increase in Surge Impedance Loading Level” IEEE Power India Conference, 2006.

6. “AC/DC Interaction in Multi-infeed HVDC scheme: A case Study” IEEE Power India Conference 2006.

7 “Change in Approach to Planning and Operation of Power Systems under Open Access Regime – Indian Experience” – St. Petersburg Power Tech’2005 Russia

8. “Application of FACTS Devices in Indian Power System”, CIGRE Colloquium Bangalore, 2005.

9. “Radical Performance Improvement – A Road map through technological innovation”. Power HP Forum, India 2005.

10. “Series capacitor project for 420kV Raipur-Fourkela line” Capacit 2005, IEEMA Conference, 2005.

11. “Series compensation on 400kV Transmission line – A few design aspects, 13th National Power System conference, Chennai, 2004.

12. “Application of emerging technologies for the development of Indian Power System, 19th World Energy Congress, Sydney, 2004.

13. “765kV system of Sipat power project in India”, International conference on Power System, Kathmandu, 2004.

14. “Emerging technologies and IT application in future Indian Power System”, International conference on IT application in Power System, India, 2003.

15. “Search for Optimal Technological Option for Power System Expansion in India – A Great Challenge”, CIGRE Symposium, Malaysia, 1999

 Experience in Commercial and Business Development Activities. Responsible for policy advocacy related to Ministry of POWER, CEA and CERC. Coordination with Ministry of POWER, MNRE, CEA, CTU , State utilities and CERC for new policies/ regulations suitable for new Energy transition Regime of Green Power. Coordination and interaction with different Central bidding agencies like SECI , NTPC and States. 

 Coordination with MOP and CEA and CERC for storage policy, regulations suitable for Electric storage and addressing issues for making viable the Electric storage in the country.

Page 1 of 3 
RAJESH KUMAR BANSAL, PMP 
 
Present Location : GE Gas Power Systems, Noida, India 
Contact No : +91 9313585161 
SSO ID : 212719630 
Email : rajesh.bansal@ge.com 
 
 
A. Profile 
 Seasoned Project Management, Planning and Controls professional 
having Project Management Professional (PMP) Certification from PMI, 
USA since 2005, having over 25+ years of domestic and international 
experience in Power Sector - Gas, Coal and Renewable. 
 Certified Trainer on Primavera (P6) Project Planning and Scheduling 
software by Primavera Systems Inc. USA, now Oracle Inc., since 2003. 
 Presently working with GE in Gas Power as Senior Project Planning 
Manager at Noida, India since August 2018 (4 years) within ITO/COE 
Scheduling Organization under Vinod Mittal. 
B. Functions / Skills 
 Multi facet working exposure with Owner Group, with EPC Contractor, and 
with External Project Management Consultants. 
 Worked with Reliance Power – Project Planning, Scheduling and Controls 
during 2004 to 2011 in Central Planning / PMO office, wherein role was to 
Define, Implement and Enforcement of Planning Systems and Procedures 
across all projects, Define Progress Measurement System including S-
Curve for E, P, and C and Conduct System Audits periodically. 
 Managed - (Planning, Scheduling, Controlling and Project Management, 
Cost control, Budgets, Reports, MIS) over 22 Solar Farm projects with 
combined capacity of 415 MW spread across India during 2011 to 2016. 
 EPC business - Projects Head for an Indian Multinational company in 
West Africa (Nigeria) stationed during 2016 to 2017. 
 Prior to GE, in my last organization, I worked as Project Manager for a 85 
MW Solar PV Project, stationed at Morocco during 2017 to 2018. 
C. Present Employer 
 Working with GE Gas Power Systems at Noida from August 2018 till date 
D. Roles and Responsibilities 
 Working as ITO Scheduler supporting all kinds of bid formats EO, EEP, 
TKP and TKSI covering Europe, Middle East, APAC and Latin America 
region. 
 Dolna Odra - Poland, Ostiglia - Italy, Ostroleka - Poland, Mulla Abdulla - 
Iraq, EDRA – Bangladesh, EnBW Heilbron and Altbach - Germany etc. 
are few of the important bids. 
 In addition, I also helped PMLPs / new comer to learn P6. 
 Contributed development of Standard Templates for ITO L1 schedule. 

Page 2 of 3 
 Prepare Cash Flow Curves based on Should Cost for Partner scope of 
work in the early stage to support deal team. 
 Finalization of Project terminal points, Interfaces and setting of milestones 
and major activities in order to use all the information as contract during 
project execution stage. 
 
 Ensure the established project execution policies and processes are 
consistently implemented. 
 Preparation of Customer (External) schedule and Consortium (Internal) L1 
schedule as per contract agreement. 
E. Previous Employers 
 Present-1 
 Worked with Sterling and Wilson, an Indian EPC Power company for their 
International Renewable group at Morocco, as Project Manager for a 85 
MW Solar PV project 
 Responsible for timely, safely and quality delivery of project within limited 
resources, controlled budget and available cash flow by effective project 
management, detailed time planning and effective sub contractor and 
people management. 
 Reporting to Director Projects 
 Present-2 
 Worked with Skipper Nigeria Limited – an Indian multinational Power 
company at Lagos, Nigeria in Leadership position as Head of Projects in 
the West African region 
 Head – SBU, responsible for Top Line and Bottom Line, timely and quality 
delivery of projects within limited resources, controlled budget and 
available cash flow by effective project management, detailed time 
planning and execution budget. 
 Managing, Planning, Controlling Execution of over 6 different Project Sites 
spread across Nigeria with a combined EPC value of over 155 MUSD 
o EPC of 1x2 MW + 1x8 MW TIGA Hydro Electric Project in the 
Kano State with EPC value of 25 MUSD 
o EPC of 2x12.5 MW Challawa Hydro Electric Project in the Kano 
State with EPC value of 62.5 MUSD 
o EPC of 132 kV Double Circuit line for 350 km in the State of Yola 
with EPC value of 40 MUSD 
o EPC of 2x60 MVA, 132/33 kV Sub-Station project in the State of 
Kaduna with EPC value of 13.5 MUSD 
o EPC of 2x60 MVA, 132/33 kV Sub-Station project in the State of 
Abeokuta with EPC value of 11 MUSD 
o EPC of 2x65 MVA, 15/132 kV Sub-Station project for Lafarge 
Cement Plant in the State of Lagos with EPC value of 3.77 MUSD 
 Reporting to SkipperSeil Group Chairman. 

Page 3 of 3 
 Present-3 
 Worked with Hindustan Power Limited (formerly Moser Baer Clean 
Energy Limited) at Okhla, New Delhi as Associate Vice President – 
Project Management, Planning, Scheduling and Controls of Renewable 
Business
