Mukesh Khanna

 

Executive Director (Retired on 30/04/2024), Power Grid Corporation of India Ltd

Held Executive leadership position with a Maharatna PSU and World’s 3rd largest Transmission Company

PROFESSIONAL PROFILE

Seasoned Transmission & Power Sector expert with more than 32 years of extensive experience and demonstrated history in Transmission Planning for National Grid, Renewable generation, development of regulatory regime including connectivity/LTA/GNA for conventional as well as renewable generation, Commercial, Regulatory, Policy, Legal, Contractual, Sectoral Reforms, Business Strategy & Development and Project Management side in Transmission Sector. Structured, negotiated and executed numerous partnership agreements. Effectiveness demonstrated in strategic transmission planning for growth and integration of 5 grids in India into one synchronous grid.

Strategized/ led /part of Policy making in key Sectoral reforms beginning from separation of Transmission to introduction of Open Access, Electricity Act 2003, Tariff Policy, NEP, ISTS planning, Private participation in ISTS, Regulations and procedures for LTA/MTOA & GNA grant, processing of connectivity/LTA applications and Calculation and Sharing of ISTS charges. 

Managed Revenue Assurance, Commercial Agreements, Tariff Petitions, Regulatory and Legal matters, Dispute resolution, Court cases, Regulatory petition management, License & approval for new business, Contractual & Commercial transaction, Project Management and Stakeholder Consultation.

Looked after commercial transaction, Regulatory and Legal matters of all India Interstate Transmission Billing, Collection and Disbursement of more than Rs 45,000 Crs annually covering > 50 Transmission Licensees and >100 Discoms and DICs 

Leader with motivational management style & reputation for building and retaining highly motivated teams.

PROFESSIONAL EXPERIENCE Duration

Executive Director (Commercial & Regulatory Cell), POWERGRID Oct’20 to Apr’24

Responsible for 

The overall functions of the Corporate Commercial and Regulatory Cell to ensure realizing the commercial targets of the Company by planning, monitoring & follow up, development of framework to align with regulatory changes, and to act as an interface between the Company and external stakeholders like CERC, CEA, RPCs, DICs, STUs, Transmission Licensees, etc. 

Coordination with all the DICs, SEBs, STUs, Transmission licensees along with IPPs for revenue realization 

Represent POWERGRID in front of CERC and other Government institutions for tariff related matters

Strategizing/ advocating policy and regulations and representing POWERGRID for implementation of the same through MoP, CERC, CEA, RPCs and Grid India

Handling grievances with Regulators, High Court and Supreme court

Working on License attainment and regulatory requirements for starting of new business venture 

Finalize commercial related agreements i.e Transmission Service agreement, Project Agreements etc. for transmission projects in India and Internationally

Key Achievement:

Strategized and led POWERGRID Transition in new regulatory regime where CERC/ MoP came up with new GNA regulations, Sharing Regulations, Grid Code, Tariff Regulations, LPS Rules etc.

Dealt > 100 Tariff Petitions for New Assets for Capital cost 50,000 Crs and > 400 Truing up Petition for Capital cost > Rs 2 lakh Crores.

Successfully handled critical litigations and disputes in APTEL/High Courts/Supreme Courts to end long pending issues mainly related to Outstanding Dues, Mismatch issues, Tariff disputes. 

Led team for grant of Regulatory approvals for Transmission projects for Renewables Generation, and Solar Power parks in India, High Capacity Corridors, New Business initiatives. 

Engineer to Chief General Manager, CTU Aug’91 to Sep’20

Responsible for/Worked on 

Transmission planning to ensure long term growth of sector and designing regulatory, policy and contractual frameworks, agreements, standard, procedure etc. for grant of connectivity, LTA, GNA etc to ISTS

Development of regulatory procedures for connectivity / LTA / GNA for various entities like conventional/renewable generations, consumers, DISCOMs etc. Handled processing and grant of Long Term Access, Connectivity applications as per CERC regulations since 2004 till 2020. 

Planning of reliable & techno economic transmission schemes for evacuation of power from various Thermal, Hydro and renewable generations in coordination with CEA, STUs, RPCs etc. 

Representing POWERGRID for approval of various transmission schemes in Standing Committee Meetings for Transmission Planning by CEA and RPC and coordinating with various agencies like CEA, POSOCO (now Grid Controller), STUs and other Govt officials in Centre and State.

Actively involved in monitoring of pre-award implementation and corporate level management of transmission schemes through close interaction with Region and Management.

Leading Consultancy assignments at National and International level. Major works involved PSTCL, DTL, HPPTCL, NDMC, UT Chandigarh, Western UP transmission scheme, IPPs etc. 

Worked as consultant to World Bank for development of transmission scheme in Tajikistan & Afghanistan and also provided consultancy to Fiji. 

Representing before CERC for various issues/petitions and interacting with CERC during formulation of various regulations.

Key Achievement:

Planning for development of National Grid through step-by-step integration of all 5 regions which started with interconnection through HVDC and progressively developed with strong interconnections at 765 kV and high capacity HVDC systems.

Introduction and adoption of various new technologies like Series Reactor, Series Capacitors, TCSC, STATCOMs, 800 kV HVDC system etc. in the country.

Formulated and advocated for Open Access Regulations and Procedure, formulation of Indian Electricity Grid Code, Grid Standards.

Worked towards CERC’s / MoP’s endeavor towards Sectoral growth activities like introduction of Availability based Tariff, Private participation through JV/TBCB, Distribution Sector reforms.

Engineer, NTPC Oct’86 to Aug 1991

Posted in Power System Engineering division of NTPC in 1987 and had worked on Transmission Line engineering & DPR preparation activities.

 Name of the Assignment or Project: 2X500 MW HVDC Back to Back station at Vizag 
Year: 1999-2004
Location: India
Client: In-House
Position Held: In-Charge, Project Management Team
Main Project Features: 
A policy decision was taken in India to inter-connect the five independently operating electrical regions with an ultimate objective of establishment of "National Grid" covering entire length and breadth of the country. The "National Grid" was to be developed in phases taking into account the ground realities of operations. The different regions were operating with varying electrical parameters in terms of wide frequency excursions from nominal value of 50 Hz. Therefore, in the first phase the regions were planned to be inter-connected with HVDC back-to-back links which are quite robust against the varying frequencies in the inter-connected regions. The instant scheme was one of such project in which Eastern region of India were inter-connected with the Southern region with 1000 MW HVDC back-to-back module, on the two sides 

This project has envisaged construction of 1000 MW HVDC back-to-back station at Gazuwaka and a 400 kV Jeypore - Gazuwaka 400 kV D/c line of about 225 Km length. This has enabled transfer of power upto 1000 MW in either direction depending on the power flow requirement.

2x500 MW HVDC Back-to-Back station at Gazuwaka

 Name of the Assignment or Project: 2X250 MW HVDC Back to Back station at Vindhyachal 
Year: 1986-1999
Location: India
Client: In-House
Position Held: Part of Project Management Team
Main Project Features: 
This scheme was planned in 1980's. At that time, Indian power system was divided into five regions, all of them operating independently. Through detailed load generation studies, it was found that interconnection of regions shall give various benefits viz. reducing demand-supply gap, improving thermal-hydro mix, reduction of spinning reserves, improvement of operating parameters through transfer of surplus power in surplus region and meeting load demand in deficit region. Detailed studies were carried out by POWERGRID (erstwhile NTPC) for selection of best alternative for inter-connection of Northern and Western regions and, it was decided to connect them through HVDC back-to-back link as both the regions had different operating parameters. 

Vindhyachal HVDC back-to-back link consists of 2x250 MW HVDC modules at Vindhyachal, a major generating complex in Western Region and a 400kV AC D/c line to Singrauli, the major generating complex of Northern Region. Power is exchanged between two regions over this link almost on continuous basis. This inter-connector is operating successfully for last twenty seven years.

A policy decision was taken in India to inter-connect the five independently operating electrical regions with an ultimate objective of establishment of "National Grid" covering entire length and breadth of the country. Main Project Features:
This scheme was planned in 1980's. At that time, Indian power system was divided into five regions, all of them operating independently. Through detailed load generation studies, it was found that interconnection of regions shall give various benefits viz. reducing demand-supply gap, improving thermal-hydro mix, reduction of spinning reserves, improvement of operating parameters through transfer of surplus power in surplus region and meeting load demand in deficit region. Detailed studies were carried out by POWERGRID (erstwhile NTPC) for selection of best alternative for inter-connection of Northern and Western regions and, it was decided to connect them through HVDC back-to-back link as both the regions had different operating parameters.
Vindhyachal HVDC back-to-back link consists of 2x250 MW HVDC modules at Vindhyachal, a major generating complex in Western Region and a 400kV AC D/c line to Singrauli, the major generating complex of Northern Region. Power is exchanged between two regions over this link almost on continuous basis. This inter-connector is operating successfully for last twenty seven years.

candidates.rawText:
A. MOHAN MENON

Senior Consultant - Techno-Commercial Advisory

Consultant for the bulk electricity business covering techno-commercial issues for both conventional and renewable power generation, advising clients on purchase & sale of power covering tariff-based bid processes, electricity pricing, drafting & negotiation of Power Purchase Agreements (PPAs), procurement of transmission services, fuel access issues, hydrology risk issues, compliance with power market regulations and on project due diligence issues etc. 

Balanced experience of over thirty years in the Indian electricity sector covering the entire spectrum of ownership namely the Public Sector, Public-Private Partnerships (PPPs) and the Private Sector. Experience covers electricity tariff issues, bid processes for selection of bulk power supplier, power purchase agreements, power transmission access facilitation, power project construction, financing issues and power trading. Hands-on understanding of the concerns of various stakeholders and the ways to address them efficiently & effectively to make projects more bankable. 

Have successfully advised companies like McKinsey & Co, Goldman Sachs Special Situations Group, South Asia Clean Energy Fund, Canasia Power Corp (Canada based project developer), Thermax Ltd., JSW Energy and several other Indian entities including project developers and investment companies. Supported international firms like PA Consulting, KPMG, ICF International and Gas Natural Fenosa Engineering in their bids for major consulting assignments in India & the region.

Involved with capacity building programs focussed on power market development and power procurement processes for countries in the South Asian Region.

Participated in several international exchange programmes on electricity markets & regulation, with NORDPOOL - the world’s pioneering multi-country electricity pool, PJM Network - the leading power trading platform in the United States and several events covering electricity partnership issues in South Asia. 

Key assignments as an INDEPENDENT CONSULTANT (From June 2009 till date)

Advisory services to investment companies, both international and domestic, for due diligence on tariff viability, fuel security / hydrology assumptions, transmission access, power market regulations, bid processes for power sale and power purchase agreements (PPAs) and to facilitate strategic investments in grid-connected power projects; 

Advised the legal team of a company seeking revision to a tariff discovered through a competitive bidding process on account of major changes to the external environment (principally legal and financial) of their power project;

Assisted several project developers in the process of obtaining long term transmission access from India’s national power transmission company POWERGRID when regulations were nascent; 

Advisory services on risk allocation & bidding strategy to a successful bidder for a MW scale geothermal power project in India involving deep drilling and with acute construction & maintenance challenges; 

Advisory services for an outsourced Operation & Maintenance contract for a large power station, with particular emphasis on commercial risks from PPAs and from grid operations; 

Undertook a Power Market Study for an Indian client for assessing the market scenario over a 7 – 10 year horizon, identifying key competing technologies and the impact of international trends on the power market;

Advise to members of the international investor community and also investment bankers on opportunities in the Indian Power Sector including renewable energy and also about specific segments / players in the business.

Advised power project development entities on optimal sales mix to balance their revenue expectations while addressing lender / investor concerns;

Key roles handled during prior professional career 

ZEUS INFRAMANAGEMENT Pvt. Ltd. (India) (2007 – 2009)

Key member of the management team driving strategy for the power portfolio of a specialised management advisory & investment company focused on power and related infrastructure sectors and engaged in channelising investments into and catalyzing competitiveness of infrastructure projects.

Advised client companies on investment strategies in both conventional and renewable power generation, on transmission access issues, tariff, power market regulations, PPAs and commercial strategy for competitive bids for sale of power.

Was a member on the Boards of several power project development companies where Zeus Inframanagement had a management contract. These include a coal-based 1200 MW project, a 700 MW hydro project, a large gas-based project, a company setting up a series of renewable energy projects and a joint venture company between India's national transmission utility and a private developer formed for the purpose of executing a 400 kV transmission system to evacuate power from multiple IPPs.

Was the Chief Operating Officer of a joint venture company set up by a power project developer, a leading electricity trader and a leading infrastructure finance company, by pooling their strengths in project development, power marketing and financial services respectively. The company had a prime target of developing power projects with an operating capacity of over 10,000 MW with an investment of around INR 400 billion.

PTC INDIA Ltd. (1999 – 2007) (India’s largest electricity trader)

Played a key role in conceptualising and driving new business strategies for PTC India which is India’s largest electricity trader. The company’s annual turnover moved exponentially from INR 10 million to over INR 30 billion during that time. Also played a key role in developing & successfully implementing a new organization structure for PTC based on business processes, in close consultation with a leading business school.

Headed the group that negotiated and executed long term power purchase contracts for over 6000 MWs with more than 15 IPPs and power sale contracts for over 3000 MWs with distribution utilities in India and one in Nepal that included issues related to cross-border flow of electricity. These include projects ranging from 20 MW to 1500 MW in size and cover hydro, coal, gas and wind based generation. Many of these projects are already in operation.

Worked on the selection of a developer for a 2000 MW project in Western India through tariff based competitive bidding where the choice of fuel was left open to bidders. This included formulation of Request for Qualifications, Request for Proposals and handling of bidders queries through a Pre-bid Conference and thereafter until the bid cut-off date.

Also worked on reviving the PPA process conducted by a state electricity utility where an international consortium had been selected to develop a 1800 MW LNG based project in Southern India for which multiple buyer utilities needed to be contracted subsequently in order to reduce any payment default risk.

NTPC Ltd. (1980 – 1999) (now an integrated 50,000 MW power generation company)

Was involved with planning, project management, on-site execution and operations monitoring for large generation & transmission assets.

Led a team that completed the installation & commissioning of the combined cycle module of a gas-based power project 6 months ahead of schedule.

Worked at Project Site, Regional Offices and at the Corporate Headquarters of the Company handling diverse responsibilities.

WORK UNDERTAKEN THAT BEST ILLUSTRATES CAPABILITY TO HANDLE THE TASKS RELATED TO DEVELOPING POWER MARKETS

Specialised in work on market strategy for the bulk electricity business covering issues relating to generation and fuels, bulk transmission issues including constraints in directional power flow, contracts (PPAs) for sale and purchase of electricity for varying tenures for revenue optimisation and competitiveness, experience and familiarity with competitive bid processes for selection of project developers as well as capacity suppliers and with project execution / investment / financing risks. 

Key experience that would, among others, support such a role would be as follows :

Advisor to several power developers in a large power market like India’s with major diversities in fuel, project location, ownership and project sizes to make the best use of a dynamically emerging electricity market for optimising their return on investment.

Advising members of the international investor community and also investment bankers on emerging opportunities in the Indian Power Sector, including projects that could be set up outside the country and targeted at the local market.

Having been a key member of the management team driving strategy for the power portfolio of a specialised management advisory & investment company focused on power and related infrastructure sectors. Being engaged in channelizing investments into and catalysing competitiveness of infrastructure projects and advising client companies on investment strategies in both conventional and renewable power generation, on transmission access issues, tariff, power market regulations, PPAs and commercial strategy for competitive bids for sale of power.

Having been a member on the Boards of several power project development companies including conventional as well as renewable generation projects and a transmission joint venture between India's national transmission utility and a private developer to execute the transmission system to evacuate power from various IPPs along the line’s route so as to have an integrated and optimal system for best economic benefit.

As Chief Operating Officer of a power project development company, was closely involved in identifying obstacles and finding solutions keeping the bigger picture always in view. 

Having headed the group at PTC that negotiated and executed long term power purchase contracts for over 6000 MWs with more than 15 IPPs and power sale contracts for over 3000 MWs with distribution utilities in India and one in Nepal, including projects ranging from 20 MW to 1500 MW in size and cover hydro, coal, gas and wind based generation, have been directly involved in the helping create a strong system for financeable projects from the private sector and public-private partnerships that have already begun to compete strongly with the public sector.

Long experience in an integrated power sector entity like NTPC which is amongst the world’s largest, and was involved with planning, project management, on-site execution and operations monitoring for large generation & transmission assets and leading a team for completing a large project within a tight time schedule, would help further in understanding the project development, construction and commercial feasibility issues associated with power sector development even in a new setting.

EDUCATIONAL QUALIFICATIONS 

Bachelor’s degree (1980) in Electrical Engineering (B.E. Electrical) from the Regional Engineering College (now National Institute of Technology) at Bhopal, and an MBA degree (1999) from the Faculty of Management Studies (FMS), University of Delhi.

Name of assignment or project: Transmission Activities for Karnataka State.

Year: 2023 – Ongoing

Location: India

Client: USAID (SAREP Program)

Main project features: Technical assistance to develop the roadmap and plan transmission corridor for green hydrogen production. Identified activities within this task are as follows:

Perform Transmission Planning as per CEA planning criteria (including N-1 criteria) for 5 GW Capacity for Green Hydrogen in the Mangalore area from Renewable Energy Resources, considering the existing and planned transmission system in both Intra and interstate transmission systems for the 2027 – 2030 time frame. Ensure that the load generation balance is adhered and load and generation assumptions including RE, electrolyzer, EV, PSP etc. are pre-validated by KPTCL.

Conduct Power/load flow studies/modeling/simulation for the target year (2027 and 2030) with the planned network.

Assess and recommend the most optimal transmission network based on techno- economic analysis of various scenarios such as HVDC corridor v/s AC transmission corridor for smooth and reliable operation, reconductoring using HTLS conductors.

Assess any requirement of storage technologies (like Battery or Pump storage plant etc.) to address the variability /uncertainty of RE resources to ensure availability of 24x7 electricity.

Carry out Dynamic & and static reactive management studies on the planned network for the Mangalore area and suggest appropriate reactive compensation.

Carry out short circuit studies for the transmission network and its mitigation

measures, if required.

Positions held: Senior Engineer

Activities performed: The key requirements to be addressed includes:

System Modelling: With the actual and forecasted load generation balance scenarios.

Electrolyser selection and Modelling: Choosing the right electrolyser for the system is very crucial.

Modelling the system components of Electrolysers: Storage modelling if required

Transient Model: Modelling the system for transient studies.

Maximum RE potential of the system is evaluated, Analysis are carried on the present system to evaluate its reliability for producing 5 GW of green Hydrogen. Assessment and recommending the most optimal transmission network based on techno-economic analysis of various scenarios such as HVDC corridor v/s AC transmission corridor for smooth and reliable operation, reconductoring using HTLS conductors.

Name of assignment or project: EMTP Switching Surge and Reactive Power Studies at 220kV

Atul GETCO Substation.

Year: 2023-24

Location: India

Client: Western Railways

Main project features: The objective of the assignment is to perform the reactive Power studies and EMTP studies for laying of an underground cable between existing and a proposed substation. Switching overvoltage studies for cable charging and discharging without transformers. Switching overvoltage studies for cable charging and discharging with transformer. Switching overvoltage studies with stuck breaker condition (Ferroresonance).

Positions held: Senior Engineer

Activities performed: Power system networks with cables may produce reactive power (Q) particularly during off-peak load hours due to more capacitive reactance of cables as compared with overhead lines. This extra reactive power will flow back to transmission networks and may cause overvoltage and active power losses in networks or reduce the transmission capacity of lines. Although, there is some room for free amount of reactive power to back feed but exceeding this free limit may result in heavy penalty and cost for reactive power tariff, hence suitable Reactive power studies must be carried out. The key task involves performing the reactive Power studies and EMTP studies for laying of an underground cable between existing and a proposed substation. The study addresses the evaluation of maximum switching impulse voltage that can occur while operating the Circuit Breakers. The reactive power analysis of the underground cable. Assessing suitable reactive

compensation to maintain reactive power stability in the system.

Performing Harmonic analysis: which includes evaluating the Voltage and Current harmonic distortion and its compliance with the IEEE 519:2014 standard.

candidates.rawText:
A. MOHAN MENON

Senior Consultant - Techno-Commercial Advisory

Consultant for the bulk electricity business covering techno-commercial issues for both conventional and renewable power generation, advising clients on purchase & sale of power covering tariff-based bid processes, electricity pricing, drafting & negotiation of Power Purchase Agreements (PPAs), procurement of transmission services, fuel access issues, hydrology risk issues, compliance with power market regulations and on project due diligence issues etc. 

Balanced experience of over thirty years in the Indian electricity sector covering the entire spectrum of ownership namely the Public Sector, Public-Private Partnerships (PPPs) and the Private Sector. Experience covers electricity tariff issues, bid processes for selection of bulk power supplier, power purchase agreements, power transmission access facilitation, power project construction, financing issues and power trading. Hands-on understanding of the concerns of various stakeholders and the ways to address them efficiently & effectively to make projects more bankable. 

Have successfully advised companies like McKinsey & Co, Goldman Sachs Special Situations Group, South Asia Clean Energy Fund, Canasia Power Corp (Canada based project developer), Thermax Ltd., JSW Energy and several other Indian entities including project developers and investment companies. Supported international firms like PA Consulting, KPMG, ICF International and Gas Natural Fenosa Engineering in their bids for major consulting assignments in India & the region.

Involved with capacity building programs focussed on power market development and power procurement processes for countries in the South Asian Region.

Participated in several international exchange programmes on electricity markets & regulation, with NORDPOOL - the world’s pioneering multi-country electricity pool, PJM Network - the leading power trading platform in the United States and several events covering electricity partnership issues in South Asia. 

Key assignments as an INDEPENDENT CONSULTANT (From June 2009 till date)

Advisory services to investment companies, both international and domestic, for due diligence on tariff viability, fuel security / hydrology assumptions, transmission access, power market regulations, bid processes for power sale and power purchase agreements (PPAs) and to facilitate strategic investments in grid-connected power projects; 

Advised the legal team of a company seeking revision to a tariff discovered through a competitive bidding process on account of major changes to the external environment (principally legal and financial) of their power project;

Assisted several project developers in the process of obtaining long term transmission access from India’s national power transmission company POWERGRID when regulations were nascent; 

Advisory services on risk allocation & bidding strategy to a successful bidder for a MW scale geothermal power project in India involving deep drilling and with acute construction & maintenance challenges; 

Advisory services for an outsourced Operation & Maintenance contract for a large power station, with particular emphasis on commercial risks from PPAs and from grid operations; 

Undertook a Power Market Study for an Indian client for assessing the market scenario over a 7 – 10 year horizon, identifying key competing technologies and the impact of international trends on the power market;

Advise to members of the international investor community and also investment bankers on opportunities in the Indian Power Sector including renewable energy and also about specific segments / players in the business.

candidates.rawText:
Aman Chhabra

📞 +91 8700011719 | ✉️ aman.chhabra@gmail.com🏠 D-28, Indira Enclave, Neb Sarai, New Delhi – 110068🗓 Date of Birth: 17th March 1982

PROFILE SUMMARY

Senior energy and automation professional with 18+ years of extensive experience delivering integrated electrical automation, smart grid, and IT systems for public and private utilities across India and internationally. Proven expertise in managing full life cycles of SCADA/EMS/DMS/OMS deployments, utility-grade GIS systems, AMI solutions, and enterprise system integrations with SAP ISU, supporting India's national electrification, grid modernization, and digital transformation agendas.Skilled in leading multidisciplinary teams, managing P&L, executing multilateral-funded programs (World Bank, ADB, KfW), and working across regulatory, operational, and commercial domains. Strategic thinker with a clear vision for aligning emerging technologies with utility objectives for resilience, sustainability, and cost-efficiency.

RECENT PROFESSIONAL DEVELOPMENT (2023 – Present)

Career Break – Strategic Industry Engagement & Upskilling

Tracked RDSS, offshore wind transmission policy, and regulatory models for public-private utility partnerships.

Completed courses in cybersecurity for utilities, digital twin applications, and AI-based energy analytics.

Analyzed execution models for DER, microgrids, and transnational energy corridors through World Bank-funded studies.

Engaged utility experts in peer discussions on SCADA–SAP convergence, EPC contractor coordination, and AMI scale-up challenges.

CORE COMPETENCIES

Strategic Utility Leadership & P&L Management

Smart Grid Planning, SCADA/DMS/EMS/OMS Implementation

AI/ML for Predictive Maintenance & Load Forecasting

AMI and Smart Metering Integration

GIS, SAP ISU, Telecom & Enterprise Systems

Cybersecurity, Regulatory Compliance & Governance

Tender Management, QR, EPC & Turnkey Contracts

Public Utility Program Execution (R-APDRP, RDSS, Smart Grid Mission)

Knowledge Management & Team Building

Stakeholder Engagement and Industry Advocacy

TECHNOLOGY STACK

SCADA/EMS/OMS Platforms: Siemens, GE PowerOn, ABB, OSIsoft, Schneider

GIS & SAP Tools: GE Smallworld GIS, SAP ISU, SAP PI, Crystal Reports

Protocols & Standards: IEC 61850, IEC 104, DNP3, IEEE C37.118

Specialist Tools: Business Objects, IoT Sensor Platforms, AMI Dashboards

Integration Interfaces: SCADA–SAP, GIS–OMS, Telecom, SMS Gateway, ERP Systems

PROFESSIONAL EXPERIENCE

Bidgely – EU Region

Head – Sales & Business Development (2020 – 2022)

Owned end-to-end business development and P&L for smart energy solutions across key EU regions (France, Germany, Spain).

Led consultative selling and solution customization for DSOs, integrating Bidgely's AI-powered customer engagement and load disaggregation solutions.

Developed localization strategies based on EU utility regulation, market behavior, and technology adoption cycles.

Spearheaded strategic partnerships with implementation vendors and data platforms.

IoT & Energy Tech Company – India Utility Business

General Manager – Utility Solutions (2018 – 2020)

Led GTM and delivery strategy for AMI, transformer monitoring, and predictive maintenance solutions across Indian DISCOMs.

Executed tender-based projects under RDSS, coordinating across state nodal agencies, utilities, and implementation partners.

Introduced AI/ML-based energy efficiency algorithms to optimize transformer performance and reduce AT&C losses.

Oversaw project budgeting, proposal creation, and post-sales handholding for key accounts in UP, Rajasthan, and Tamil Nadu.

KEC International Ltd.

Head – Automation Business Development (2016 – 2018)

Established automation division targeting Indian DISCOMs, railways, and pipelines for SCADA, DMS, and telemetry solutions.

Mapped market, defined product positioning, and supported technical qualification for tenders across Powergrid, UGVCL, WBSEDCL.

Defined control room architecture and implemented pilot projects for remote monitoring systems in railway electrification corridors.

Interfaced with OEMs to align technical specs and SLAs per utility procurement norms.

Innovari India Pvt. Ltd.

Regional Sales Lead – Smart Grid (2014 – 2016)

Drove regional engagement with state utilities to adopt DER, demand response, and energy balancing platforms.

Engaged in client training, policy advocacy, and business case development for real-time grid optimization.

Expanded partner ecosystem across EPCs and SIs for rapid pilot deployment.

Handled project coordination and compliance documentation for grid-interactive control systems.

Open Systems International (OSI)

Project Manager – SCADA & RLDC Systems (2011 – 2014)

Set up and led India operations including vendor identification, resource hiring, and client onboarding.

Managed multi-project portfolios (R-APDRP, RLDC) delivering SCADA/EMS/DMS systems for 400kV+ substations under Powergrid.

Led all project phases—from design, integration, FAT/SAT to training and documentation handover.

Directed India-specific adaptation of global SCADA systems, including protocol mapping and bilingual UI deployments.

Tata Power Company Ltd. – Mumbai

Contracts Manager – Automation Group (2009 – 2011)

Managed rollout of SCADA/OMS/DMS/GIS across Mumbai’s primary distribution substations.

Formed BRDs for cross-departmental MIS tools and deployed dashboards for CXO-level decision making.

Collaborated with GE, Oracle, and Siemens for smart grid pilots.

Provided automation-side consulting to the energy audit group and facilitated internal knowledge base creation.

Early Career Roles

Engineer → Team Lead – Projects & Electrical Automation (2004 – 2009)

Managed substation monitoring projects, deployed CO₂ and nitrogen flow meters, and upgraded enterprise MIS systems.

Designed PDA-based data collection software to streamline field data acquisition.

Led automation implementation from design to commissioning, reporting to technical heads and client-side leadership.

EDUCATION

B.E. (Hons) – Electronics Technology, Coventry University, UK

MBA – Marketing, Faculty of Management Studies, Delhi

ADDITIONAL INFORMATION

Actively engaged in India's energy transition roadmap including RDSS, Smart Grid Mission, and offshore wind integration.

Experienced in managing World Bank, ADB, KfW, and JICA-funded public sector projects with strict quality and compliance norms.

Skilled at bridging technical and business teams; fluent in developing winning proposals and high-impact solution designs.

Deep utility network across India and EU—strong engagement with OEMs, EPCs, and consultants in the energy ecosystem.

Participated in international knowledge exchange forums and contributed to internal capacity-building initiatives in prior roles.

Senior energy and automation professional with 18+ years of extensive experience 
delivering integrated electrical automation, smart grid, and IT systems for public and

cycles of SCADA/EMS/DMS/OMS deployments, utility-grade GIS systems, AMI solutions,

commercial domains. Strategic thinker with a clear vision for aligning emerging 
technologies with utility objectives for resilience, sustainability, and cost-efficiency.

private utility partnerships.

energy analytics.

through World Bank-funded studies.

• Expanded partner ecosystem across EPCs and SIs for rapid pilot deployment.

control systems.

• Directed India-specific adaptation of global SCADA systems, including protocol mapping

PowerGrid Corporation of India Limited

Position: Director (Commercial & Regulatory Cell)

Contact for Reference:

INDIA

Overall 37+ years of experience in the electrical utility and consulting industry, with extensive leadership in transmission planning, project management, commercial operations, regulatory reforms, and international consultancy. Successfully guided national-level transmission development as well as global assignments in feasibility studies, design, and regulatory clearances.

Key responsibilities included:

Directed strategic transmission planning for the National Grid, achieving synchronous integration of India’s five regional grids.

Spearheaded policy and regulatory reforms including Electricity Act 2003, Tariff Policy, ISTS charging methodology, Open Access, and GNA regulations.

Managed commercial operations and tariff petitions, overseeing petitions worth over ₹2.5 lakh Crs and annual billing & disbursement exceeding ₹45,000 Cr.

Secured approvals for renewable projects, high-capacity transmission corridors, and solar power evacuation systems.

Led litigations and dispute resolution at APTEL, High Courts, and Supreme Court, resolving critical issues on tariff and dues.

Delivered international consultancy services, including World Bank projects in Tajikistan & Afghanistan, and consultancy for Fiji.

Oversaw contractual and commercial agreements for transmission projects in India and abroad.

Introduced advanced transmission technologies (765kV AC, 800kV HVDC, STATCOMs, TCSC, Series Reactors).

Coordinated with CERC, MoP, CEA, RPCs, STUs, IPPs, and Discoms to ensure smooth project approvals and compliance.

Built and nurtured high-performing technical and management teams across diverse functions.

Aug 1991 – 

Sep 2020

CTU (Central Transmission Utility)

Position: Chief General Manager

Contact for Reference:

INDIA

Drove transmission planning, regulatory framework development, and project execution during India’s power sector transformation. Played a central role in developing the National Grid and enabling renewable integration.

Key responsibilities included:

Led long-term transmission planning, integrating India’s five regional grids into one synchronous National Grid.

Developed regulatory and contractual frameworks for Connectivity, LTA, and GNA under CERC regulations.

Planned techno-economic transmission schemes for evacuation of Thermal, Hydro, and Renewable power projects.

Represented POWERGRID in Standing Committee Meetings of CEA and RPCs for approval of national and regional schemes.

Oversaw corporate-level monitoring of projects, coordinating between regional offices and management.

Delivered consultancy services for PSTCL, DTL, HPPTCL, NDMC, UT Chandigarh, Western UP, and IPPs.

Provided international consultancy to World Bank (Tajikistan & Afghanistan) and transmission planning for Fiji.

Introduced advanced transmission technologies: 765kV systems, 800kV HVDC, STATCOMs, TCSC, and Series Reactors.

Contributed to Open Access Regulations, Indian Electricity Grid Code, and Grid Standards.

Supported sectoral reforms including Availability-Based Tariff (ABT), JV/TBCB participation, and distribution reforms.

Coordinated with CEA, POSOCO, MoP, STUs, and state regulators for project planning and implementation.

Mentored teams of planners and engineers, strengthening corporate expertise in policy and transmission planning.

Supported studies on system performance and power evacuation for NTPC projects.

Oct 2020 -
Apr 2024
PowerGrid Corporation of India Limited
Position: Director (Commercial & Regulatory Cell)
Contact for Reference:
INDIA
Overall 37+ years of experience in the electrical utility and consulting industry, with extensive leadership in transmission planning, project management, commercial operations, regulatory reforms, and international consultancy. Successfully guided national-level transmission development as well as global assignments in feasibility studies, design, and regulatory clearances.
Key responsibilities included:
Directed strategic transmission planning for the National Grid, achieving synchronous integration of India s five regional grids.
Spearheaded policy and regulatory reforms including Electricity Act 2003, Tariff Policy, ISTS charging methodology, Open Access, and GNA regulations.
Managed commercial operations and tariff petitions, overseeing petitions worth over 2.5 lakh Crs and annual billing & disbursement exceeding 45,000 Cr.
Secured approvals for renewable projects, high-capacity transmission corridors, and solar power evacuation systems.
Led litigations and dispute resolution at APTEL, High Courts, and Supreme Court, resolving critical issues on tariff and dues.
Delivered international consultancy services, including World Bank projects in Tajikistan & Afghanistan, and consultancy for Fiji.
Oversaw contractual and commercial agreements for transmission projects in India and abroad.
Introduced advanced transmission technologies (765kV AC, 800kV HVDC, STATCOMs, TCSC, Series Reactors).
Coordinated with CERC, MoP, CEA, RPCs, STUs, IPPs, and Discoms to ensure smooth project approvals and compliance.
Built and nurtured high-performing technical and management teams across diverse functions.
Aug 1991 -
Sep 2020
CTU (Central Transmission Utility)
Position: Chief General Manager
Contact for Reference:
INDIA
Drove transmission planning, regulatory framework development, and project execution during India s power sector transformation. Played a central role in developing the National Grid and enabling renewable integration.
Key responsibilities included:
Led long-term transmission planning, integrating India s five regional grids into one synchronous National Grid.
Developed regulatory and contractual frameworks for Connectivity, LTA, and GNA under CERC regulations.
Planned techno-economic transmission schemes for evacuation of Thermal, Hydro, and Renewable power projects.
Represented POWERGRID in Standing Committee Meetings of CEA and RPCs for approval of national and regional schemes.
Oversaw corporate-level monitoring of projects, coordinating between regional offices and management.
Delivered consultancy services for PSTCL, DTL, HPPTCL, NDMC, UT Chandigarh, Western UP, and IPPs.
Provided international consultancy to World Bank (Tajikistan & Afghanistan) and transmission planning for Fiji.
Introduced advanced transmission technologies: 765kV systems, 800kV HVDC, STATCOMs, TCSC, and Series Reactors.
Contributed to Open Access Regulations, Indian Electricity Grid Code, and Grid Standards.
Supported sectoral reforms including Availability-Based Tariff (ABT), JV/TBCB participation, and distribution reforms.
Coordinated with CEA, POSOCO, MoP, STUs, and state regulators for project planning and implementation.
Mentored teams of planners and engineers, strengthening corporate expertise in policy and transmission planning.
Oct 1986 -
Aug 1991
NTPC
Position: Engineer (Power System Engineering Division)
Contact for Reference:
INDIA
Contributed to transmission line design and planning at the early stage of career, gaining strong technical foundation in engineering and feasibility studies.
Key responsibilities included:
Assisted in transmission line engineering design, layout preparation, and feasibility analysis.
Prepared Detailed Project Reports (DPRs) for new transmission schemes.
Supported studies on system performance and power evacuation for NTPC projects.
Coordinated with consultants and design teams to ensure technical compliance.
Built expertise in system studies and project design methodologies for future large-scale projects.

MAHESH KUMAR 
mahesh.21029@gmail.com 
Contact No.: +91-9125374384 
 
CAREER OBJECTIVE: 
To work in a competitive and challenging environment wherein I can utilize my knowledge and 
interpersonal skills towards achieving the goals of an organization simultaneously with personal 
growth. 
 
EXPERIENCE: Total 8 yr.2-month Experience in Transmission line Project & sub station Project. 
Company Name : Medhaj Techno Concept Pvt. Ltd. 
Position : Deputy manager (Electrical). 
Period : Nov.-2024 – till date. 
Role and Responsibility 
 Here I’m responsible for (2X50 MVA) 132/33 KV GSS. & 132 KV transmission Line (30KM) 
 Foundation, Erection & stringing work in 132/33 KV switch yard & transmission line. 
 Testing of Transformer, switch yard equipment testing, cable termination & Commissioning. 
 All responsibilities managing of transmission line (Such as- tower foundation, tower erection & 
stringing) and NH clearance, Forest clearance, power line crossing clearance etc. 
 Line billing work, ROW solving and other responsibilities with client JUSNL. 
 Commissioning and Charging of line and GSS. 
 Inspect materials before installation (Lugs, conduit, structure, cables, etc.). 
 Excavation of HT & LT cable trenches, Inverter to LT panel LT cable laying, HT panel 
to MCR or 33 KV overhead line HT cable line, inverters erection done. 
 Megger test of LT & HT cables before cable laying, VOC test of every string 
before commissioning. 
 Earthing of all equipment (transformer, Panel, inverter, table to table earthing) and 
connecting with earth pit. 
 Inspect the structure Erection, Module Erection, Series & Parallel connection of 
Modules, Strings, and giving the permission to contactor according to that. 
 Transformers, HT & LT Panels erection at IDTs, Luging of HT & LT cables and 
termination as per IDTs. 
 Control cables laying, lugging, ferruling and termination as per control cable schedule. 
 Experience in testing and commissioning of transformers and control panal. 
 
 
Company Name: Aarvanss buildwell Infracon & LLP. 
Position : Senior Engineer (Electrical) 
Period : Dec-2023 – Oct-2024. 
Aarvanss Buildwell Infracon & LLP Pvt ltd basically focus on Diversion of T/L. Such as 132, 
220, 400 &765KV HVAC And 500 KV & 800 KV HVDC T/L.

Foundation work, Erection, stringing & Earthing work. And dismantling old line and finally 
charged line. 
 Ensure that safety and quality meet the standards at site. 
 Proper management of manpower for completion of project within time limit. 
 Proper management with client (PowerGrid) and site employee. 
 
 
 

Company Name: Basics Engineering India Private Limited. 
Position : Project Engineer. 
Period : Jun 2022 – Nov 2023. 
Role and Responsibility 
 Here I am responsible from Planning & Execution of construction activities of civil works as 
well as electrical works likes Foundation work, Erection, stringing & Earthing work. 
 Ensure that safety and quality meet the standards at site. 
 Here I am completed 90 KM 132 KV D/C transmission line at Jharkhand (JUSNL) project. 
 90 KM T/L is divided in 5 lines in one project. (1. Irba-Ratu, 2. Irba – Angara, 3. Irba – Kanke,4. 
Silli – Angara, 5. Silli- Chauka) 
 Proper management of manpower for completion of project within time limit. 
 Proper management with client (JUSNL) and site employee. 
 ROW work, Compensation work & Billing work also. 
 
Company Name : Navdurga Electro construction Pvt. Ltd. 
Position : Field Engineer (Electrical). 
Period : Nov 2019 – May 2022 
Role and Responsibility 
 Here I am responsible from Planning & Execution of construction activities of civil works as well 
as electrical works likes Foundation work, Erection, stringing & Earthing work 
 220KV D/C Baghpat (400KV PGCIL) to Modi Puram -II T/L (38KM)

Profile of Dr. P.C. Nawani 

1. Name : Dr. Pramod Chandra Nawani
 
2. Date of Birth : 11 July 1951

3. Mailing Address : G- 202, JMD Garden,
 Sohna Road, Sector- 33
 Gurgaon- 122018 
 ( Haryana) 
 
 9560894337
 Email ID: drnawanipc@gmail.com

 
 
4. Academic qualification : M.Sc (Geology), Ph.D. (Engg. geology)

5. Positions Held : 
 
 Director of National Institute of Rock Mechanics (NIRM), an Autonomous Research Institute under Ministry of Mines, Govt. of India, from 20th February, 2008 to 31st July 2011 

NIRM is a premier centre of research in applied and basic rock mechanics. It was set up under Ministry of Mines, Govt. of India, in 1988. The mandate of NIRM is to provide enabling technology to mining, civil engineering sectors and construction industries, both in India and abroad, to achieve improved production, productivity and 
quality, with enhanced safety and economy. NIRM is presently involved 
in surface and underground works in power sector (hydro power, nuclear, thermal), mining sector (coal, metal, dimensional stone mining), underground storage for oil/gas, infrastructure building (roads, bridges), tunneling for rapid communication (railway, metro), oil pipelines, disaster management (national hazard - landslides, earthquake) and environmental engineering. The uniqueness of the institute to have entire spectrum of rock engineering investigations being carried out by twelve specialized departments, under one umbrella. The institute organizes training courses in rock mechanics/rock engineering. 
 
The CSIR, AICTE and a number of Universities / IITs have acknowledged NIRM as a national laboratory for carrying out higher studies in the area of rock mechanics.
 
Director, Geological Survey of India (GSI) and headed Engineering Geology Projects in Uttrakhand Himalaya, from July 2000 to February 2008. Served GSI for more than 35 years in different capacities and carried out geological/engineering geological/geotechnical investigations and also supervised investigations taken up by junior officers. GSI is a premier geo scientific survey organization of Govt. of India, under Ministry of Mines, having more than 158 years of existence. GSI is the principal provider of geo scientific information and services to the government, industry and public. The Geological Survey of India is a world class institution for fundamental as well as applied geosciences. Its activities fall in the following areas, viz., surface mapping, offshore survey and exploration, mineral and energy resources exploration, engineering geology and geotechnical investigations, geo environmental and fragile ecosystem, shallow surface geology, geology of water resources, geological hazards and Research & Development.

6. President ship and Membership : 
 
 • 
 President, Indian Society of Engg.
 Geology (ISEG) for the term
 2009 & 2010.
• Vice President of ISEG for 2001 and
 2002.
 Life Member (LM-1081) of the Indian
Society of Engineering Geology (ISEG).
 Member of International Association of
Engg. Geology and Environment (IAEG).
 Member, International Society of Rock
Mechanics (ISRM).
 Member, International Tunnelling
Association (ITA).
 
7. Field of Specialization : Engineering Geology, Geotechnics and Rock Mechanics 
8. Special Achievement/Award : I was conferred upon the prestigious 
 "National Mineral Award 2001" 
 for 
 my distinguished contribution in the 
 field of Applied Geology (Engg. 
 Geology) by Government of India.
 
 I was bestowed with "Science and 
 Technology Excellence Award"-- 
 'Uttarakhand Vigyan Vibhuti -2013' 
 by Govt of Uttarakhand 

9. Professional Experience:

 (a) In National Institute of Rock Mechanics:

As Director, I headed the Institute and was involved in planning, execution and monitoring of more than 80 projects - industry sponsored and R&D Projects in power sector (hydro power sector, nuclear power), mining sector (coal, metal, dimensional stone), communication sector (traffic tunnels, metro rail, highways) irrigation sector (canals, tunnels), underground caverns for strategic storage of oil/gas, disaster management (land slide mitigation, earthquake monitoring) and geo environmental management, in India and abroad.
 These projects were carried out under my direct control by highly qualified and experienced scientists, using the state-of-the-art equipments, in the following areas of specialization viz., engineering geology, engineering geophysics, geotechnical engineering, rock fracture mechanics and material testing, engineering seismology, numerical modeling, rock blasting and excavation engineering, mine design and ground control, micro seismic & automation, environmental engineering and dimensional stone technology. These scientific departments form an intricate web to provide single window solutions to all types of DPR related and construction stage investigations for hydel (Malshejghat HEP in India and Bunakha HEP in Bhutan) and allied sectors.

 Training courses in rock mechanics/engineering were regularly organized by NIRM under my guidance. 
 
 (b) In Geological Survey of India:

As Director, Engineering Geology Division, Geological Survey of India, for the Projects in Uttarakhand State, I was involved in planning, programming, implementation, coordination and monitoring of the engineering geological/geotechnical investigations in pre-construction and construction stages of various important hydro-electric projects like Tehri Dam Project (2000 MW), Koteshwar Dam Project (400 MW), Maneri Bhali stage-II (304 MW), Lakhwar Dam Project (600 MW), Kishau Dam Project (600 MW), Tapovan-Vishnugad HE Project (520 MW) and Loharinag Pala HE Project (600MW) and also a no. of run-of-the river schemes on Alaknanda river, Bhagirathi river, Yamuna river and Tons river in Uttarakhand Himalaya and in Bhutan (Tala HEP-1020 MW) . Other projects included geological/geotechnical investigations of road alignment (National Highways), reservoir studies, micro hydel schemes, seismic macro zonation, landslides etc. The treatment of Varunavat Landslide (Sep.2003) in Uttarakashi was executed under my technical guidance, as Chairman of Technical Committee.
For more than 20 years I was actively associated with the most prestigious Tehri Dam Project during its construction on Bhagirathi river in Garhwal Lesser Himalaya and which has been commissioned in July 2006. The project envisages construction of a 260.5m high earth core rock fill dam (highest in SE Asia) and other appurtenances like chute/shaft spillways, HRT and underground power house complex (IC-2000 MW). 
 
I played a key role in planning and execution of the construction stage engineering geological investigations and generated geotechnical data input for safe and economic design and construction of Tehri Dam and its appurtenant structures.
I was associated with the preliminary, and preconstruction stage engineering geological/geotechnical investigations of many other hydro power projects in NW Himalaya like Vishnu Prayag Project, Srinagar Hydel Scheme, Kotli Bhel Dam Project, Vishnugad - Pipalkoti scheme, Pala Maneri Hydel Scheme, Bhilangana Hydel Scheme etc. and also other civil engineering structures like traffic tunnels, bridges, roads, building etc. I also formulated and implemented a long term siltation studies in the proposed Tehri and Koteshwar reservoirs.

I was associated with the macro-seismic investigations of Uttarkashi Earthquake of October, 1991 and Chamoli Earthquake of March, 1999, in Garhwal Himalaya.

For over seven years (during 1974-1981), I was involved in regional geological and geo-morphological studies in NW Himalaya. I was member of two expeditions to Ladakh Himalaya for investigation of potash deposits in Tsokar area (Ladakh), in 1975 and 1976. 

During 1982-85, I was also involved in Marine Geology and Offshore explorations programme of GSI for carrying out seabed mapping, in Arabian Sea, Bay of Bengal and Andaman Sea.

I was given additional responsibility by Govt of India -PMO to act as Chairman of Technical Committee to carry out stabilization of a massive Varunavat Hill Landslide overlooking Uttarkashi Town in Uttarakhand, during the period 2003-2008. The stabilization works were successfully accomplished by adopting standard geotechnical measures like reprofiling, geotextiles, wiremesh-shotcreting, rockbolting, cable anchoring, weep holes, toe drains, cellular walls to create catch-pits and a road tunnel to bypass shooting-stone zone. This landslide stabilization work is considered as a world class example. 

I was also associated with a geo-environmental project in 1976, and carried out geological investigations followed by exploratory drilling in Farrukhnagar area of Haryana under "Environmental resurrection of Brine- rich area in Farrukhnagar. 

10. Professional Contributions (Technical Reports/Publications:

 The following are my professional contributions :

Technical Reports - More than 70 Reports

Engineering Geological Reports:
 
 Fifty five (55) Reports on construction stage, pre-construction stage and Preliminary investigations of different sites of hydro electric projects, other engineering structures, reservoir and natural hazards (Landslides, earthquake), siltation studies.

 Other Geological Reports - 10 reports

 Reports on Rock Mechanics - 5 reports
 
 (b) Special Publication of GSI:
 GSI Publication (Bulletin: Series B, Number 62) "Tehri Dam Project- A geotechnical Appraisal" by P.C.Nawani et al, published n June 2006. (ISSN : 0445-622X) 

 
 
 (c) Publications in National/International Journals
More than 90 publications in the National/International journals and conferences/seminars proceedings.

11. Significant Research Achievement:

Awarded Ph.D for the research work on "Foundation Evaluation of Tehri Dam vis-à-vis Rock Mass Structure". In this research, the concept of rock mass, rock mass structure and engineering geological modeling was utilised for the geotechnical evaluation of the foundation of Tehri Dam and spillway structures.
 
12. Chairmanship/Membership of Technical Committees and Expert Groups.

 (1) Chairman of WRD-05 Committee (Water Resources Division) of Bureau of Indian Standards (BIS) on "Geological Investigation and Subsurface Exploration", since 2004.
 (2) FormerMember of Expert Committee for various Hydro-Electric Project to examine the cases related to Geological Surprises, under Ministry of Power, Govt. of India
 (3) Former Member of Task Force set up by PMO (Prime Minister's Office) for Varunavat Parvat Landslide Treatment (in Uttarkashi, Uttarakhand) under Ministry of Home Affairs, Govt. of India.
(4) Chairman of the Technical Committee for Varunavat Parvat Landslide treatment Project in Uttarkashi, Uttarakhand state for coordination of investigation, designing and construction of works.
(5) Member High level Task Force set up by Govt. of Uttarakhand, to assess the Hydro-electric potential of Uttarakhand state
(6) Member of the Project Implementation & Monitoring Committee (PIMC) of the Mission Project on " Landslide Hazard Mitigation for Uttarakhand State' under Ministry of Science & Technology, Govt. of India. 
(7) Former Invited member of Technical Advisory Committee (TAC) for Tehri Dam Project.
(8) Member, Board of Consultants for Maneri Bhali HE Project Stage II in Uttarakhand.
 (9) Member, Expert Committee for Research in Geo-hazards (Landslide/Tsunami) set up by Dept. of Science & Technology, Ministry of Science & Technology, Govt. of India.
 (10) Former Member Geoscience Advisory Council, set up by 
 Ministry of Mines,Govt of India in Sep, 2011 for three yrs.
 (11) Former Member Technical Advisory Committee (TAC) of 

 THDC India Ltd. 
 (12) Member of Project Review Panel (PRP) of World Bank 
 Funded hydropower project of THDC
 (13) Member Project Evaluation Committee of NDMA for
 Landslides.
 (14) Member of Governing Body of NIRM ( National Institute 
 of Rock Mechanics)
 (15) Member Panel of Experts for Hydropower projects of 
 NTPC.
 (16) Principal Consultant at L&T Construction

 (17) Chairman Technical Expert Group of Lakhwar Hydro 
 Project (MPP), Uttarakhand.
 (18) Member Technical Group for Punatshanchhu I & II
 Bhutan 
 
13. Foreign Visits: 

 Visited W. Germany (in 1982), Russia (in 1991), Tajikistan (in1991), Iran (in 1994), Bhutan (in 2003 2004, 2008, 2009, 2010&2011, 2018,2023,2024), UAE (in 2010,2012,2013,2014, 2015,2018,2021 2022), Nepal (in 2012), USA(in 2013,2016 ,2023and 2025 ) and Ethiopia (in 2016) in connection with project visits/review, courses, meetings, conferences and personal visits.

14. Additional Information:
 
 
 I was working with Jindal Power Ltd as President (Geotech) - Hydropower, and I was involved in development of three mega hydropower projects of 6000 MW of JPL from Sep 2011 to Dec 2014.

 Presently I am involved in different engineering projects, including defence projects, in India and abroad.

Date : 

11.09.2025 (Dr. P. C. Nawani)

For over seven years (during 1974-1981), I was involved in regional geological and geo-morphological studies in NW Himalaya. I was member of two expeditions to Ladakh Himalaya for investigation of potash deposits in Tsokar area (Ladakh), in 1975 and 1976.
During 1982-85, I was also involved in Marine Geology and Offshore explorations programme of GSI for carrying out seabed mapping, in Arabian Sea, Bay of Bengal and Andaman Sea.
I was given additional responsibility by Govt of India -PMO to act as Chairman of Technical Committee to carry out stabilization of a massive Varunavat Hill Landslide overlooking Uttarkashi Town in Uttarakhand, during the period 2003-2008. The stabilization works were successfully accomplished by adopting standard geotechnical measures like reprofiling, geotextiles, wiremesh-shotcreting, rockbolting, cable anchoring, weep holes, toe drains, cellular walls to create catch-pits and a road tunnel to bypass shooting-stone zone. This landslide stabilization work is considered as a world class example.
I was also associated with a geo-environmental project in 1976, and carried out geological investigations followed by exploratory drilling in Farrukhnagar area of Haryana under "Environmental resurrection of Brine- rich area in Farrukhnagar.

• Geotechnical Investigation: Planning and Conducting detailed geological and geotechnical investigations to

• Geological Mapping: Creating detailed maps and cross-sections of the tunnel/project route to identify 
geological features and potential hazards. 
• Ground model preparation-Expertise in preparation of geological/geotechnical profiles and ground model in 
AutoCAD Civil 3D, with the help of geotechnical modeller. 
• Rock Mechanics: Analysing the mechanical properties of rock masses using RMR, GSI, Q-System to determine 
their stability and behaviour All types of laboratory test and in-situ test required for a project in the 
investigation stage. 
• Slope Stability Analysis: Evaluating the stability of slopes and designing measures to prevent landslides and 
rock fall using SLIDE/DIPS kinematic analysis. 
• Foundation Analysis: Foundation mapping for assessing the suitability of foundation materials for dams and 
other structures.

report(DPR), Detailed design and ground parameters evaluation for various infra projects. 
• Monitoring and Instrumentation: Instrumentation chapter for monitoring in BOD and Implementing 
monitoring systems to track ground movement and stress changes during construction.

geotechnical specifications.

candidates.rawText:
Kumar Abhinav

Professional Summary

Senior Power System Engineer with 6+ years of experience in power system modelling, renewable grid integration, and transmission system planning across major North American ISO/RTO markets including ERCOT, MISO, PJM, CAISO, NYISO, ISO-NE, SPP, SOCO, TVA, and WECC. Expert in steady-state, dynamic, and EMT simulations covering transient stability, voltage stability, LVRT/FRT, harmonic compliance, insulation coordination, switching transients, SSR/SSO, and inverter-dominated grid interactions. Proven leader in generator and large-load interconnection, grid compliance certification, production-cost modeling, congestion analysis, and transmission impact studies.

Core Technical Competencies

Power System Studies: Transient & Dynamic Stability, Voltage Stability, Harmonic Analysis, Power Quality, LVRT/FRT, Short-Circuit & Breaker Duty, Insulation Coordination, Switching & Lightning Transients, SSR/SSO, Ferro-Resonance, Contingency Analysis, DER/IBR Modeling

Transmission & Market Analysis: Generator & Load Interconnection, Transmission Planning, Hosting Capacity, Production Cost Modeling, LMP Forecasting, Congestion & Curtailment Analysis

Tools & Platforms: PSCAD, PSS/E, PROMOD, DigSilent PowerFactory, PSLF, PowerWorld, ETAP, ASPEN One-Liner, EMTP-RV, MATLAB, RTDS, OPAL-RT

Programming & Automation: Python (PSSPY, PSCAD API), MATLAB, Fortran

Standards & Grid Codes: IEEE, IEC, NERC, IEEE 1547, IEEE 2800, CAISO Rule 21, ERCOT MQT, PJM & ISO-NE Model Requirements

Professional Experience

Nestki Consulting (OPC) Pvt Ltd. – Senior Power System Engineer 

Lead interconnection, EMT modeling, and transmission planning studies for utility-scale solar, wind, BESS, and large-load projects across ERCOT, MISO, PJM, SPP, SOCO, TVA, and WECC.

Execute transient stability, voltage stability, LVRT/FRT, grid compliance, and disturbance ride-through studies supporting Generator Interconnection Agreements.

Perform short-circuit, breaker duty, and switchgear sizing studies in compliance with IEEE and IEC standards.

Lead insulation coordination and switching transient investigations including transformer energization, cable energization, TRV, lightning impulse, and fast-front transients.

Drive SSO/SSR risk assessments using frequency-scan and impedance-based stability techniques for inverter-dominated grids.

Deliver contingency, thermal, voltage, and stability impact assessments for renewable and data-center interconnections.

Execute grid injections and hosting-capacity studies to support IPP siting decisions.

Perform production-cost modeling, congestion analysis, LMP forecasting, and curtailment studies.

Interface with OEMs to integrate and validate plant control systems.

Continuum Associates LLC – Lead Power System Engineer 

Directed dynamic, transient, frequency, and voltage stability studies for renewable and storage projects.

Built EMT models and executed switching transient, ferro-resonance, harmonic, and fast-front transient studies.

Led short-circuit, breaker rating study tasks.

Delivered insulation coordination studies covering lightning surge, transformer energization, GIS fast transients, and switching overvoltages.

Performed grid injection feasibility and transmission capacity studies for offshore wind developments.

Designed STATCOM, SVC, and capacitor bank solutions for voltage and reactive power support.

IIT Mandi – Research Assistant 

Developed real-time digital simulation platforms for microgrid protection and resilient grid operation research.

Led hardware-in-the-loop testing for inverter-dominated networks.

Contributed to WAMS-based adaptive protection and PMU-driven wide-area control strategies.

NIT Agartala – Teaching Assistant Conducted laboratory sessions on load flow, short-circuit, and stability simulation.

Supervised undergraduate research on machine-learning-based fault detection in transmission networks.

Keonjhar School of Engineering – Lecturer 

Taught Electrical Machines, Power Systems, Protection, Switchgear, High Voltage Engineering, and Power Electronics.

Established industry-academia collaboration programs and professional training workshops.

Education

M.Tech (Power System Engineering) NIT Agartala, 2018

B.Tech (Electrical & Electronics Engineering) Gandhi Engineering College, 2013

NIRJHAR NASKAR

S/O: Chitta Ranjan Naskar, Ghasiara, P.O+P.S: Sonarpur, Kolkata-700150, (W.B.)

Contact: +91 9863465820/8420784217(India) ; Email: naskar.nirjhar85@rediffmail.com

ELECTRICAL ENGINEER – CONSTRUCTION INDUSTRY

Seeking a position to utilize my skills and abilities in the Industry that offers professional growth while being resourceful

PROFILE

Qualified B.Tech in Electrical Engineering with an experience of more than 15 years across Transmission Line Construction Companies. (9 years in hilly and difficult areas of North East, India and Eastern Bhutan)

Possess sound knowledge of Transmission Line with all aspects including Survey, Foundation, Erection & Stringing work.

Professional competencies in mobilizing and judiciously managing available resources – men & materials along with planning, and monitoring to ensure job accomplishment within defined time/cost parameters.

Strong understanding of safety requirements and standards procedure with proven ability to manage the entire quality management and project execution.

PROFESSIONAL EXPERIENCE

Present Employee of Transrail Lighting Ltd as a Dy. Manager for Construction of 765KV D/C Vadodara to Olpad Transmission Line under PGCIL, Vadodara, Gujrat.

Previous Employer and Project Details: :

Nestki consulting as Electrical Expert (PMC services) for GIPCL Gujarat, 600MW ground mounted solar project. 

Nestki Consulting Pvt Ltd as a TL Expert (Consultant) for Construction of 220KV D/C Lower Kopili Hydro Electric Project to Sankardev Nagar Grid S/S T/L an ADB Funded Project under supervision of APGCL, Hojai, Assam.

Gepdec Infratech Limited As a Substation expert for Construction Jahangirpur 765/400 KV SS at Sector 18 of Gtr Noida under UPPTCL

Siddhartha Engineering Limited, Bhubaneswar, Odisha: As a Project Manager for Construction of

132 KV Lungsen – Chawngte & Chawngte and associated substatiuons – South Bungtlang T/L (Total 67 KM) (Charged successfully) under PGCIL package TW01 at Lunglei, Mizoram.

Shyama Power India Ltd, Gurgaon, Haryana: As a Project Manager for Construction of 132 KV D/C Merung – Corlung & Kanglung – Phuntshothang and associated substatiuons T/L (Total 56KM, Both Line Charged Successfully) under Bhutan Power Corporation Ltd. at Trashigang, Eastern Bhutan.

Kailash Devbuild India Pvt. Ltd, Jabalpur, MP: As a Site in Charge for Construction Work of 220 KV D/C Achhaliya – Jambuva line (Total 23KM) under GETCO, Vadodara, Gujarat and Hot Line Stringing of CKT-2 (Charged Successfully) of 220KV D/C Siddih to Bargawa TL under HINDALCO, MP

Gammon India Ltd (T&D Business), Nagpur, Maharashtra: As an Engineer for Construction of

765KV D/C Angul – Jharshuguda (Charged Successfully) line under PGCIL, Angul, Odisha.

Huma Power & Tower Pvt Ltd, Guwahati, Assam as a Field Engineer.

Projects Undertaken:

Construction of 220 kV S/S Ramgrah (JSPL, Jharkhand)

Construction of 132 kV S/S East Siang, Arunachal Pradesh.

Detailed Survey under NER PKG- 4 & 7. (PGCIL, Tezu, Arunachal Pradesh)

Job Responsibilities:

Responsible for Meetings with client/ consultants on project progress or on various technical issues concerned with the projects.

Involved in project execution, scheduling and handling the projects on cost/time parameters also monitoring & following up with internal departments for step-by-step activities getting done during execution of project.

Resource planning, Scheduling & monitoring of the sites as per requirement. Preparation of JMC, Check List & Maintaining all kind of site register & other documents and submit as per time limit.

Efficiently interacting, corresponding and coordinating with the project concern and ensuring execution of work to their satisfaction.

Skilfully preparing work schedules to monitor and manage work progress at site on daily basis and ensuring achievement of timelines.

Ensuring construction work complies with all engineering standards, codes, specifications and design instruction also estimating material requirement at site and arranging timely delivery.

Proficiently solving technical queries with the management and quality control personals for the smooth progress of work on site.

Responsible for all site activities including planning, programming and monitoring the project as per bar- chart and also responsible for reviewing vendor drawing and documents and getting approval.

Efficiently prepared bills of executed work as per work order also prepared micro schedules, execution plans and job progress reports.

EDUCATIONAL CREDENTIALS

Meghnad Saha Institute of Technology, West Bengal University of Technology, SCPA-7.28

Harinavi D.V.A.S. High School, W .B.C.H.S.E, 63.1%

candidates.rawText:
Aman Chhabra 
Senior Solution Engineer | Energy Automation & Smart Grid Specialist +91 8700011719 | 
aman.chhabra@gmail.com New Delhi, India 
 
Professional Profile 
Senior energy and automation professional with around 20 years of experience in designing 
and delivering integrated electrical automation, smart grid, and IT systems. Proven expertise in 
the full life cycle of complex deployments, including SCADA, EMS, DMS, and AMI solutions, with 
a focus on enterprise system integration (SAP ISU, GIS). Strategic expert in bridging the gap 
between emerging technologies—like AI-based energy analytics and digital twins—and utility 
operational objectives. 
 
Core Competencies 
● Solution Architecture: Expert in Smart Grid planning and SCADA/DMS/EMS/OMS 
implementation. 
 
● Systems Integration: Deep experience in SCADA-SAP, GIS-OMS, and Telecom/ERP 
system interfacing. 
 
● Emerging Tech: Implementing AI/ML for predictive maintenance, load forecasting, and 
energy efficiency. 
 
● Technical Consulting: Leading consultative selling and solution customization for DSOs 
and utilities. 
 
● Project Governance: Managing full project phases from design and FAT/SAT to final 
commissioning and handover. 
 
Technical Stack 
● Platforms: Siemens, GE PowerOn, ABB, OSIsoft, Schneider. 
 
● GIS & ERP: GE Smallworld GIS, SAP ISU, SAP PI. 
 
● Protocols: IEC 61850, IEC 104, DNP3, IEEE C37.118. 
 
● Specialist Tools: IoT Sensor Platforms, AMI Dashboards, Business Objects. 

 
Professional Experience 
Head - Sales & Business Development | Bidgely (2022) 
● Led consultative solution engineering for DSOs, integrating AI-powered load 
disaggregation and customer engagement platforms. 
 
● Developed localization strategies for technical solutions based on regional utility 
regulations and technology adoption cycles. 
 
General Manager - Utility Solutions | Vodafone India (2021–2022) 
● Architected GTM and delivery strategies for AMI, transformer monitoring, and predictive 
maintenance solutions. 
 
● Introduced AI/ML-based algorithms to optimize grid performance and reduce AT&C 
losses. 
 
● Oversaw technical proposal creation and solution design for major utility accounts. 
 
Head - Automation Business Development | KEC International Ltd. (2018–2021) 
 
● Established the automation division focusing on SCADA, DMS, and telemetry solutions 
for railways and power utilities. 
 
● Defined control room architecture and spearheaded pilot projects for remote monitoring 
systems.

Kumar Abhinav

Professional Summary

Senior Power System Engineer with 6+ years of experience in power system modelling, renewable grid integration, and transmission system planning across major North American ISO/RTO markets including ERCOT, MISO, PJM, CAISO, NYISO, ISO-NE, SPP, SOCO, TVA, and WECC. Expert in steady-state, dynamic, and EMT simulations covering transient stability, voltage stability, LVRT/FRT, harmonic compliance, insulation coordination, switching transients, SSR/SSO, and inverter-dominated grid interactions. Proven leader in generator and large-load interconnection, grid compliance certification, production-cost modeling, congestion analysis, and transmission impact studies.

Core Technical Competencies

Power System Studies: Transient & Dynamic Stability, Voltage Stability, Harmonic Analysis, Power Quality, LVRT/FRT, Short-Circuit & Breaker Duty, Insulation Coordination, Switching & Lightning Transients, SSR/SSO, Ferro-Resonance, Contingency Analysis, DER/IBR Modeling

Transmission & Market Analysis: Generator & Load Interconnection, Transmission Planning, Hosting Capacity, Production Cost Modeling, LMP Forecasting, Congestion & Curtailment Analysis

Tools & Platforms: PSCAD, PSS/E, PROMOD, DigSilent PowerFactory, PSLF, PowerWorld, ETAP, ASPEN One-Liner, EMTP-RV, MATLAB, RTDS, OPAL-RT

Programming & Automation: Python (PSSPY, PSCAD API), MATLAB, Fortran

Standards & Grid Codes: IEEE, IEC, NERC, IEEE 1547, IEEE 2800, CAISO Rule 21, ERCOT MQT, PJM & ISO-NE Model Requirements

Professional Experience

Tranzenergy global LLC. – Senior Power System Engineer 

Lead interconnection, EMT modeling, and transmission planning studies for utility-scale solar, wind, BESS, and large-load projects across ERCOT, MISO, PJM, SPP, SOCO, TVA, and WECC.

Execute transient stability, voltage stability, LVRT/FRT, grid compliance, and disturbance ride-through studies supporting Generator Interconnection Agreements.

Perform short-circuit, breaker duty, and switchgear sizing studies in compliance with IEEE and IEC standards.

Lead insulation coordination and switching transient investigations including transformer energization, cable energization, TRV, lightning impulse, and fast-front transients.

Drive SSO/SSR risk assessments using frequency-scan and impedance-based stability techniques for inverter-dominated grids.

Deliver contingency, thermal, voltage, and stability impact assessments for renewable and data-center interconnections.

Execute grid injections and hosting-capacity studies to support IPP siting decisions.

Perform production-cost modeling, congestion analysis, LMP forecasting, and curtailment studies.

Interface with OEMs to integrate and validate plant control systems.

Continuum Associates LLC – Lead Power System Engineer 

Directed dynamic, transient, frequency, and voltage stability studies for renewable and storage projects.

Built EMT models and executed switching transient, ferro-resonance, harmonic, and fast-front transient studies.

Led short-circuit, breaker rating study tasks.

Delivered insulation coordination studies covering lightning surge, transformer energization, GIS fast transients, and switching overvoltages.

Performed grid injection feasibility and transmission capacity studies for offshore wind developments.

Designed STATCOM, SVC, and capacitor bank solutions for voltage and reactive power support.

IIT Mandi – Research Assistant 

Developed real-time digital simulation platforms for microgrid protection and resilient grid operation research.

Led hardware-in-the-loop testing for inverter-dominated networks.

Contributed to WAMS-based adaptive protection and PMU-driven wide-area control strategies.

NIT Agartala – Teaching Assistant Conducted laboratory sessions on load flow, short-circuit, and stability simulation.

Supervised undergraduate research on machine-learning-based fault detection in transmission networks.

Keonjhar School of Engineering – Lecturer 

Taught Electrical Machines, Power Systems, Protection, Switchgear, High Voltage Engineering, and Power Electronics.

Established industry-academia collaboration programs and professional training workshops.
