CURRICULUM VITAE

Site Officer (Key Expert K-4)

Format: ADB / World Bank style, 13 numbered sections

Central Electricity Board – Republic of Mauritius

Procurement Reference: OAB-TD-2026-10068 (IFB 10748)

Consultancy Services for Technical Survey, Procurement and Project Management for the Major Maintenance of the 132 kV Transmission Lines in Mauritius

Submission deadline: 8 May 2026

Instructions for the Expert

This document is a template for the Curriculum Vitae of the Site Officer Key Expert (K-4) to be submitted within the Joint Venture proposal for the Central Electricity Board of the Republic of Mauritius procurement reference OAB-TD-2026-10068. The format follows the standard ADB / World Bank style required by CEB, organized in thirteen numbered sections.

Cells highlighted in light yellow contain placeholders to be filled in directly by the Expert. Cells highlighted in light green contain pre-filled content specific to the CEB assignment that the Expert is requested to confirm or refine, but should NOT be substantially altered without prior coordination with the Joint Venture lead. The text "[TO BE FILLED IN BY THE EXPERT]" must be replaced with the actual personal data, education, and employment record and assignment descriptions.

Section 12 (Work Undertaken that Best Illustrates Capability) is the most important section of the CV from a scoring perspective. The Expert is requested to provide TWO OR THREE detailed assignment descriptions that demonstrate direct experience on transmission line maintenance, tower climbing operations, supervision of works on energized or partially-energized infrastructure at 132 kV or above. Each description should be 150 to 200 words in narrative prose (not telegraphic bullet points) and must include: year and duration of the assignment, location, name of client, project description (voltage, length, number of towers, type of intervention), and position held, and detailed activities personally performed.

After completion, the Expert is requested to physically sign Section 13 (Certification) in the dedicated space, and to forward the signed document to the Joint Venture coordination by Wednesday 30 April 2026 at the latest, to allow joint review and integration into the final proposal package by 4 May 2026.

For any clarification or coordination need during the compilation of this CV, please contact: Jacopo Licheri (Business Development & Project Management, Studio Santi S.r.l.), email jacopo.licheri@studiosanti.eu, sales.project@studiosanti.eu

11. Detailed Tasks Assigned for this Project

This section is pre-filled with the specific responsibilities assigned to the Site Officer Key Expert in the CEB Mauritius assignment. The Expert is requested to confirm acceptance of these tasks. Refinement is possible upon coordination with the Joint Venture lead, but no substantial changes are expected at this stage.

Tasks:

• Lead all tower climbing and working-at-heights operations during Assignment 1 (Technical Survey) and Assignment 3 (Project Management Services) on the six 132 kV transmission lines comprising 234 lattice towers across approximately 60 km in the Republic of Mauritius.

• Conduct the detailed in-field condition assessment of the 234 lattice towers during the Assignment 1 site survey campaign, including visual inspection of tower structural members, hardware, insulators, conductor terminations, shield wire attachments, anti-climbing devices and earthing system, with photographic documentation and GPS-tagged reporting.

• Perform sample electrical accessory inspection at height, including isolators, suspension and tension hardware, anti-vibration dampers, spacer dampers and lightning arresters, in coordination with the Electrical/Power Engineer Key Expert.

• Lead the safety planning of the on-site activities, including the Job Hazard Analysis, the Method Statement for tower climbing operations, the rescue plan in case of fall or medical emergency at height, and the daily toolbox talks with the on-site team.

• Provide on-site supervision during Assignment 3 (Project Management Services) of the EPC contractor activities on tower maintenance, accessory replacement and aerial warning sphere installation, ensuring compliance with CEB technical specifications, with the live-line working procedures applicable to the operating voltage of 66 kV (lines designed for 132 kV but currently operated at 66 kV), and with the Mauritius Occupational Safety and Health Act 2005.

• Coordinate with CEB dispatching team on the daily outage planning for partial line de-energization windows, optimizing the maintenance schedule to minimize the impact on the national grid reliability.

• Sign-off on the satisfactory completion of each maintenance intervention per tower, with photographic evidence, certificate of conformity to CEB specifications, and updated condition record in the digital twin / asset management database (if implemented in the Assignment 1 deliverable).

• Train the CEB local staff on the tower climbing safety procedures, on the method statements applicable to the maintenance activities, and on the post-intervention condition assessment protocols, in coordination with the Assignment 3 training plan and with the TECH-7 capacity building deliverable of the joint proposal.

• Maintain permanent presence in Mauritius throughout the Assignment 3 implementation period (estimated 12 to 18 months), with operational base aligned with the CEB headquarters in Curepipe and field deployment along the six lines route.

This is the most heavily-scored section of the CV in the CEB technical evaluation. The Expert is requested to provide TWO OR THREE detailed assignment descriptions that demonstrate direct experience on transmission line maintenance, tower climbing operations, and supervision of works on lattice tower transmission infrastructure at 132 kV or above. Each description targets 150 to 200 words in narrative prose and must include the elements listed below.

 • Year and duration of the assignment (e.g. "From January 2022 to December 2023")

 • Location (country, region, route corridor)

 • Name of client (utility, EPC contractor, or owner)

 • Project description with technical specifications: voltage class, length, number of towers, tower type (lattice / pole / monopole), conductor type, and type of intervention (new construction, refurbishment, maintenance, and replacement)

 • Position held by the Expert (Site Officer, Site Engineer, Tower Climbing Supervisor, similar)

 • Detailed activities personally performed by the Expert (NOT generic project description, but the specific role and contributions of the Expert), including number of towers personally climbed and inspected, hours of live-line working performed, number of safety incidents managed, training delivered to local staff, and similar specific metrics

SUMMARY 
Recent Transportation Engineering graduate with expertise in machine learning algorithms for predicting the 
strength of concrete and expertise in Python. Strong teamwork and communication skills. I am now seeking to 
apply my expertise in a dynamic role that offers professional growth and the opportunity to make a meaningful 
impact in civil engineering.

and adherence to safety protocols.

construction management and teamwork.

theoretical concepts learned during academic studies.

tising Electrical Engineer with 17+ years of hands-on industry experience in high-voltage power 
infrastructure, large-scale erection and commissioning, and multi -contractor site management within a

entirety of a professional career has been spent in electrical power engineering. E recti on and commissioning of

ards, generators, generator transformers, protection and control systems, and DCS/SCADA 
infrastructure on major generation projects. Proven ability to supervise cross-functional site teams and right -
first- time delivery across complex electrical infrastructure programmes. Recognised for maintaining safety, 
quality, and programme discipline in demanding site environments, including emergency and fast -track 
scenarios. A committed people manager and technical mentor with strong commercial awareness, adept at 
managing budgets, records, and stakeholder relationships across the full project lifecycle.

Site Supervision & Safe Delivery HV Erection & Commissioning Multi-Contractor Management

Kerala State Electricity Board Ltd. (KSEB Ltd.) 
Assistant Engineer (Electrical) - Erection, Commissioning & Site Management 
Government Public Sector Utility | Kerala, India

Large Infrastructure Programme - 2×30MW Hydro Power Station (60MW total) 
§Directed erection and commissioning of a major 60MW power station involving international OEM

equipments), brought into successful commercial operation January 2025.

supervised execution, and maintained programme discipline across a multi-discipline, multi-contractor
workforce throughout the full erection and commissioning sequence.
§Supervised installation and commissioning of all primary and secondary electrical infrastructure:
generators, generator transformers, excitation systems, 220kV AIS switchyard (circuit breakers, isolators,
CTs, PTs, lightning arresters, control & relay panels), cooling water systems, ABB Symphony+ DCS
(SPC700 controllers, PN800 bus), and SCADA.
§Ensured all works were delivered compliant with engineering specifications, contract documents, and
regulatory requirements. R eviewed, modified, and finalised design specifications in line with contract
obligations throughout the project lifecycle.
§Produced and maintained all required commissioning records, test protocols, loop-check and cabl
e
schedule documents, and handover documentation in a timely and auditable manner.
§Actively managed and cared for the site workforce. Led toolbox talks, conducted risk assessments,
implemented EHS plans, and promoted a safe working culture across all contractor interfaces.
§Implemented fast-track execution strategies during COVID-19 site restrictions to maintain programme-
awarded Good Service Entry by KSEB Ltd. for sustained delivery under exceptional conditions.
§Received Special Mention Award (KSEB Engineers Association) for meritorious contribution to the
commissioning of the Pallivasal Extension Scheme HEP.

Additional Projects Delivered 
§ Erection and commissioning of 2×1MW Upper Kallar Small Hydro Power Plant (2022): coordinated a four-
party JV contractor, supervised all electrical works from cable installation through to synchronisation and 
handover. 
§ Erection and commissioning of 3×1.4MW Sengulam Pump House, vertical turbine pump station (2021): 
led site team through installation, testing, and commissioning in record time-awarded Good Service Entry 
for fast-track delivery. 
§ Member of Technical Experts Committee (Generation), KSEB Ltd., contributed to design review and 
technical governance across the organisation's generation infrastructure. 
§ Member of Technical Advisory Committees for 40MW Thottiyar HEP and 24MW Chinnar Small HEP: 
reviewed specifications, assessed contractor proposals, and provided independent technical 
recommendations. 
§ Technical Training Faculty at NPTI/PETARC-KSEB: designed and delivered engineering training, 
building site team capability and technical competence. 
Kerala State Electricity Board Ltd. (KSEB Ltd.) 
Assistant Engineer (Electrical) - HV Testing, Condition Monitoring & Compliance 
Government Public Sector Utility | Kerala, India 
2017-2020 
§ Managed pre-commissioning, routine, and emergency HV testing across all KSEB generating stations- 
equipment ranging from 3.3kV to 220kV- including generators, power and generator transformers, CTs, 
PTs, circuit breakers, surge arresters, and grounding transformers. 
§ Managed the electrical restoration of 12 generating stations following the 2018 Kerala floods, coordinating 
emergency works under extreme conditions to restore generation capacity; awarded Good Service Entry 
for flood restoration of Madupetty HEP. 
§ Developed and maintained contingency plans for critical assets (transformers, generators), ensuring rapid 
deployment capability to minimise downtime in the event of failure-directly enhancing system resilience. 
§ Supervised, trained, and developed a team of site testing engineers, ensuring the department maintained 
full competence across all planned and reactive testing activities. 
§ Approved technical drawings for power equipment at stations under construction, contributing to design 
compliance and right-first-time installation outcomes. 
§ Testing portfolio included: Tan Delta, Insulation Resistance, Polarisation Index, HVDC Withstand, 
Dynamic Contact Resistance (circuit breakers), Contact Resistance (cables), Surge Arrester reliability, 
Generator Rotor impedance measurement, and third harmonic leakage current monitoring. 
Kerala State Electricity Board Ltd. (KSEB Ltd.) 
Assistant Engineer (Electrical) — Operations & Maintenance, 780MW Hydro Station 
Government Public Sector Utility | Idukki, Kerala, India 
July 2013 – 2017 
§ Responsible for operation and maintenance of the 780MW (6×130MW) Idukki underground hydro power

switchyard systems.

Woodward. Maintained turbines, spherical and butterfly valves up to 2.5m diameter at pressures up to 70

§ Prepared annual departmental O&M budget forecasts; managed critical spares inventory and long-term 
maintenance planning to minimise unplanned outages. 
§ Led a team of 20 site staff in emergency breakdown maintenance of a 1.6m spherical valve- completed

candidates.rawText:
RESUME 
 Gaurav Sony 
Objective: To secure a challenging role in the energy EPC/PMC sector where I can leverage my 
technical and managerial strengths, while contributing to organizational growth and taking on 
increasing responsibilities. 
•A results-driven professional with 10+ years of comprehensive experience in PMC/EPC 
power projects, covering both technical and commercial domains.
•Proven expertise in execution, testing, and commissioning of transmission systems up to 400 
kV, including retrofitting works.
•Extensive experience in handling EHV transmission lines and substation projects, ensuring 
timely and quality project delivery.
•Strong leadership skills with the ability to manage teams effectively and foster a high- 
performance work environment.
•Excellent techno-commercial, coordination, and problem-solving skills, with the ability to 
work in multi-stakeholder and multicultural environments.
•Hands-on experience in AIS/GIS substations, foundation works, erection, stringing, and 
project execution lifecycle.
•Proficient in quality assurance (FQP), site safety compliance, contractor billing 
certification, joint measurements, and material reconciliation.
•Bid Documentation & Proposal Management for EOI/RFP/PMC Consultancy Projects.
•Preparation of Technical Proposals, DPR Support Documents, Manpower Deployment planning 
and Tender Compliance Documentation.
•Experience in Infrastructure, Transmission & Substation Consultancy Bid Preparation.
Key Skills and Competencies 
•Transmission Line (HV & EHV) Engineering & Execution - Comprehensive experience in
survey, design, planning, and execution of HV & EHV transmission lines up to 220 kV.
Expertise in foundation, tower erection, stringing, and commissioning of transmission lines.
•Substation Construction & Commissioning - Expertise in AIS (132/33 kV) and GIS (33/11
kV) substations, including installation and commissioning of transformers, switchgear, circuit
breakers, and protection systems.
•Civil & Electrical Engineering - Strong knowledge of civil structures, foundations, and
electrical systems related to transmission and substation projects. Expertise in concrete and
steel structures, soil testing, grounding, and earthing systems.
•Project Coordination & Stakeholder Management -
➢Coordination with PIU, clients, contractors, and government authorities.
➢Preparation of MPR, QPR, statutory reports, GTP/MQP approvals, and project
documentation.
➢Liaison with Railways, Highways, Forest, and Telecom authorities for approvals.
•Contract & Commercial Management -
➢Understanding of power sector contracts, including TBCB tenders.
➢Experience in billing, BOQ preparation, cost control, and contractor management.
•Execution & Site Management
➢End-to-end handling of electrical execution, testing, and commissioning up to 400 kV.
➢Ensuring compliance with drawings, specifications, quality standards, and safety protocols.
•Testing & Commissioning Expertise - Hands-on experience in testing and commissioning of
SF6 Circuit Breakers, CTs, CVTs, VCB panels, transformers, cables, and switchyard equipment.
•Planning, MIS & Resource Management
➢Project planning, scheduling, and monitoring. MIS reporting, material planning, store
management, and audit. Contractor material reconciliation and inventory control.

Work Experience (Transmission, Distribution, Grid Sub-station, MEP & PMC) 
 
Feedback Infra (Dec 2022 – Till Date) 
Assistant Manager (Project Execution) Client – JUSNL 
Location – Ranchi, Jharkhand 
Project Overview: World Bank (WB) is supporting Jharkhand Urja Sancharan Nigam Limited 
(JUSNL) with a loan of US$310 million to achieve the ‘24/7 Power for All’ goal of the Government 
of the Jharkhand (GOJ). JUSNL is using the fund to construct substations and transmission lines to 
evacuate power from upcoming generation plants of 4.3 GW capacity and to support the availability of 
electricity in all corners of the state of Jharkhand. This World Bank Funded Transmission Project of 
JUSNL under JPSIP (Jharkhand Power System Improvement Project) scheme has been divided into 
16 Packages, which includes 8 Nos of 132/33 Grid Substation Packages having capacity of 2*50 
MVA each and 8 Nos of Transmission Lines Packages having total length of 2244 CKM. The overall 
project is divided into Package-1 as Zone-1 (Ranchi) & Zone-2 (Dumka) and Package-2 as Zone-3 
(Jamshedpur) and Zone-4 (Daltonganj) in Jharkhand District. 
 
Project Name: Procurement of Consulting Services for Project Management Consultant to support 
JUSNL in Implementation of World Bank Funded Transmission Line & Sub-station Contracts in Zone-I 
(Ranchi) and Zone-II (Dumka) under package-1. 
 
M/s Feedback Infra has been appointed as PMC for Package-1. The scope of the work is to deliver 
services for Transmission Projects consisting of 12 Grid Substations of 2X50 MVA capacity each and 
1030 CKM of 132 kV Transmission Lines in Ranchi and Dumka Zone. 
I have been appointed to the Ranchi Zone for execution of transmission projects comprising 
approximately 550 ckm of lines and 6 (six) substations along-with 2(two) bay extensions. Each zone is 
supported by a team of around 20 key and non-key experts, including Site Engineers (Electrical & Civil), 
Social Safeguard Experts, Environmental Experts with their associates, along with a Safety Engineer, 
Inspection Engineer, and Technical Assistant. My key responsibilities include. 
• Supervised end-to-end construction of EHV transmission lines, including route survey, 
foundation construction, tower erection, and conductor stringing. 
• Managed AIS substation installation, ensuring seamless integration of transformers, switchgear, 
and protection systems. 
• Oversaw material procurement, vendor coordination, and logistics management, ensuring 
timely availability of critical components. 
• Conducted technical troubleshooting for on-site issues related to civil and electrical 
infrastructure, preventing project delays. 
• Ensured adherence to contract specifications, quality assurance measures, and safety protocols 
at all project stages. 
• Coordinate and follow up with Railways, National Highways, Telecom department, Forest 
authorities etc. for approvals. 
 
Tetra Tech (Mar 2022 – Oct 2022) 
Technical Assistant to Project Director Client – JUSNL 
Location - Jharkhand 
(On Contract till Oct’22 with Ohm Encon Pvt Ltd, Sama Savli Road, Vadodara) 
Project Name: Procurement of Consulting Services for Project Management Consultant to support 
JUSNL in Implementation of World Bank Funded Transmission Line & Sub-station Contracts in Zone-III 
(Jamshedpur) and Zone-IV (Daltonganj) under package-2. 
 
M/s Tetra Tech. has been appointed as PMC for Package-2. The scope of the work is to deliver services 
for Transmission Projects consisting of 12 Grid Substations of 2X50 MVA capacity each and 1214 
CKM of 132 kV Transmission Lines in Jamshedpur and Daltonganj Zone. 

I have been appointed to the Jamshedpur Zone for execution of transmission projects comprising 
approximately 650 ckm of lines and 6 (six) substations along-with 2(two) bay extensions. Each zone is 
supported by a team of around 20 key and non-key experts, including Site Engineers (Electrical & Civil), 
Social Safeguard Experts, Environmental Experts with their associates, along with a Safety Engineer, 
Inspection Engineer, and Technical Assistant. My key responsibilities include. 
•Supervised end-to-end construction of EHV transmission lines, including route survey,
foundation construction, tower erection, and conductor stringing.
•Managed AIS substation installation, ensuring seamless integration of transformers, switchgear,
and protection systems.
•Oversaw material procurement, vendor coordination, and logistics management, ensuring
timely availability of critical components.
•Conducted technical troubleshooting for on-site issues related to civil and electrical
infrastructure, preventing project delays.
•Ensured adherence to contract specifications, quality assurance measures, and safety protocols
at all project stages.
•Coordinate and follow up with Railways, National Highways, Telecom department, Forest
authorities etc. for approvals.
FABRITECH CONSTRUCTION AND SERVICES PVT. LTD. (Feb 2021 - Mar 2022) 
Project Coordinator/Project In-charge Client – MVML & John Deere 
Location – Pune, Maharashtra 
Worked in Paint Shop at Mahindra Vehicles Manufacturing Limited with Sterling & Wilson, Chakan, 
Pune and at John Deere Technology Center with Schneider Electric, Magarpatta, Pune for Fire Alarm 
System. Having hands-on experience in executing and managing Industrial and Commercial projects in 
which the work of Electrification was done including the following: 
•Power and Data cabling work of different sizes and cores including laying, gland, and
termination of different sizes and cores.
•Fabrication and erection of support for cable trays, Earthing, and its arrangement as per the site
condition.
•Installation of 16 Nos. 11kV/0.44 KV 3.25 MVA and 22/0.44 KV 2.5 MVA dry type distribution
transformer with HV supply, LV supply with Bus Duct, Installation of Breakers and its associated
body earthing and neutral work.
•Installation of UPS with its battery connections, coupling, and installation of different HT & LT
panels
•Installation of various lights and luminaries with its fixture and junction boxes.
•Installation of Smoke Detectors and Speakers with Panel for FAS.
KPM INFRA PVT. LTD. (Nov 2019 - Feb 2021) 
Project Engineer Client- DVC & JBVNL 
Location - Jharkhand 
•Construction of Bays at different Sub-Stations (220/132/33) and Powerhouse Switchyard for
Jharkhand and West Bengal under Damodar Valley Corporation (DVC).
•Construction of 33/11 KV GIS Sub-Station (2*10 MVA) for Dhanbad Town and Bokaro
Industrial Area under Jharkhand Sampurana Bijli Achchadhan Yojana (JSBAY) on behalf of
JBVNL.
•Overhead and underground cabling of 33kV, and 11kV Lines for Dhanbad town on behalf of
JBVNL.

RAJ SHYAMA CONSTRUCTIONS PVT. LTD. (July 2015 - Nov 2019) 
Project Engineer Client-PTCUL & UPCL 
Location - Uttarakhand 
 
• Construction of Bays and Retrofitting work at different Sub-Stations (400/220/132/33 KV) for 
Uttarakhand District at different sites- Rishikesh, Dehradun, Haridwar, Roorkee, etc under PSDF 
scheme on behalf of PTCUL. 
• Construction of LILO (5.3 CKT KM) of 132 KV Dhalipur-Purukul line at 220 KV substation 
Dehradun. 
• Construction of LILO (10.86 CKT KM) of 220 KV D/C Puhana-SIDCUL Line at 220 KV Substation 
at Piran Kaliyar. 220 KV Piran-Kaliyar Substation has been connected to Northern Grid to 400 
KV substation (PGCIL) through this line. 
• Construction of 220 KV D/C Twin Zebra line (12.3 CKT KM) from 400 KV S/s PGCIL, Dehradun

DETAILED ASSIGNMENT DESCRIPTIONS

ASSIGNMENT 1: Construction Supervision, Testing & Commissioning of 220kV / 33kV Substation and Associated Transmission Lines

Period:

February 2021 – Present (Ongoing)

Employer:

M/s Tecsupport (On Contract to Utkal Alumina International Ltd)

Position:

Shift Engineer – Electrical (Construction Supervision, Testing, Commissioning & O&M)

Project Location:

Tikiri, Rayagada District, Odisha, India

Project Description:

Construction, erection, testing, commissioning, and ongoing operation & maintenance of a 220kV / 33kV switchyard, 33kV Gas Insulated Switchgear (GIS) substation, and associated EHV transmission infrastructure for a large-scale alumina refinery and captive power complex.

Voltage Levels:

220kV EHV, 33kV HV, 0.4kV LV

Key Equipment:

30/40/50 MVA Power Transformers, 10 MVA Isolation Transformer, 220kV Control & Relay (CR) Panels, 33kV GIS, SF6 Circuit Breakers, VCBs, CTs, CVTs, LAs, Isolators, Battery Banks, DC Systems, 29 km 220kV OHL, 18 km 33kV Mine Transmission Line

Duties and Responsibilities during Construction, Testing & Commissioning:

Supervised the civil-electrical interface works for the 220kV / 33kV switchyard, including foundation excavation, reinforcement, PCC/RCC works for transformer foundations, breaker plinths, control room building, and cable trench networks, ensuring compliance with design drawings and IS codes.

Supervised the erection and alignment of 30/40/50 MVA power transformers and 10 MVA isolation transformer, including unloading, oil filling, bushing installation, cooler bank assembly, and control wiring termination as per manufacturer specifications and CEA guidelines.

Supervised the installation of 220kV Control & Relay (CR) Panels, including panel erection, relay wiring, CT/VT secondary connections, communication cabling, and SCADA interface commissioning.

Supervised the installation and commissioning of 33kV Gas Insulated Switchgear (GIS) from reputed OEMs, including bay assembly, SF6 gas filling, vacuum testing, HV testing, and functional checks of circuit breakers, disconnectors, and earth switches.

Supervised the erection of 220kV and 33kV outdoor switchyard equipment including SF6 circuit breakers, vacuum circuit breakers (VCB), current transformers (CT), capacitive voltage transformers (CVT), lightning arresters (LA), wave traps (WT), and isolators, ensuring proper clearances, alignment, and torque compliance.

Supervised the stringing and tensioning of a 29 km 220kV overhead transmission line (OHL), including tower foundation inspection, tower erection supervision, conductor and earth wire installation, insulator stringing, and sag adjustment as per design specifications.

Supervised the construction and commissioning of an 18 km 33kV mine transmission line, including route survey verification, pole erection, conductor installation, and terminations at both substation and mine ends.

Conducted pre-commissioning tests on all switchyard equipment including insulation resistance (IR) tests, polarity checks, ratio tests on CTs/CVTs, SF6 gas purity and dew point tests, contact resistance measurements, and breaker timing tests.

Conducted transformer oil testing (BDV, moisture content, acidity, interfacial tension) and winding resistance measurements on all power transformers prior to energization.

Prepared and reviewed Standard Operating Procedures (SOP), Standard Maintenance Procedures (SMP), Job Safety Analysis (JSA), and Standard Work Instructions (SWI) for all electrical construction and commissioning activities.

Issued and audited electrical permit-to-work systems in strict compliance with Indian Electricity Rules and Electrical Safety Regulations, ensuring zero safety incidents during the construction and commissioning phase.

Coordinated with contractors, OEM representatives, and third-party testing agencies for timely completion of construction, erection, testing, and commissioning activities within the project schedule.

Maintained detailed as-built documentation, test reports, commissioning certificates, and equipment dossiers for handover to the client's O&M team.

Managed inventory control and spare parts planning for all electrical equipment, ensuring adequate stock of critical spares for both construction and post-commissioning O&M phases.

ASSIGNMENT 2: Construction Supervision, Expansion & Upgradation of 132kV / 33kV Grid Substation and Associated Transmission Infrastructure

Period:

December 2005 – February 2021

Employer:

Odisha Power Transmission Corporation Ltd (OPTCL) – Government of Odisha

Position:

Shift Engineer – Electrical (Construction Supervision, O&M & Commissioning)

Project Location:

132/33kV Grid Substation, Kamakhyanagar, Dhenkanal District, Odisha, India

Project Description:

Supervision of construction, expansion, upgradation, testing, commissioning, and ongoing operation & maintenance of a 132kV / 33kV / 0.4kV grid substation serving as a critical node in the Odisha State Transmission Network. The substation underwent multiple capacity enhancement phases during the assignment tenure.

Voltage Levels:

132kV EHV, 33kV HV, 0.4kV LV

Key Equipment:

2 x 12.5 MVA + 1 x 20 MVA Power Transformers (132/33kV), 33/0.4kV Distribution Transformers (2 x 250 kVA), SF6 & Vacuum CBs, CTs, CVTs, LAs, Isolators, 132kV DC Line Feeders, Battery Banks, Control Room SCADA

Duties and Responsibilities during Construction, Expansion & Commissioning:

Supervised the construction and commissioning of the 132kV / 33kV grid substation during initial erection and subsequent capacity expansion phases, including the installation of additional 20 MVA power transformer and associated bay equipment.

Supervised the civil works for transformer foundations, breaker plinths, control room, switchyard grading, drainage, and fencing, ensuring compliance with OPTCL technical specifications and CPWD/CEA standards.

Supervised the erection of 132kV outdoor switchyard equipment including SF6 circuit breakers, vacuum circuit breakers, current transformers, capacitive voltage transformers, lightning arresters, wave traps, and motor-operated isolators.

Supervised the installation, oil filling, and commissioning of 2 x 12.5 MVA and 1 x 20 MVA power transformers (132/33kV), including bushing fitting, cooler bank piping, control cabinet wiring, and protection relay coordination.

Supervised the installation of 33/0.4kV distribution transformers (2 x 250 kVA) for auxiliary power supply to the substation, including LV panel installation, cabling, and earthing system.

Supervised the laying and termination of 132kV XLPE underground cables and overhead line connections between the substation and the 132kV DC transmission line corridor.

Conducted pre-commissioning and commissioning tests on all new and upgraded equipment, including insulation resistance tests, CT/CVT ratio and polarity tests, breaker timing and contact resistance tests, and transformer oil analysis.

Supervised the installation and commissioning of substation automation and SCADA systems in the control room, including RTU configuration, communication link testing, and remote monitoring validation with the State Load Dispatch Centre (SLDC).

Coordinated with DISCOM (Distribution Company) representatives for load transfer scheduling, shutdown planning, and energization sequencing during substation expansion works, ensuring minimal disruption to consumers.

Supervised the installation and testing of lead-acid battery banks and DC chargers (110V / 220V), including load testing, float/charge cycle verification, and battery capacity discharge tests.

Maintained detailed construction progress reports, material reconciliation statements, and as-built drawings for all expansion and upgradation works, ensuring complete documentation for audit and handover.

Conducted regular safety audits and toolbox talks for contractor workforces, enforcing compliance with Indian Electricity Rules, Electrical Safety Regulations, and OPTCL safety protocols during all construction and maintenance activities.

Liaised with local government authorities, district administration, and forest/revenue departments for obtaining necessary approvals, Right-of-Way (RoW) clearances, and statutory compliance for substation expansion and transmission line works.

Managed spare parts inventory, procurement requisitions, and vendor coordination for both construction phase material supply and ongoing O&M requirements.

TRAINING, CERTIFICATIONS & PROFESSIONAL DEVELOPMENT

Electrical Safety Rules and Permit-to-Work Systems – OPTCL In-House Training

Substation Operation & Maintenance – OPTCL Technical Training Centre

SF6 Gas Handling and Safety – OEM Training (Siemens / ABB / CGL)

Transformer Testing and Condition Monitoring – OEM Training

SCADA / DMS System Operation – State Load Dispatch Centre (SLDC) Orientation

First Aid and Fire Safety – Industrial Safety Certification

MS Office, Windows Applications, and Internet Applications – Self-Certified Proficiency

PROFESSIONAL MEMBERSHIPS & AFFILIATIONS

Life Member / Registered Electrical Engineer – State Electrical Licensing Board, Odisha

Member – Odisha Power Transmission Corporation Ltd (OPTCL) Employees' Technical Association

Active Participant – CEA Workshops on Grid Safety and Substation Modernization

COMPUTER SKILLS & SOFTWARE PROFICIENCY

Well-versed with MS Windows Operating System, Microsoft Office Suite (Word, Excel, PowerPoint, Outlook), and Internet Applications. Proficient in preparing technical reports, project documentation, test reports, and presentation materials using MS Office. Familiar with basic SCADA/DMS HMI interfaces, EMS control panels, and digital monitoring systems.

AVINASH DEEP

Transmission Line Engineer | PMC Professional — Foundation, Erection & Stringing

avinashjsr110@gmail.com | 07091898455, 06205639435

Proposed Position: Project Manager / PMC Team Member

Nationality: Indian

Date of Birth: 04 March 1978

Education: B. Tech, Electrical Engineering (2007)

Total Experience: 16+ Years — Transmission Sector

Software: MS Office (Word, Excel, PowerPoint)

Profile Summary

16+ years of continuous experience in India's power transmission sector, spanning EHV transmission lines (132kV to 400kV Double Circuit) and substation works. Career progression moves from hands-on site execution to project management and client-side quality/PMC oversight, giving him the ability to evaluate contractor performance across the complete construction lifecycle — foundation, erection, stringing, and sag-tension verification — while also managing client-contractor-HO coordination typical of PMC assignments.

Core Technical Strength — Foundation, Erection & Stringing

A recurring thread across nearly every assignment is hands-on responsibility for the three critical construction phases of a transmission line:

Foundation work: Tower foundation execution and supervision across multiple projects, including specialised Ganga pile foundation work (New Purnia–Bihar Sharif Line) — a technically demanding riverbed/deep foundation technique — plus equipment and power transformer foundations at substations.

Erection: Tower erection supervision as per FQP (Field Quality Plan), from early site roles (Tata Projects, Jyoti Structures) through to site-in-charge assignments (Aravali Infrapower).

Stringing & Sag-Tension Checking: Direct experience in conductor stringing operations, including verification of sag and tension parameters during stringing — a critical quality-control step ensuring conductor ground clearance, tension limits, and line safety standards as per design/QAP. Covered under the 400kV DC Redo–Patiala Line (Aravali Infrapower) and the New Purnia–Bihar Sharif Line (Intertek Moody International), where full charge of foundation, erection, and stringing works was held.

This foundation-to-stringing continuity gives him command of the complete electro-mechanical construction sequence of a line — valuable for PMC oversight, where sag/tension and clearance checks are frequent points of contractor non-compliance.

Employment Record

Mar 2021 – 15 Aug 2023 Manager, Material Quality Section — Feedback Infra Pvt Ltd

132kV various projects (World Bank Project) under JUSNL, Ranchi

Client: JUSNL

Quality checking of materials and construction as per MQP and BOQ for Sub-Stations (SS) and Transmission Lines (TL).

May 2019 – 28 Feb 2021 Sr. Manager, Material Quality Section — Medhaj Techno Concept Pvt Ltd

132kV Non-World Bank Project under JUSNL, Ranchi

Client: JUSNL

Quality checking as per MQP and BOQ for Sub-Stations (SS) and Transmission Lines (TL).

Sep 2013 – Apr 2019 Project Manager — JBS Enterprises Pvt Ltd

Managed two concurrent transmission line projects — Full charge: 400kV DC New Purnia–Bihar Sharif Line (Bihar); Additional charge: 400kV DC Siliguri–Bongaigaon Line (WB)

Client: Sterlite Grid

Overall management of civil construction works, including foundation and erection, across both projects concurrently.

Jul 2012 – Aug 2013 Site In-charge — Intertek Moody International (I) Pvt Ltd

400kV DC New Purnia–Bihar Sharif Line

Client: Sterlite Grid

All civil works of line construction including Ganga pile foundation work, tower erection, and conductor stringing; ROW issue resolution for the project.

Feb 2011 – May 2012 Sr. Engineer cum Site In-charge — Aravali Infrapower Limited

400kV DC Redo–Patiala Line, including Indian Railway track height-increasing work on an electrified line

Client: Power Grid Corporation of India Ltd

Full charge of civil works of line — foundation, erection, and stringing work, including sag and tension checking during conductor stringing; ROW issue resolution for the project.

Jan 2009 – Jan 2011 Site Engineer — Jyoti Structures Limited

400kV DC Vadavi–Kansari Line (Package-3)

Client: Reliance Energy Ltd

Foundation and erection supervision as per FQP; planning and scheduling of transmission line works.

Aug 2007 – Dec 2008 Asst. Engineer — Tata Projects Ltd

132kV Jojobera Project, Jamshedpur

Client: Tata Power

Foundation and erection supervision as per FQP.

Why This Maps Well to a PMC Role

Client-side quality oversight experience: 4.5 years representing the client's (JUSNL) interest in monitoring contractor compliance.

Complete construction-cycle expertise: Foundation → erection → stringing → sag-tension verification, giving the technical depth to check contractor work at every stage of line construction, not just administratively.

Multi-voltage class exposure: 132kV, 220kV, and 400kV Double Circuit lines.

World Bank project familiarity: Direct experience on a World Bank-funded transmission scheme (Feedback Infra/JUSNL) — relevant for PMC contracts tied to internationally funded projects.

Standard PMC deliverables already in skillset: client/contractor/HO coordination, progress meetings, drawing review (400/220/132/33kV lines & substations), DPR/MPR monitoring, FQP/QAP-based inspection, joint measurement sheet verification for billing, and civil compliance audits.

Key Responsibilities Across Career

Coordinating between clients, contractors, and regional/head office for project progress; conducting daily, weekly, and monthly review meetings with client, contractor, and executing staff.

Drawing study for 400/220/132/33kV Substation and Transmission Line works.

Detailed supervision as per FQP for Transmission Line & Sub-Station construction.

Monitoring DPR (Daily Progress Report) and MPR (Monthly Progress Report) with the project team.

Checking erection plans and material availability as per AFC drawings and QAP; conducting site inspections.

Job supervision of civil portions for 400/220/132/33kV Transmission Line & Sub-Station works — power transformer foundations, equipment foundations, tower foundations, RCC roads, and residential buildings.

Verification of Joint Measurement Sheets for Substation and Transmission Line billing.

Project billing oversight — client/contractor/sub-contractor billing for erection, supply, freight, and PV bills.

Monitoring contractor compliance with legal and statutory requirements.

Site audits to verify civil compliance status of contractors as per project requirements.

Education & Experience Summary

Education: B. Tech in Electrical Engineering, 2007.

Total Experience in Transmission Sector: 16+ years.

Project Manager (Project): 9.11 years

Site In-charge of Line: 1.2 years

Sr. Engineer: 1.4 years

Project Engineer: 2 years

Asst. Engineer: 2 years

Relevant Experience: Transmission Line & Sub-Station Work — 16+ years.

Address

Local Address: Flat No. 1A, OAK Forest Society, Pundag Road, Ranchi, Jharkhand — 834002

Permanent Address: Vill. Ratanua, Anchal – Deo, Post & Dist. Aurangabad, Bihar — 824002

Complete construction-cycle expertise: Foundation erection stringing sag-tension verification, giving the technical depth to check contractor work at every stage of line construction, not just administratively.
Multi-voltage class exposure: 132kV, 220kV, and 400kV Double Circuit lines.
World Bank project familiarity: Direct experience on a World Bank-funded transmission scheme (Feedback Infra/JUSNL) - relevant for PMC contracts tied to internationally funded projects.
Standard PMC deliverables already in skillset: client/contractor/HO coordination, progress meetings, drawing review (400/220/132/33kV lines & substations), DPR/MPR monitoring, FQP/QAP-based inspection, joint measurement sheet verification for billing, and civil compliance audits.
Key Responsibilities Across Career
Coordinating between clients, contractors, and regional/head office for project progress; conducting daily, weekly, and monthly review meetings with client, contractor, and executing staff.
Drawing study for 400/220/132/33kV Substation and Transmission Line works.
Detailed supervision as per FQP for Transmission Line & Sub-Station construction.
Monitoring DPR (Daily Progress Report) and MPR (Monthly Progress Report) with the project team.
Checking erection plans and material availability as per AFC drawings and QAP; conducting site inspections.
Job supervision of civil portions for 400/220/132/33kV Transmission Line & Sub-Station works - power transformer foundations, equipment foundations, tower foundations, RCC roads, and residential buildings.
Verification of Joint Measurement Sheets for Substation and Transmission Line billing.
Project billing oversight - client/contractor/sub-contractor billing for erection, supply, freight, and PV bills.
Monitoring contractor compliance with legal and statutory requirements.
Site audits to verify civil compliance status of contractors as per project requirements.

Power Systems Sales & Business Development Leader | P&L Management | SCADA/ADMS/EMS/OMS | Grid Automation | EPC Integration

Mobile: +91-8700011719 | Email: aman.chhabra@gmail.com | Location: New Delhi, India 

EXECUTIVE SUMMARY

A seasoned Power Systems Sales & Business Development Leader with over 20 years of progressive experience in grid automation, transmission & distribution solutions, and utility software sales. Proven track record of owning and driving P&L for business units, winning large multi-crore utility tenders, and delivering complex EPC and system integration projects across SCADA, ADMS, EMS, OMS, and Substation Automation domains. Deep expertise in the Indian utility ecosystem with extensive CXO-level relationships at State DISCOMs, Central Transmission Utilities (CTU), and private power producers. Strong commercial-technical hybrid profile with hands-on experience in solution architecture, tender strategy, bid management, project execution, and commissioning of mission-critical grid automation systems.

Key Value Propositions for L&T Digital Energy Solutions:

P&L Leadership: Direct ownership of EU P&L at Bidgely Technologies and Utility Business Unit P&L at Vodafone Idea, demonstrating full accountability for revenue growth, margins, and order booking.

Large Deal Wins: Proven record of winning and executing SCADA/EMS/RLDC tenders for 400kV and above substations, R-APDRP projects, and large-scale grid automation deployments at State and Central utilities.

Technical-Commercial Hybrid: Unique blend of deep domain knowledge in SCADA/ADMS/EMS/OMS/DERMS platforms with strong commercial acumen, enabling effective solution positioning against global competitors (Siemens, GE, ABB, OSI).

Utility Ecosystem Mastery: Extensive network across Indian utilities, OEMs, and system integrators; deep understanding of CEA regulations, R-APDRP frameworks, Smart Grid guidelines, and World Bank/ADB/KfW funded project procurement cycles.

End-to-End Execution: Experience spanning pre-sales solutioning, tender bid strategy, technical design, deployment, commissioning, and post-sales support – ensuring on-time, on-cost delivery of complex grid projects.

Team Building & Scale: Led multidisciplinary teams across sales, engineering, and project delivery; hired and mentored talent in fast-growth environments; scaled operations from single-person setups to full-fledged delivery teams.

Develop partner ecosystem with system integrators and technology providers to accelerate market penetration and localization of offerings.

Lead tender response for large utility analytics procurements, managing complete bid lifecycle from opportunity identification to contract award.

Lead and won many WB/ADB funded PMC projects with international partners as JV/Sub-cons

Key Responsibilities & Achievements:

Own full P&L for European business unit, accountable for order booking, revenue growth, and margin delivery across UK, Nordics, and Continental European markets.

Strategize and position Bidgely's AI-driven energy disaggregation platform country-wise, targeting relevant DSOs, retailers, and regulatory bodies aligned with EU Green Deal and Net Zero targets.

Actively engage with C-level executives at DSOs and energy retailers to demonstrate ROI of energy efficiency products, leading to pilot-to-production conversions.

Evaluated and pursued railway and pipeline SCADA and communication opportunities, expanding KEC's market footprint beyond traditional utility T&D into industrial automation and transport infrastructure.

Represented KEC at major industry conferences, CEA workshops, and utility forums, establishing thought leadership and expanding the company's brand presence in the automation space.

Led sales and marketing for Innovari's grid edge and demand response solutions across India and Asia. Managed the complete sales pipeline from lead generation to order closure, including partner development for local implementation and support.

Managed the complete sales pipeline for India and Asia, targeting renewals and new business at State and Central utilities with Innovari's grid-edge analytics and demand response platform.

Delivered high-impact client presentations to utility CTOs, CEOs, and regulatory commissioners, demonstrating the value of grid-edge intelligence for loss reduction and demand optimization.

Owned full sales lifecycle management – from sales initiation and management approvals to final Purchase Order execution and post-sales relationship management.

Developed new implementation partners across India and Southeast Asia, building a local delivery ecosystem to support rapid deployment and after-sales service.

OPEN SYSTEMS INTERNATIONAL (OSI), India (SCADA/EMS/DMS/OMS Software)

Project Manager – SCADA/EMS & RLDC Projects | July 2012 – January 2017

Single-person hire responsible for establishing OSI's India operations, including office setup, recruitment, vendor management, and project delivery. Led all R-APDRP and RLDC (400kV & above) SCADA/EMS projects won by OSI in India and Asia, managing complete technical implementation from design to commissioning.

Key Responsibilities & Achievements:

Established OSI's India operations from scratch, handling office setup, team recruitment, vendor onboarding, and operational processes to create a fully functional delivery centre.

Served as Project Manager for all R-APDRP and RLDC SCADA/EMS projects (400kV and above) won by OSI in India, delivering on-time, on-budget implementations across multiple State utilities.

Managed complete technical implementation including system design, RTU/IED integration, database configuration, HMI development, testing, commissioning, and final handover to client operations teams.

Led complete proposal and bid management work for SCADA/EMS and RLDC projects across India and Asia, ensuring technical compliance, commercial competitiveness, and win-rate optimization.

Developed strategic implementation partnerships with local system integrators and OEMs to strengthen OSI's delivery capability and market presence in the Indian subcontinent.

Managed cross-functional project teams comprising software engineers, SCADA specialists, communication engineers, and commissioning experts, ensuring rigorous project governance and risk mitigation.

TATA POWER DELHI DISTRIBUTION LIMITED (TPDDL), India (Integrated Power Utility)

Internal Sales Manager & Domain Expert – SCADA / DMS / EMS / OMS | September 2006 – July 2012

Served as Contracts Manager and Domain Expert for Outage Management System (OMS) within Tata Power's Automation Group. Led the SCADA/DMS/EMS implementation on 54 substations (400kV, 220kV, 66kV), managed vendor selection, and drove business process engineering for grid automation.

Key Responsibilities & Achievements:

Served as Domain Expert and Contracts Manager for the Outage Management System (OMS), managing vendor contracts, SLA compliance, and performance benchmarking for grid automation vendors.

Part of the core team implementing the Smart Grid Pilot for Tata Power, integrating advanced metering, SCADA, and DMS functionalities to demonstrate next-generation distribution management capabilities.

Provided SCADA/GIS consulting to a Mumbai-based power utility and automation systems consulting to a government utility, delivering vendor-neutral technology assessments and implementation roadmaps.

Led the SCADA/DMS/EMS implementation across 54 substations (400kV, 220kV, 66kV), coordinating with GE, Siemens, Oracle, and other OEMs for seamless integration and commissioning.

Developed Business Requirement Documents (BRD) for enterprise reporting tools, evaluating vendor responses, conducting product demonstrations, and selecting optimal solutions for executive dashboards and MIS.

Created executive dashboards with drill-down capabilities for senior management, along with department-specific operational reports, enabling data-driven decision-making across the organization.

Provided technical assistance to the Energy Audit Group from an automation perspective, enabling accurate loss analysis and load forecasting through integrated SCADA and metering data.

Established and maintained the In-House Knowledge Base for the Automation Group, ensuring institutional knowledge retention and rapid onboarding of new team members.

Managed electronic and electrical engineering projects from initial client requirement through scope development, cost estimation, contractor management, commissioning, and final handover. Projects included nitrogen/CO2 flow meter installation, MIS system upgrades, substation monitoring, and PDA-based data collection software design.

PHONES 4U, Coventry, UK | Sales Manager | October 2004 – April 2005

Project Manager at OSI. Led complete implementation of SCADA/EMS systems for R-APDRP funded projects across multiple Indian State Utilities. Managed end-to-end delivery from design to commissioning, ensuring compliance with CEA and MoP guidelines.

Key Responsibilities & Achievements:
Served as Domain Expert and Contracts Manager for the Outage Management System (OMS), managing vendor contracts, SLA compliance, and performance benchmarking for grid automation vendors.
Part of the core team implementing the Smart Grid Pilot for Tata Power, integrating advanced metering, SCADA, and DMS functionalities to demonstrate next-generation distribution management capabilities.
Provided SCADA/GIS consulting to a Mumbai-based power utility and automation systems consulting to a government utility, delivering vendor-neutral technology assessments and implementation roadmaps.
Led the SCADA/DMS/EMS implementation across 54 substations (400kV, 220kV, 66kV), coordinating with GE, Siemens, Oracle, and other OEMs for seamless integration and commissioning.
Developed Business Requirement Documents (BRD) for enterprise reporting tools, evaluating vendor responses, conducting product demonstrations, and selecting optimal solutions for executive dashboards and MIS.
Created executive dashboards with drill-down capabilities for senior management, along with department-specific operational reports, enabling data-driven decision-making across the organization.
Provided technical assistance to the Energy Audit Group from an automation perspective, enabling accurate loss analysis and load forecasting through integrated SCADA and metering data.
Established and maintained the In-House Knowledge Base for the Automation Group, ensuring institutional knowledge retention and rapid onboarding of new team members.
EARLY CAREER FOUNDATION

Managed electronic and electrical engineering projects from initial client requirement through scope development, cost estimation, contractor management, commissioning, and final handover. Projects included nitrogen/CO2 flow meter installation, MIS system upgrades, substation monitoring, and PDA-based data collection software design.

RLDC Projects (400kV & Above Substations)
Project Manager at OSI. Delivered SCADA/EMS solutions for Regional Load Dispatch Centres (RLDC) with 400kV and above substation coverage. Integrated multi-vendor RTUs/IEDs, developed HMI graphics, and commissioned real-time monitoring for grid stability.
Tata Power Smart Grid Pilot (Delhi)
Domain Expert at TPDDL. Part of the core team implementing India's pioneering Smart Grid pilot, integrating AMI, SCADA, DMS, and OMS on a live distribution network. Demonstrated loss reduction and demand response capabilities to CEA and regulatory authorities.
54-Substation SCADA/DMS/EMS Implementation (400kV/220kV/66kV)
Technical Lead at TPDDL. Managed the rollout of SCADA/DMS/EMS across 54 substations, coordinating with GE, Siemens, and Oracle for seamless integration. Delivered real-time monitoring, outage management, and load forecasting capabilities.
Large-Scale Solar EPC Bids (100MW+ Grid-Connected)
Business Development Lead at KEC International. Led bidding and financial modelling for 100MW+ grid-scale solar projects, managing complete grid connection cycle, PPA negotiation support, and EPC contract structuring.
Utility IoT & AMI Platform (Vodafone Idea)
P&L Owner at Vodafone Idea. Forayed into AMI business by leveraging NB-IoT and cellular networks for smart metering. Managed tender responses for DISCOM smart metering procurements and custom IoT solution development.

Sales Director at Bidgely. Won and managed pilot-to-production conversions for AI-driven energy disaggregation platform at major European DSOs, driving energy efficiency and demand-side management initiatives.

candidates.rawText:
AVINASH DEEP

Transmission Line Engineer | PMC Professional — Foundation, Erection & Stringing

avinashjsr110@gmail.com | 07091898455, 06205639435

Proposed Position: Project Manager / PMC Team Member

Nationality: Indian

Date of Birth: 04 March 1978

Education: B. Tech, Electrical Engineering (2007)

Total Experience: 16+ Years — Transmission Sector

Software: MS Office (Word, Excel, PowerPoint)

Profile Summary

16+ years of continuous experience in India's power transmission sector, spanning EHV transmission lines (132kV to 400kV Double Circuit) and substation works. Career progression moves from hands-on site execution to project management and client-side quality/PMC oversight, giving him the ability to evaluate contractor performance across the complete construction lifecycle — foundation, erection, stringing, and sag-tension verification — while also managing client-contractor-HO coordination typical of PMC assignments.

Core Technical Strength — Foundation, Erection & Stringing

A recurring thread across nearly every assignment is hands-on responsibility for the three critical construction phases of a transmission line:

Foundation work: Tower foundation execution and supervision across multiple projects, including specialised Ganga pile foundation work (New Purnia–Bihar Sharif Line) — a technically demanding riverbed/deep foundation technique — plus equipment and power transformer foundations at substations.

Erection: Tower erection supervision as per FQP (Field Quality Plan), from early site roles (Tata Projects, Jyoti Structures) through to site-in-charge assignments (Aravali Infrapower).

Stringing & Sag-Tension Checking: Direct experience in conductor stringing operations, including verification of sag and tension parameters during stringing — a critical quality-control step ensuring conductor ground clearance, tension limits, and line safety standards as per design/QAP. Covered under the 400kV DC Redo–Patiala Line (Aravali Infrapower) and the New Purnia–Bihar Sharif Line (Intertek Moody International), where full charge of foundation, erection, and stringing works was held.

This foundation-to-stringing continuity gives him command of the complete electro-mechanical construction sequence of a line — valuable for PMC oversight, where sag/tension and clearance checks are frequent points of contractor non-compliance.

Employment Record

Mar 2021 – 15 Aug 2023 Manager, Material Quality Section — Feedback Infra Pvt Ltd

132kV various projects (World Bank Project) under JUSNL, Ranchi

Client: JUSNL

Carried out quality checking of materials and construction works as per MQP (Material Quality Plan) and BOQ for both Sub-Stations (SS) and Transmission Lines (TL) on behalf of the client.

Conducted third-party inspection of incoming materials (towers, conductors, insulators, hardware fittings) against approved vendor QAP prior to dispatch/use at site.

Reviewed contractor's foundation and erection work for compliance with approved drawings and FQP under World Bank funding/procurement guidelines.

Attended joint site inspections with JUSNL engineers and contractor representatives to certify stage-wise completion for billing purposes.

Prepared and reviewed non-conformance reports (NCRs) and tracked closure of quality observations raised during inspection.

Coordinated with JUSNL regional office and contractor's project team to resolve material quality disputes and expedite project progress.

Verified compliance documentation (test certificates, type test reports, material test certificates) for equipment and line materials as per World Bank project requirements.

May 2019 – 28 Feb 2021 Sr. Manager, Material Quality Section — Medhaj Techno Concept Pvt Ltd

132kV Non-World Bank Project under JUSNL, Ranchi

Client: JUSNL

Independently handled quality assurance function for 132kV Sub-Station and Transmission Line packages, checking works as per MQP and BOQ.

Inspected tower foundation casting, erection, and stringing activities at multiple work fronts to confirm adherence to approved FQP/QAP.

Cross-verified contractor's Joint Measurement Sheets against actual site quantities prior to client certification for billing.

Flagged and escalated quality deviations to JUSNL and contractor management, and monitored corrective action closure.

Reviewed material test reports and site test results (soil testing, concrete cube testing) for foundation works.

Participated in periodic progress review meetings with JUSNL, reporting on quality status and pending compliance issues.

Sep 2013 – Apr 2019 Project Manager — JBS Enterprises Pvt Ltd

Managed two concurrent transmission line projects — Full charge: 400kV DC New Purnia–Bihar Sharif Line (Bihar); Additional charge: 400kV DC Siliguri–Bongaigaon Line (WB)

Client: Sterlite Grid

Held overall project management responsibility for two 400kV Double Circuit transmission line projects running concurrently across two states.

Directed and monitored foundation and erection works across all work fronts, ensuring adherence to approved drawings, FQP, and project schedule.

Managed planning and scheduling of construction activities, tracking progress against DPR/MPR and taking corrective measures to address slippages.

Led resolution of Right-of-Way (ROW) and other local/land issues in coordination with local administration, landowners, and client representatives — a recurring challenge on both project corridors.

Coordinated with client (Sterlite Grid) and internal head-office team for material planning, drawing approvals, and resolution of design/site issues.

Managed project billing — verification and processing of erection, supply, freight, and PV bills for client and sub-contractors.

Supervised site engineering staff and sub-contractors across both projects, allocating resources between the two corridors as priorities shifted.

Ensured statutory and safety compliance across both project sites.

Jul 2012 – Aug 2013 Site In-charge — Intertek Moody International (I) Pvt Ltd

400kV DC New Purnia–Bihar Sharif Line

Client: Sterlite Grid

Held full site-in-charge responsibility for civil works of the line, including Ganga large pile foundation work, tower erection, and conductor stringing.

Supervised specialised riverbed pile foundation construction for towers crossing the Ganga, coordinating with specialist piling sub-contractors and geotechnical inputs.

Checked and certified sag and tension parameters during conductor stringing operations to ensure design ground clearance and tension limits were met.

Led Right-of-Way (ROW) resolution for the project corridor, liaising with landowners, local authorities, and district administration to clear line hindrances.

Conducted day-to-day site supervision, safety monitoring, and quality checks as per FQP for all foundation, erection, and stringing activities.

Reported daily and weekly progress to client (Sterlite Grid) and coordinated resource mobilisation to maintain project schedule.

Feb 2011 – May 2012 Sr. Engineer cum Site In-charge — Aravali Infrapower Limited

400kV DC Redo–Patiala Line, including Indian Railway track height-increasing work on an electrified line

Client: Power Grid Corporation of India Ltd

Held full charge of civil works of line — foundation, erection, and stringing for the 400kV DC line.

Personally checked sag and tension readings during stringing to confirm compliance with design clearance and tension charts before sag clearance was given.

Executed specialised railway-crossing work involving track height increase for an electrified line, coordinating closely with Railway authorities on safety protocols, traffic/power block permissions, and clearance certifications.

Led Right-of-Way (ROW) resolution for the line corridor in coordination with landowners and local administration.

Supervised tower foundation excavation, casting, and curing as per approved drawings and soil investigation reports.

Coordinated with PGCIL site engineers for joint inspection and stage-wise approval of foundation and erection works.

Maintained site safety standards during work near live railway lines and electrified track sections.

Jan 2009 – Jan 2011 Site Engineer — Jyoti Structures Limited

400kV DC Vadavi–Kansari Line (Package-3)

Client: Reliance Energy Ltd

Carried out foundation and erection supervision as per FQP for the 400kV DC line package.

Handled planning and scheduling of transmission line construction activities across the assigned package.

Monitored progress of foundation casting, tower erection, and material delivery against project schedule, reporting deviations to management.

Coordinated with survey and design teams for tower spotting and foundation-type finalisation as per soil conditions.

Assisted in quality checks of foundation concrete works and erection tolerances as per FQP/QAP.

Aug 2007 – Dec 2008 Asst. Engineer — Tata Projects Ltd

132kV Jojobera Project, Jamshedpur

Client: Tata Power

Assisted in foundation and erection supervision as per FQP for the 132kV substation/line project.

Carried out day-to-day site checks on foundation excavation, reinforcement, and concreting works.

Supported senior engineers in erection sequencing and material tracking at site.

Gained foundational exposure to FQP-based quality supervision practices that shaped later independent site roles.

PMC Role

Client-side quality oversight experience: 4.5 years representing the client's (JUSNL) interest in monitoring contractor compliance.

Complete construction-cycle expertise: Foundation → erection → stringing → sag-tension verification, giving the technical depth to check contractor work at every stage of line construction, not just administratively.

Multi-voltage class exposure: 132kV, 220kV, and 400kV Double Circuit lines.

World Bank project familiarity: Direct experience on a World Bank-funded transmission scheme (Feedback Infra/JUSNL) — relevant for PMC contracts tied to internationally funded projects.

Standard PMC deliverables already in skillset: client/contractor/HO coordination, progress meetings, drawing review (400/220/132/33kV lines & substations), DPR/MPR monitoring, FQP/QAP-based inspection, joint measurement sheet verification for billing, and civil compliance audits.

Key Responsibilities Across Career

Coordinating between clients, contractors, and regional/head office for project progress; conducting daily, weekly, and monthly review meetings with client, contractor, and executing staff.

Drawing study for 400/220/132/33kV Substation and Transmission Line works.

Detailed supervision as per FQP for Transmission Line & Sub-Station construction.

Monitoring DPR (Daily Progress Report) and MPR (Monthly Progress Report) with the project team.

Checking erection plans and material availability as per AFC drawings and QAP; conducting site inspections.

Job supervision of civil portions for 400/220/132/33kV Transmission Line & Sub-Station works — power transformer foundations, equipment foundations, tower foundations, RCC roads, and residential buildings.

Verification of Joint Measurement Sheets for Substation and Transmission Line billing.

Project billing oversight — client/contractor/sub-contractor billing for erection, supply, freight, and PV bills.

Monitoring contractor compliance with legal and statutory requirements.

Site audits to verify civil compliance status of contractors as per project requirements.

Education & Experience Summary

Education: B. Tech in Electrical Engineering, 2007.

Total Experience in Transmission Sector: 16+ years.

Project Manager (Project): 9.11 years

Site In-charge of Line: 1.2 years

Sr. Engineer: 1.4 years

Project Engineer: 2 years

Asst. Engineer: 2 years

Relevant Experience: Transmission Line & Sub-Station Work — 16+ years.

Address

Local Address: Flat No. 1A, OAK Forest Society, Pundag Road, Ranchi, Jharkhand — 834002

Permanent Address: Vill. Ratanua, Anchal – Deo, Post & Dist. Aurangabad, Bihar — 824002

candidates.rawText:
AVINASH DEEP

Transmission Line Engineer | PMC Professional — Foundation, Erection & Stringing

avinashjsr110@gmail.com | 07091898455, 06205639435

Proposed Position: Project Manager / PMC Team Member

Nationality: Indian

Date of Birth: 04 March 1978

Education: B. Tech, Electrical Engineering (2007)

Total Experience: 16+ Years — Transmission Sector

Software: MS Office (Word, Excel, PowerPoint)

Profile Summary

16+ years of continuous experience in India's power transmission sector, spanning EHV transmission lines (132kV to 400kV Double Circuit) and substation works. Career progression moves from hands-on site execution to project management and client-side quality/PMC oversight, giving him the ability to evaluate contractor performance across the complete construction lifecycle — foundation, erection, stringing, and sag-tension verification — while also managing client-contractor-HO coordination typical of PMC assignments.

Core Technical Strength — Foundation, Erection & Stringing

A recurring thread across nearly every assignment is hands-on responsibility for the three critical construction phases of a transmission line:

Foundation work: Tower foundation execution and supervision across multiple projects, including specialised Ganga pile foundation work (New Purnia–Bihar Sharif Line) — a technically demanding riverbed/deep foundation technique — plus equipment and power transformer foundations at substations.

Erection: Tower erection supervision as per FQP (Field Quality Plan), from early site roles (Tata Projects, Jyoti Structures) through to site-in-charge assignments (Aravali Infrapower).

Stringing & Sag-Tension Checking: Direct experience in conductor stringing operations, including verification of sag and tension parameters during stringing — a critical quality-control step ensuring conductor ground clearance, tension limits, and line safety standards as per design/QAP. Covered under the 400kV DC Redo–Patiala Line (Aravali Infrapower) and the New Purnia–Bihar Sharif Line (Intertek Moody International), where full charge of foundation, erection, and stringing works was held.

This foundation-to-stringing continuity gives him command of the complete electro-mechanical construction sequence of a line — valuable for PMC oversight, where sag/tension and clearance checks are frequent points of contractor non-compliance.

Employment Record

Mar 2021 – 15 Aug 2023 Manager, Material Quality Section — Feedback Infra Pvt Ltd

132kV various projects (World Bank Project) under JUSNL, Ranchi

Client: JUSNL

Carried out quality checking of materials and construction works as per MQP (Material Quality Plan) and BOQ for both Sub-Stations (SS) and Transmission Lines (TL) on behalf of the client.

Conducted third-party inspection of incoming materials (towers, conductors, insulators, hardware fittings) against approved vendor QAP prior to dispatch/use at site.

Reviewed contractor's foundation and erection work for compliance with approved drawings and FQP under World Bank funding/procurement guidelines.

Attended joint site inspections with JUSNL engineers and contractor representatives to certify stage-wise completion for billing purposes.

Prepared and reviewed non-conformance reports (NCRs) and tracked closure of quality observations raised during inspection.

Coordinated with JUSNL regional office and contractor's project team to resolve material quality disputes and expedite project progress.

Verified compliance documentation (test certificates, type test reports, material test certificates) for equipment and line materials as per World Bank project requirements.

May 2019 – 28 Feb 2021 Sr. Manager, Material Quality Section — Medhaj Techno Concept Pvt Ltd

132kV Non-World Bank Project under JUSNL, Ranchi

Client: JUSNL

Independently handled quality assurance function for 132kV Sub-Station and Transmission Line packages, checking works as per MQP and BOQ.

Inspected tower foundation casting, erection, and stringing activities at multiple work fronts to confirm adherence to approved FQP/QAP.

Cross-verified contractor's Joint Measurement Sheets against actual site quantities prior to client certification for billing.

Flagged and escalated quality deviations to JUSNL and contractor management, and monitored corrective action closure.

Reviewed material test reports and site test results (soil testing, concrete cube testing) for foundation works.

Participated in periodic progress review meetings with JUSNL, reporting on quality status and pending compliance issues.

Sep 2013 – Apr 2019 Project Manager — JBS Enterprises Pvt Ltd

Managed two concurrent transmission line projects — Full charge: 400kV DC New Purnia–Bihar Sharif Line (Bihar); Additional charge: 400kV DC Siliguri–Bongaigaon Line (WB)

Client: Sterlite Grid

Held overall project management responsibility for two 400kV Double Circuit transmission line projects running concurrently across two states.

Directed and monitored foundation and erection works across all work fronts, ensuring adherence to approved drawings, FQP, and project schedule.

Managed planning and scheduling of construction activities, tracking progress against DPR/MPR and taking corrective measures to address slippages.

Led resolution of Right-of-Way (ROW) and other local/land issues in coordination with local administration, landowners, and client representatives — a recurring challenge on both project corridors.

Coordinated with client (Sterlite Grid) and internal head-office team for material planning, drawing approvals, and resolution of design/site issues.

Managed project billing — verification and processing of erection, supply, freight, and PV bills for client and sub-contractors.

Supervised site engineering staff and sub-contractors across both projects, allocating resources between the two corridors as priorities shifted.

Ensured statutory and safety compliance across both project sites.

Jul 2012 – Aug 2013 Site In-charge — Intertek Moody International (I) Pvt Ltd

400kV DC New Purnia–Bihar Sharif Line

Client: Sterlite Grid

Held full site-in-charge responsibility for civil works of the line, including Ganga pile foundation work, tower erection, and conductor stringing.

Supervised specialised riverbed pile foundation construction for towers crossing the Ganga, coordinating with specialist piling sub-contractors and geotechnical inputs.

Checked and certified sag and tension parameters during conductor stringing operations to ensure design ground clearance and tension limits were met.

Led Right-of-Way (ROW) resolution for the project corridor, liaising with landowners, local authorities, and district administration to clear line hindrances.

Conducted day-to-day site supervision, safety monitoring, and quality checks as per FQP for all foundation, erection, and stringing activities.

Reported daily and weekly progress to client (Sterlite Grid) and coordinated resource mobilisation to maintain project schedule.

Feb 2011 – May 2012 Sr. Engineer cum Site In-charge — Aravali Infrapower Limited

400kV DC Redo–Patiala Line, including Indian Railway track height-increasing work on an electrified line

Client: Power Grid Corporation of India Ltd

Held full charge of civil works of line — foundation, erection, and stringing for the 400kV DC line.

Personally checked sag and tension readings during stringing to confirm compliance with design clearance and tension charts before sag clearance was given.

Executed specialised railway-crossing work involving track height increase for an electrified line, coordinating closely with Railway authorities on safety protocols, traffic/power block permissions, and clearance certifications.

Led Right-of-Way (ROW) resolution for the line corridor in coordination with landowners and local administration.

Supervised tower foundation excavation, casting, and curing as per approved drawings and soil investigation reports.

Coordinated with PGCIL site engineers for joint inspection and stage-wise approval of foundation and erection works.

Maintained site safety standards during work near live railway lines and electrified track sections.

Jan 2009 – Jan 2011 Site Engineer — Jyoti Structures Limited

400kV DC Vadavi–Kansari Line (Package-3)

Client: Reliance Energy Ltd

Carried out foundation and erection supervision as per FQP for the 400kV DC line package.

Handled planning and scheduling of transmission line construction activities across the assigned package.

Monitored progress of foundation casting, tower erection, and material delivery against project schedule, reporting deviations to management.

Coordinated with survey and design teams for tower spotting and foundation-type finalisation as per soil conditions.

Assisted in quality checks of foundation concrete works and erection tolerances as per FQP/QAP.

Aug 2007 – Dec 2008 Asst. Engineer — Tata Projects Ltd

132kV Jojobera Project, Jamshedpur

Client: Tata Power

Assisted in foundation and erection supervision as per FQP for the 132kV substation/line project.

Carried out day-to-day site checks on foundation excavation, reinforcement, and concreting works.

Supported senior engineers in erection sequencing and material tracking at site.

Gained foundational exposure to FQP-based quality supervision practices that shaped later independent site roles.

Why This Maps Well to a PMC Role

Client-side quality oversight experience: 4.5 years representing the client's (JUSNL) interest in monitoring contractor compliance.

Complete construction-cycle expertise: Foundation → erection → stringing → sag-tension verification, giving the technical depth to check contractor work at every stage of line construction, not just administratively.

Multi-voltage class exposure: 132kV, 220kV, and 400kV Double Circuit lines.

World Bank project familiarity: Direct experience on a World Bank-funded transmission scheme (Feedback Infra/JUSNL) — relevant for PMC contracts tied to internationally funded projects.

Standard PMC deliverables already in skillset: client/contractor/HO coordination, progress meetings, drawing review (400/220/132/33kV lines & substations), DPR/MPR monitoring, FQP/QAP-based inspection, joint measurement sheet verification for billing, and civil compliance audits.

Key Responsibilities Across Career

Profile Summary
16+ years of continuous experience in India's power transmission sector, spanning EHV transmission lines (132kV to 400kV Double Circuit) and substation works. Career progression moves from hands-on site execution to project management and client-side quality/PMC oversight, giving him the ability to evaluate contractor performance across the complete construction lifecycle - foundation, erection, stringing, and sag-tension verification - while also managing client-contractor-HO coordination typical of PMC assignments.
Core Technical Strength - Foundation, Erection & Stringing
A recurring thread across nearly every assignment is hands-on responsibility for the three critical construction phases of a transmission line:
Foundation work: Tower foundation execution and supervision across multiple projects, including specialised Ganga pile foundation work (New Purnia-Bihar Sharif Line) - a technically demanding riverbed/deep foundation technique - plus equipment and power transformer foundations at substations.
Erection: Tower erection supervision as per FQP (Field Quality Plan), from early site roles (Tata Projects, Jyoti Structures) through to site-in-charge assignments (Aravali Infrapower).
Stringing & Sag-Tension Checking: Direct experience in conductor stringing operations, including verification of sag and tension parameters during stringing - a critical quality-control step ensuring conductor ground clearance, tension limits, and line safety standards as per design/QAP. Covered under the 400kV DC Redo-Patiala Line (Aravali Infrapower) and the New Purnia-Bihar Sharif Line (Intertek Moody International), where full charge of foundation, erection, and stringing works was held.
This foundation-to-stringing continuity gives him command of the complete electro-mechanical construction sequence of a line - valuable for PMC oversight, where sag/tension and clearance checks are frequent points of contractor non-compliance.
