Positions held and Description of Duties

Name of Project: 132/33kV Sub-Station & 132kV D/C Line, Al Jawabi to Al Khuiamah

Location: Oman

Client: Oman Electricity Transmission Company (O.E.T.C)

Major Features Of the project: 132/33kV substation with associated 132kV D/C transmission line.

Position Held: Senior Land Surveyor

Responsibilities:

Leading complete survey work for the 132/33kV substation and associated 132kV D/C transmission line between Al Jawabi and Al Khuiamah, covering preliminary survey, detail survey and layout marking.

Carrying out topographic and layout survey of the substation site, establishing benchmarks and contour data using Total Station and DGPS-Trimble.

Performing route survey, foundation marking and level transfer for the associated 132kV D/C transmission line tower locations.

Conducting check survey to verify tower spotting, foundation marking and substation layout accuracy prior to construction.

Surveying crossings and utility interfaces along the transmission line route, recording clearance details for design approval.

Preparing and submitting survey drawings (profile, plan, contour, site layout) to the client (O.E.T.C) and design office for approval.

Name of Project: 220kV S/C Transmission Line, Bagasara to Amreli

Location: Gujarat

Client: Varsana Ispat Ltd.

Major Features Of the project: 220kV single-circuit transmission line.

Position Held: Senior Land Surveyor

Responsibilities:

Conducted preliminary (reconnaissance) survey of the transmission line route, including walkover, alternative alignment study and fixing of angle points to finalize the most feasible corridor.

Carried out detail survey of the finalized alignment using Total Station and DGPS, capturing longitudinal profile, cross-sections and ground levels for tower spotting.

Performed tower spotting (pop setting) on the approved profile as per the optimized tower schedule, working out span, weight span and wind span for each location.

Conducted check survey to verify tower spotting, foundation marking and level transfer accuracy prior to construction handover.

Carried out crossing survey of roads, rivers, railway lines and existing utilities along the route, recording clearance and crossing angle details.

Prepared route profile and plan drawings using AutoCAD, and coordinated with the design office for approval.

RESUME 
 Gaurav Sony 
Objective: To secure a challenging role in the energy EPC/PMC sector where I can leverage my 
technical and managerial strengths, while contributing to organizational growth and taking on 
increasing responsibilities. 
•A results-driven professional with 10+ years of comprehensive experience in PMC/EPC 
power projects, covering both technical and commercial domains.
•Proven expertise in execution, testing, and commissioning of transmission systems up to 400 
kV, including retrofitting works.
•Extensive experience in handling EHV transmission lines and substation projects, ensuring 
timely and quality project delivery.
•Strong leadership skills with the ability to manage teams effectively and foster a high- 
performance work environment.
•Excellent techno-commercial, coordination, and problem-solving skills, with the ability to 
work in multi-stakeholder and multicultural environments.
•Hands-on experience in AIS/GIS substations, foundation works, erection, stringing, and 
project execution lifecycle.
•Proficient in quality assurance (FQP), site safety compliance, contractor billing 
certification, joint measurements, and material reconciliation.
•Bid Documentation & Proposal Management for EOI/RFP/PMC Consultancy Projects.
•Preparation of Technical Proposals, DPR Support Documents, Manpower Deployment planning 
and Tender Compliance Documentation.
•Experience in Infrastructure, Transmission & Substation Consultancy Bid Preparation.
Key Skills and Competencies 
•Transmission Line (HV & EHV) Engineering & Execution - Comprehensive experience in
survey, design, planning, and execution of HV & EHV transmission lines up to 220 kV.
Expertise in foundation, tower erection, stringing, and commissioning of transmission lines.
•Substation Construction & Commissioning - Expertise in AIS (132/33 kV) and GIS (33/11
kV) substations, including installation and commissioning of transformers, switchgear, circuit
breakers, and protection systems.
•Civil & Electrical Engineering - Strong knowledge of civil structures, foundations, and
electrical systems related to transmission and substation projects. Expertise in concrete and
steel structures, soil testing, grounding, and earthing systems.
•Project Coordination & Stakeholder Management -
➢Coordination with PIU, clients, contractors, and government authorities.
➢Preparation of MPR, QPR, statutory reports, GTP/MQP approvals, and project
documentation.
➢Liaison with Railways, Highways, Forest, and Telecom authorities for approvals.
•Contract & Commercial Management -
➢Understanding of power sector contracts, including TBCB tenders.
➢Experience in billing, BOQ preparation, cost control, and contractor management.
•Execution & Site Management
➢End-to-end handling of electrical execution, testing, and commissioning up to 400 kV.
➢Ensuring compliance with drawings, specifications, quality standards, and safety protocols.
•Testing & Commissioning Expertise - Hands-on experience in testing and commissioning of
SF6 Circuit Breakers, CTs, CVTs, VCB panels, transformers, cables, and switchyard equipment.
•Planning, MIS & Resource Management
➢Project planning, scheduling, and monitoring. MIS reporting, material planning, store
management, and audit. Contractor material reconciliation and inventory control.

Work Experience (Transmission, Distribution, Grid Sub-station, MEP & PMC) 
 
Feedback Infra (Dec 2022 – Till Date) 
Assistant Manager (Project Execution) Client – JUSNL 
Location – Ranchi, Jharkhand 
Project Overview: World Bank (WB) is supporting Jharkhand Urja Sancharan Nigam Limited 
(JUSNL) with a loan of US$310 million to achieve the ‘24/7 Power for All’ goal of the Government 
of the Jharkhand (GOJ). JUSNL is using the fund to construct substations and transmission lines to 
evacuate power from upcoming generation plants of 4.3 GW capacity and to support the availability of 
electricity in all corners of the state of Jharkhand. This World Bank Funded Transmission Project of 
JUSNL under JPSIP (Jharkhand Power System Improvement Project) scheme has been divided into 
16 Packages, which includes 8 Nos of 132/33 Grid Substation Packages having capacity of 2*50 
MVA each and 8 Nos of Transmission Lines Packages having total length of 2244 CKM. The overall 
project is divided into Package-1 as Zone-1 (Ranchi) & Zone-2 (Dumka) and Package-2 as Zone-3 
(Jamshedpur) and Zone-4 (Daltonganj) in Jharkhand District. 
 
Project Name: Procurement of Consulting Services for Project Management Consultant to support 
JUSNL in Implementation of World Bank Funded Transmission Line & Sub-station Contracts in Zone-I 
(Ranchi) and Zone-II (Dumka) under package-1. 
 
M/s Feedback Infra has been appointed as PMC for Package-1. The scope of the work is to deliver 
services for Transmission Projects consisting of 12 Grid Substations of 2X50 MVA capacity each and 
1030 CKM of 132 kV Transmission Lines in Ranchi and Dumka Zone. 
I have been appointed to the Ranchi Zone for execution of transmission projects comprising 
approximately 550 ckm of lines and 6 (six) substations along-with 2(two) bay extensions. Each zone is 
supported by a team of around 20 key and non-key experts, including Site Engineers (Electrical & Civil), 
Social Safeguard Experts, Environmental Experts with their associates, along with a Safety Engineer, 
Inspection Engineer, and Technical Assistant. My key responsibilities include. 
• Supervised end-to-end construction of EHV transmission lines, including route survey, 
foundation construction, tower erection, and conductor stringing. 
• Managed AIS substation installation, ensuring seamless integration of transformers, switchgear, 
and protection systems. 
• Oversaw material procurement, vendor coordination, and logistics management, ensuring 
timely availability of critical components. 
• Conducted technical troubleshooting for on-site issues related to civil and electrical 
infrastructure, preventing project delays. 
• Ensured adherence to contract specifications, quality assurance measures, and safety protocols 
at all project stages. 
• Coordinate and follow up with Railways, National Highways, Telecom department, Forest 
authorities etc. for approvals.

Objective: To secure a challenging role in the energy EPC/PMC sector where I can leverage my

Assistant Manager (Project Execution) Client – JUSNL 
Location – Ranchi, Jharkhand 
Project Overview: World Bank (WB) is supporting Jharkhand Urja Sancharan Nigam Limited 
(JUSNL) with a loan of US$310 million to achieve the ‘24/7 Power for All’ goal of the Government 
of the Jharkhand (GOJ). JUSNL is using the fund to construct substations and transmission lines to 
evacuate power from upcoming generation plants of 4.3 GW capacity and to support the availability of 
electricity in all corners of the state of Jharkhand. This World Bank Funded Transmission Project of 
JUSNL under JPSIP (Jharkhand Power System Improvement Project) scheme has been divided into 
16 Packages, which includes 8 Nos of 132/33 Grid Substation Packages having capacity of 2*50 
MVA each and 8 Nos of Transmission Lines Packages having total length of 2244 CKM. The overall 
project is divided into Package-1 as Zone-1 (Ranchi) & Zone-2 (Dumka) and Package-2 as Zone-3 
(Jamshedpur) and Zone-4 (Daltonganj) in Jharkhand District. 
 
Project Name: Procurement of Consulting Services for Project Management Consultant to support 
JUSNL in Implementation of World Bank Funded Transmission Line & Sub-station Contracts in Zone-I 
(Ranchi) and Zone-II (Dumka) under package-1. 
 
M/s Feedback Infra has been appointed as PMC for Package-1. The scope of the work is to deliver 
services for Transmission Projects consisting of 12 Grid Substations of 2X50 MVA capacity each and 
1030 CKM of 132 kV Transmission Lines in Ranchi and Dumka Zone. 
I have been appointed to the Ranchi Zone for execution of transmission projects comprising 
approximately 550 ckm of lines and 6 (six) substations along-with 2(two) bay extensions. Each zone is 
supported by a team of around 20 key and non-key experts, including Site Engineers (Electrical & Civil), 
Social Safeguard Experts, Environmental Experts with their associates, along with a Safety Engineer, 
Inspection Engineer, and Technical Assistant. My key responsibilities include. 
• Supervised end-to-end construction of EHV transmission lines, including route survey, 
foundation construction, tower erection, and conductor stringing. 
• Managed AIS substation installation, ensuring seamless integration of transformers, switchgear, 
and protection systems. 
• Oversaw material procurement, vendor coordination, and logistics management, ensuring 
timely availability of critical components. 
• Conducted technical troubleshooting for on-site issues related to civil and electrical 
infrastructure, preventing project delays. 
• Ensured adherence to contract specifications, quality assurance measures, and safety protocols 
at all project stages.

authorities etc. for approvals.

PARDEEP KUMAR 
Delhi, India | +91 9870343565 | singh.pardeep0689@gmail.com | Linkedin 
 
PROFILE SUMMARY 
Electrical Engineering professional with over 14 years of experience in the electrical industry, 
specializing in distribution of HT and LT lines. Proven expertise in supervising field operations and 
coordinating cross-functional teams to ensure the successful execution of projects from planning 
through commissioning. Experienced in managing project schedules, resources, and stakeholder 
communication to deliver projects on time and within scope. 
Recognized with safety and innovation awards in distribution sector for driving operational 
excellence and implementing remote support solutions. Demonstrated ability to reduce 
maintenance downtime through structured troubleshooting, system optimization, and proactive 
project coordination 
PROFESSIONAL EXPERIENCE 
BUSINESS ASSOCIATE WITH TATA POWER DELHI DISTRIBUTION LIMITED. 
 
VISION PLUS SECURITY CONTROL PVT. LTD. ASSOCIATE WITH TPDDL. 
Safety Engineer & Project Coordinator February 2024 – Present 
• Specialization in Maintenance of HT Line and LT overhead and Underground Network and HVDS 
system, including Transformer, Switchgear, RMUs, Cables, Street light, NCC, Erection of poles, 
Metering, and LT Network up to 440Volts. Supervision of consumer energy-meter–related 
complaints and network-related breakdowns/outages. 
• Specialized in distribution infrastructure strengthening under Integrated Power Development 
Scheme (IPDS) and Revamped Distribution Sector Scheme (RDSS). 
• Coordinated with EPC contractors, vendors, and DISCOM officials for timely execution of 
IPDS/RDSS works. 
• Conducted safety training initiatives and emergency response planning. 
• Ensuring safety PPES implementation at all site locations and approval for its quality clearance, 
responsible for best industrial practices like permit LOTO, etc. 
• Managed procurement activities including vendor sourcing, quotation verification and comparison, 
and selection of suppliers based on cost, quality, and delivery timelines. 
• Coordinated billing and invoice verification, and ensured compliance with project and company 
procurement policies. 
• Coordinated with vendors, finance, and project teams to ensure the timely procurement of 
equipment and smooth material availability at the site. 
• Ensured compliance with regulations and carried out safety audits and inspections. 
• Introduced innovative safety solutions and promoted a strong safety culture. 
• Led recognition and award-winning programs for safety performance. 
• Organize all events like Safety week, Road safety week, and Safety signage’s and Morning safety 
talk to improve coordination across the group. 
• Coordinated with project and site teams to optimize resource utilization, monitor deployment, and 
address manpower requirements proactively. 

• Daily MIS makes of all sites, incident investigation & its reporting, Monthly MIS update to top 
management. 
• Planning & allocation of manpower across projects based on schedules, workload, and skill 
requirements to ensure timely and efficient project execution. 
H.S. POWER PROJECT PVT. LTD. ASSOCIATE WITH TPDDL. 
Field Safety & Project Coordinator February 2021-January 2024 
• Operation and maintenance of HT (11 kV) and LT (440 V and below) power distribution network 
and switchgear. 
• Specialized in distribution infrastructure strengthening under Integrated Power Development 
Scheme (IPDS) and Revamped Distribution Sector Scheme (RDSS). 
• Coordinated with EPC contractors, vendors, and DISCOM officials for timely execution of 
IPDS/RDSS works. 
• Conducted safety training initiatives and emergency response planning. 
• Ensuring safety PPES implementation at all site locations and approval for its quality clearance, 
responsible for best industrial practices like permit LOTO, etc. 
• Supervision of consumer energy-meter–related complaints and network-related 
breakdowns/outages. 
• Oversight of maintenance and outage activities for bare conductor networks, distribution 
transformers, etc. 
• Conduct safety training initiatives and emergency response planning. 
• Ensured compliance with regulations and carried out safety audits and inspections. 
• Introduced innovative safety solutions and promoted a strong safety culture. 
• Led recognition and award programs for safety performance. 
• Delivered morning safety talks and achieved zero-accident milestones. 
• Coordinated with project and site teams to optimize resource utilization, monitor deployment, and 
address manpower requirements proactively. 
Supervisor & Electrical Engineer February 2018- January 2021 
• Operation and maintenance of HT (11 kV) and LT (440 V and below) power distribution network 
and switchgear. 
• Supervision of consumer energy-meter–related complaints and network-related 
breakdowns/outages. 
• Oversight of maintenance and outage activities for bare conductor networks, distribution 
transformers, etc. 
• Lead the breakout and on-time schedule for the maintenance. 
• Coordinated with project and site teams to optimize resource utilization, monitor deployment, and 
address manpower requirements proactively. 
SURYA CONSTRUCTION COMPANY PVT. LTD. ASSOCIATE WITH TPDDL. 
Site Engineer December 2013 – January 2018 
• Operation and maintenance of HT (11 kV) and LT (440 V and below) power distribution network 
and switchgear. 
• Supervision of consumer energy-meter–related complaints and network-related 
breakdowns/outages. 
• Oversight of maintenance and outage activities for bare conductor networks, distribution 
transformers, etc. 

• Lead the breakout and on-time schedule for the maintenance. 
 
THYSSENKRUPP ELEVATOR INDIA PVT. LTD. 
Electrical Engineer July 2011 – November 2013 
• Hands-on experience with the Automation Electrical Panel. 
• Managed and inspected electrical panels to ensure proper operation and compliance with 
standards. 
• Identified and mitigated safety hazards across the worksite. 
• Knowledge of electric drive, elevators, Electrical panels, safety Hazards, HIRA, Civil specification 
• Coordinated with production units to resolve electrical faults and streamline assembly workflows. 
EDUCATION 
• B. Tech in Electrical Engineering — Delhi Technological University(Formerly DCE), Delhi in 2018. 
• Diploma in Electrical Engineering — G.B. Pant Institute of Technology, Delhi in 2011. 
• 12th — NIOS Delhi 
• 10th — GSBVS CBSE 
SKILLS 
Team supervision & field workforce management, Project planning, coordination & execution, 
Contractor/consultant supervision, Resource planning & work allocation, Strong decision-making & 
problem-solving, Continuous improvement mindset Soft Skills: Teamwork, decision-making, 
pressure handling 
CERTIFICATIONS & ACHIEVEMENTS 
• Certificate of Competency Class-I (Electrical Supervisor). 
• NPTI Training – Power Sector & Energy Management Strategies. 
• ACE Training – Operation, Maintenance & Safety Systems. 
• Silver Medalist Winner – Quality Circle Team (Portable 1-Phase Transformer) • Excellence Award 
– Quality Circle Team (Double-Layer Transformer), TATA Power-DDL 
• Performance Excellence Award – Quality Circle Team (Plinth on Demand), TPDDL. 
• Awarded twice as Best Supervisor and once as Best Safety Engineer. 
PERSONAL DETAILS

Nationality: Indian 
Languages: English, Hindi,

 Phone: +91 9662685960 | Email: er.ashwinsingh@gmail.com

PROFESSIONAL SUMMARY 
A results-driven Civil Engineer specializing in Geotechnical Exploration, Quality Assurance, and Heavy 
Infrastructure Projects with over 8.5 years of comprehensive experience. Proven track record in 
managing large-scale project lifecycles from complex field investigations to advanced laboratory 
testing, soil parameter development, and ground improvement. Adept at leading quality control teams, 
managing concrete mix designs and batching plant operations, resolving critical site design issues, and 
ensuring strict compliance with technical specifications on mega-scale renewable energy and 
infrastructure projects. 
 
EDUCATION 
• Bachelor of Civil Engineering (2017) 
HJD Institute of Technical Education and Research, Kera, Bhuj, Kutch | Gujarat Technological University | 
CGPA: 7.40 
 
WORK EXPERIENCE 
Lead Geotechnical Quality Engineer | October 2024 – Present 
Adani Infra (India) Limited – Khavda, Kutch, Gujarat * Heading the geotechnical and civil quality 
control/assurance team for 30 GW mega-scale wind and solar hybrid renewable energy 
infrastructure. 
• Supervising heavy foundation execution, deep mass concrete pours, and structural quality 
compliance for Wind Turbine Generators (WTGs), Pooling Stations, and 765 kV / 400 kV 
Transmission Towers. Pooling Stations, and 765 kV / 400 kV Transmission Towers 
• Managing and monitoring automated batching plant operations, ensuring strict adherence to mix 
designs, raw material quality (aggregates, cement, admixtures), and consistent concrete 
workability/strength criteria. 
• Overseeing specialized ground improvement techniques, specialized field testing, and structural 
execution monitoring using advanced tools like the PULSE quality monitoring platform. 

Senior Geotechnical Engineer | January 2024 – October 2024 
Simcon Technology Pvt. Ltd. (A venture of Unique Engineering Services) – Gandhidham, Kutch * 
Planned and managed comprehensive geotechnical investigation projects according to strict 
technical specifications and client parameters. 
• Coordinated field exploration teams and laboratory testing schedules to ensure the timely and 
accurate delivery of geotechnical engineering reports. 
• Provided structural soil parameters, concrete foundation preparation protocols, and mitigation 
strategies for execution challenges. 
Senior Geotechnical Engineer | December 2017 – December 2023 
Unique Engineering Services – Gandhidham, Kutch * Conducted field data analysis, laboratory 
data synthesis, and engineering evaluations for deep/shallow foundations, retaining structures, 
and highways. 
• Managed site and laboratory facilities, successfully overseeing teams of junior engineers, site 
supervisors, and laboratory technicians. 
• Maintained inventory, safety protocols, and calibration standards for advanced laboratory testing 
equipment. 
 
TECHNICAL SKILLS 
• Concrete Technology & Batching Plant Management: Comprehensive oversight of concrete 
batching plant operations, including calibration, material testing, mix recipe controls, slump 
retention checks, and temperature control for massive foundation pours. 
• WTG Foundation & Concrete Works: Deep expertise in the quality control of Wind Turbine 
Generator (WTG) foundations, managing reinforcement detailing, high-grade mass concrete 
casting (in-situ and pre-cast), non-destructive testing (NDT), and curing protocols. 
• Project Management & Planning: End-to-end management of geotechnical investigation 
campaigns, aligning laboratory testing with design engineering milestones to deliver optimal 
project outcomes. 
• Data Analysis & Parameter Estimation: Advanced analysis of field borehole logs and laboratory 
testing data to develop safe, optimized soil and rock parameters for structural designs. 
• Advanced Field-Testing Expertise: Execution and interpretation of Plate Load Tests, Pile Load 
Tests, K-Value Tests, Field CBR (FCBR), Block Vibration Tests, Standard Penetration Tests (SPT), 
Static/Dynamic Cone Penetration Tests (SCPT/DCPT), Non-Destructive Testing (NDT) on concrete, 
Electrical Resistivity Triangulation (ERT), Thermal Resistivity Testing (TRT), MASW, and 
Pressuremeter Tests. 

• Ground Improvement Specialist: Experienced in engineering design validation and execution 
checks for Stone Column Installations and Prefabricated Vertical Drains (PVDs). 
 
KEY PROJECTS 
• 30 GW Wind & Solar Hybrid Power Plant (Adani Green Energy India Ltd, Khavda): Successfully 
managed geotechnical engineering, extensive ground improvement execution, batching plant 
quality control, and heavy concrete foundation works for high-capacity 5.2 MW WTG structures. 
• Power Evacuation & Transmission Infrastructure: Quality and execution oversight for high-
output Concrete Batching Plants, Pooling Stations, and 765 kV / 400 kV Transmission Towers. 
• Battery Energy Storage Systems (BESS): Foundation works, massive concrete placement 
testing, and specialized ground stability monitoring for a 3.37 GW battery storage project. 
• High-Speed Rail Project: Geotechnical testing and assessment for NHSRCL (Bullet Train) Bridge 
and Yard infrastructure. 
• Linear & Pipeline Infrastructure: HRRL Crude Oil Pipeline Project across Gujarat and Assam. 
• Transportation & Highways: Roads and Buildings Department projects across Mandvi, Kandla, 
Bhuj, Rapar, Indo-Pak Border zones, and various MP-UP Bridge Projects. 
• Industrial & Strategic Infrastructure: Heavy oil refinery and chemical tankage projects across 
Gujarat and Maharashtra; Military Engineer Services (MES) runway project at Air Force Station 
Jamnagar. 
 
TRAINING & CERTIFICATIONS 
• Laboratory Testing and Triaxial Testing (Jan 2021 – Feb 2021) | Indian Institute of Technology 
(IIT), Gandhinagar 
• Physico-Chemical Analysis of Ceramic Raw Materials (Sept 2018) | CSIR-Central Glass & 
Ceramic Research Institute, Ahmedabad --- 
ACADEMIC PROJECTS 
• Soil Stabilization Using Jute Waste Material: Research focused on improving the shear strength 
and engineering properties of weak soils utilizing industrial jute waste reinforcements. 
• Soil Stabilization Using Human Hair Fiber Waste: Experimental study evaluating the structural 
enhancement of soil matrices using natural fiber waste inclusions. 
 
TECHNICAL & COMPUTER PROFICIENCY 

• Engineering Tools: AutoCAD, gINT (Geotechnical Software), Soil Testing Analysis Platforms, 
Ground Improvement Simulation Tools. 
• Operations & Monitoring: PULSE (Quality Monitoring Software), Automated Batching Plant 
Interface Software, Google Earth Pro. 
• Office Suite: Microsoft Office (Excel, Word, PowerPoint).

I hereby declare that the information contained herein is true and correct to the best of my 
knowledge and belief. 
 Ashwin Singh

Methodical wind energy engineer involved in the planning, designing, testing and supervising of manufacturing of hardware design turbines, rotor blades, electrical systems and energy production systems. VESTAS V155 – 3.6 MW – V82

Experience with troubleshooting, repair and maintenance of wind turbines.

Site Manager, Pramo Green Energy 

June 2018 – March 2022, Karnataka

Inspect wind turbines for performance and safety issues.

Maintain and repair wind turbines and related systems.

Conduct regular maintenance and safety checks.

Maintain records of maintenance and repair activities.

Ensure compliance with safety regulations and standard

Mechanical Technician, Offshore 

August 2016 – February 2018, Dubai

and outages.

Work heavily with mechanical and process system to complete inspections and skilled repairs. (Vertical/horizontal centrifugal pumps, motors bearings, alignments).

Additional Experience

Quality Inspector, TUV RHEINLAND

10 days - Al Duqm, Oman

 9.6 MW Wind Turbine (Shanghai Electricals) – Incoming Material Inspection 

Performed incoming material inspection for all components of 9.6 MW Wind Turbine Generators (WTGs), ensuring compliance with project specifications, approved drawings, and quality standards.

Verified material quality, dimensions, visual condition, coating/painting, packing integrity, and documentation before installation.

Reviewed Material Test Certificates (MTCs), inspection reports, quality documents, and vendor records to ensure conformity with technical specifications.

Maintained detailed inspection reports, checklists, quality records, and material traceability documentation.

Inspected mast sections, guy wires, anchors, foundation bolts, ladders, platforms, aviation lights, and earthing systems.

Safety Procedures

Playing Cricket and Volley Ball

Determination of right-of-way width requirement and indicative land-take; preparation of the crossing schedule for roads, watercourses and existing lines; and identification of wayleave requirements.

Issue of the evacuation corridor, right-of-way width and crossing schedule to the Lead Consultant's environmental and social team as an input to the ESIA area of influence.

16. Detailed Tasks Assigned on This Assignment

Task

Assigned Responsibility

Task G1 — Data and model validation

Validation of the ESCOM network model against published system data and measured loading at Nanjoka; documentation of gaps, inconsistencies and the assumptions adopted to close them; construction of the project model covering the PV inverter fleet, BESS, MV collection system, plant transformer, evacuation line and point of connection, with the existing 10 MW plant and its Static Var Generator explicitly represented; preparation of the study case matrix issued in Deliverable D1.

Task G2 — POC optimisation

Execution of the technical screening underlying the point of connection and voltage level comparison: thermal headroom on candidate circuits, short-circuit capability of existing switchgear, voltage regulation at the point of connection and N-1 security under each of the 33 kV, 66 kV and 132 kV options.

Task G3 — Grid impact studies (lead)

Personal delivery of the full grid impact study suite for the combined 50 MW installation: load flow across peak, shoulder and minimum demand with N-0 and N-1 contingency and cumulative-injection cases; short-circuit and fault level analysis to IEC 60909 with explicit modelling of inverter-based fault current contribution; steady-state and dynamic voltage stability, fault ride-through, post-fault active power recovery and rate-of-change-of-frequency withstand; harmonic penetration and impedance scan with identification of resonance conditions against the existing Static Var Generator; flicker assessment to IEC 61000-3-7; and determination of the combined reactive capability at the point of connection with sizing of any additional compensation required.

Task G4 — Protection support

Provision of fault duty results and network equivalents to the Protection and Control Engineer; sensitivity analysis for weak-infeed conditions arising from inverter fault current limitation; and modelling support to the islanding and anti-islanding assessment.

Task G7 — Least-cost confirmation

Determination of the operating regime and curtailment conditions under which the combined 50 MW plant can operate within network limits, and the system reliability statement supporting the least-cost confirmation.

17. Work Undertaken That Best Illustrates Capability to Handle the Assigned Tasks

(a) Interconnection and grid impact studies for inverter-based generation and storage (2022 to date). Steady-state, dynamic and electromagnetic transient studies supporting generator interconnection across six North American markets. The work has covered load flow and contingency analysis, short-circuit studies, dynamic stability assessment of solar inverters in PSS®E and PSLF, thermal overload and voltage screening under ERIS and NRIS processes, and grid injection analysis establishing available capacity at candidate points of interconnection. Relevance: this is the direct equivalent of Tasks G2 and G3 at Salima — establishing available capacity at a candidate connection point and demonstrating that the proposed inverter-based plant does not violate network limits under credible operating and contingency conditions.

(b) EMT modelling and control interaction analysis. Custom electromagnetic transient modelling in PSCAD for inverter original equipment manufacturers across 100 kW, 166 kW, 200 kW and 250 kW storage inverter stacks, and sub-synchronous oscillation investigation using frequency-scan techniques. Relevance: the Salima study must assess harmonic penetration, resonance and control interaction between a 40 MW inverter fleet, a new battery energy storage system and the existing Static Var Generator, on a hydro-dominant network where the connection point is comparatively weak. Frequency-scan and EMT capability is precisely what that assessment requires, and it is not a common skill set among generalist study engineers.

(c) Grid code compliance assessment for inverter-based resources. Compliance assessment against CAISO Rule 21, ERCOT Model Quality Tests, ISO-NE standards, IEEE 1547 and IEEE 2800, and against NERC TPL-001-4, MOD-032-1 and PRC-024-1. Relevance: Deliverable D4 includes a clause-by-clause Grid Code Compliance Statement against the ESCOM Grid Code. The discipline of demonstrating compliance clause by clause with modelled evidence, and of defending it to a system operator, transfers directly.

(d) Transmission capacity, congestion and curtailment analysis. Transmission capacity analysis for lease areas in Lake Michigan (MISO), the Gulf of Maine (ISO-NE) and PJM; congestion, curtailment and locational marginal price assessment using PROMOD; and cost estimation for transmission system upgrades in PJM and ISO-NE interconnection studies. Relevance: the Salima study must establish curtailment exposure under the cumulative injection case at Nanjoka and cost the resulting reinforcement, which are outputs of Tasks G3 and G7.

(e) Real-time simulation and protection research (2020 to 2022). Development of OPAL-RT and RTDS hardware-in-the-loop test benches for power system applications, and research into WAMS-based resilient grid protection for stability during extreme weather events. Relevance: supports the dynamic stability, fault ride-through and anti-islanding work under Tasks G3 and G4, and the resilience considerations arising from a drought- and cyclone-exposed, hydro-dominant system.

(f) Automation and reproducibility. Python-based automation of study workflows and interconnection study processes, reported to have reduced manual workload by 30 to 40 per cent. Relevance: the Salima case matrix spans several demand levels, dispatch states, contingencies and connection options. Scripted case management makes that matrix tractable within the programme and, more importantly, makes the results reproducible by ESCOM.

candidates.rawText:
MD FARHAN

Substation & Switchyard Civil Engineer | B.Tech (Civil Engineering)

+91-7003931493 / +91-8252644749 | akhtarfarhan175@gmail.com

Indian National | Holds Valid Indian Passport | Available for UAE Deployment

CAREER OBJECTIVE

To contribute to challenging substation, switchyard and infrastructure projects with a progressive organization, applying my civil construction, execution and quality-control expertise while continuing to grow within the dynamic and demanding environment of international EPC projects.

PROFILE SUMMARY

A dedicated and result-oriented B.Tech Civil Engineer with over 10 years of experience in site execution, supervision, planning and quality assurance/control of substation, switchyard and power-plant civil works, alongside industrial, water and building projects. Hands-on experience in the civil construction of 33 kV and 132 kV substations and switchyards — including transformer and equipment foundations, control buildings, cable trenches, earthing civil works and switchyard grading — as well as thermal power plant structures (TG building, boiler, ESP, FGD, 150 m RCC chimney), iron-ore and steel plant structures, water treatment plants, mega-townships and commercial/residential buildings. Proficient in foundation and RCC works, QA/QC to relevant IS codes and Field Quality Plans, planning, billing and multidisciplinary coordination. Seeking to add value to substation and infrastructure projects in the UAE.

EDUCATIONAL QUALIFICATION

Bachelor of Technology (B.Tech) in Civil Engineering — Biju Patnaik University of Technology, Odisha (2012–2016), First Class.

CORE COMPETENCIES

Substation & Switchyard Civil Works

Transformer & Equipment Foundations

Power Plant Civil Construction

Planning, Scheduling & Billing

QA/QC & Quality Audits (IS Codes / FQP)

Site Execution & Supervision

Material Estimation & Testing

Pile Foundation & Load Testing

Project Documentation & NCR Closure

WORK EXPERIENCE

Chevrox Construction Pvt. Ltd. | May 2026 – Present

Designation: Deputy Project Manager

Project: Development of 2000 MLD Water Treatment Plant (WTP), Bhandup Complex, Mumbai

Managing civil construction of major process structures (Actiflo units, dual-media filters, chlorine contact tanks) and associated RCC water-retaining structures, ensuring execution as per approved GFC drawings, IS 3370 and project specifications.

Overseeing civil works for the plant’s electrical substation / MCC buildings, pump-house equipment foundations, cable trenches and duct banks, coordinating with electrical and mechanical teams for embedded inserts and cut-out requirements.

Planning and monitoring day-to-day site activities, preparing and tracking construction schedules, and reporting progress, productivity and slippages to senior management with corrective-action plans.

Coordinating and supervising site engineers, subcontractors and consultants, and allocating manpower, material and machinery to achieve daily and weekly execution targets.

Ensuring adherence to project specifications, quality, safety and regulatory requirements through review of method statements, checklists and pour cards.

Reviewing contractor bills, reconciling material consumption and maintaining project and QA/QC documentation.

Power Mech Projects Limited | Nov 2025 – Apr 2026

Designation: Deputy Manager (Planning)

Project: Thermal Power Plant 2×800 MW, Stage-II, DVC – KTPS, Koderma, Jharkhand

Handled planning and execution monitoring of civil works for major power-plant structures including the Turbine-Generator (TG) building, Power House, Boiler and ESP foundations, CW pipeline and the switchyard / substation area.

Supervised switchyard civil works — equipment and gantry-structure foundations, transformer foundations with oil-soak pits and fire/baffle walls, cable trenches, earthing-pit civil works, switchyard grading, internal roads and drainage.

Prepared and updated L2/L3 construction schedules, monitored progress against baseline, quantified deviations and issued look-ahead plans and catch-up programmes to management.

Tracked project status through daily, weekly and monthly progress reports, comparing physical versus planned progress and highlighting areas requiring improvement.

Coordinated multidisciplinary team activities and interfaced with civil, electrical and mechanical agencies to ensure adherence to specifications, quality, safety and statutory requirements.

Provided support in resolving execution bottlenecks, drawing/RFI clarifications and work-front availability issues to keep critical-path activities on schedule.

Tribeni Construction Limited | Jan 2025 – Oct 2025

Designation: Deputy Project Manager

Project: Thermal Power Plant 2×800 MW, Stage-II – Main Power House (MPH) & Switchyard, NTPC, Lara, Raigarh, Chhattisgarh

Led civil construction of the Main Power House (MPH) and Switchyard package for the 2×800 MW thermal power project, ensuring works progressed as per approved drawings, specifications and IS codes.

Directed switchyard civil execution — transformer and equipment foundations, gantry/tower foundations, control-room building, cable and pipe trenches, earthing pits and switchyard levelling, roads and storm-water drainage.

Overseeing and coordinating team activities across contractors and site engineers, ensuring adherence to project specifications, quality and safety standards and regulatory requirements.

Tracked progress, reported on project status and identified areas for improvement, driving corrective actions to recover schedule.

Managed allocation of project resources — manpower, materials and construction equipment — to meet execution milestones across MPH and switchyard fronts.

Provided support in resolving civil execution issues, interface clarifications and closure of non-conformities with the client / consultant.

TATA Steel Limited (through Randstad India Pvt. Ltd.) | May 2024 – Jan 2025

Designation: Sr. Engineer – QA

Project: IOPP Expansion Project (6 MTPA) — 132 kV Substation, Township Phase-II, Water Reservoir, Station Building & Railway Quarter, Noamundi, Jharkhand

Executed quality assurance / quality control for civil construction of the 132 kV substation, water reservoir, station building, railway quarters and IOPP structures within the 6 MTPA expansion project.

Carried out QA/QC of substation civil works — transformer and equipment foundations, control building, cable trenches and earthing civil — ensuring compliance with GFC drawings, IS codes and approved Field Quality Plans.

Conducted site inspections and witnessed testing activities for concrete, reinforcement and compaction, and verified pour readiness through checklists and pour cards.

Logged NCRs in “Wrench” (TSL database system) and prepared weekly and monthly quality-observation reports for management review.

Held coordination meetings with contractors and line managers to address non-conformities and quality issues arising during construction.

Maintained QA documentation, material-inspection records and test reports to ensure full traceability and audit readiness.

Jindal Steel Odisha Limited (through Intertek India Pvt. Ltd.) | Aug 2023 – Apr 2024

Designation: Sr. Construction Engineer

Project: Steel Plant Expansion Project (Coke Oven Area), JSOL, Angul, Odisha

Supervised civil construction across the Coke Oven area, including the 33 kV substation, Quenching Tower, SCP track, Flue Tunnel, Sedimentation Pond, Coke Wharf, Coal Blending Bin, Coal Crusher House, CDQ and associated structures.

Managed substation civil works — equipment and transformer foundations, cable trenches, control-room and earthing-pit civil — in line with drawings, specifications and IS codes.

Conducted site inspections and oversaw testing activities for concrete, reinforcement and compaction works.

Performed quality assurance for all civil works to ensure conformance with project specifications and approved drawings.

Ensured proper management of materials and workmanship and verified the quality of incoming materials at site.

Interacted with the engaged contractor to address non-conformities and resolve quality issues during construction.

BHEL (through Moody International India Pvt. Ltd.) | Jun 2021 – Aug 2023

Designation: Field Quality Engineer

Project: Thermal Power Plant FGD Package (4×250 MW), BRBCL, Nabinagar, Aurangabad, Bihar (Client: Bhartiya Rail Bijli Company Ltd. / NTPC Nabinagar)

Executed civil QA for FGD structures — 150 m RCC chimney, absorber foundations, gypsum storage building, duct and ball-mill foundations, truck-tippler and process-water-tank foundations, crusher house, lime storage silo and FGD control-room building, including associated electrical/switchgear building foundations.

Inspected pile boring as per the approved methodology and witnessed pile load testing as per approved drawings and IS codes.

Inspected incoming materials, approved concrete mix designs and verified survey and layout of foundations.

Ensured testing of works and materials as per the approved Field Quality Plan and relevant IS codes.

Maintained accurate records of quality activities, inspections and test results, and prepared monthly quality reports for submission to the client along with bills.

Interacted with client BRBCL (NTPC) and the contractor to close non-conformance reports and submit quality documents for billing.

Asha Realty Developers Pvt. Ltd. | Jan 2018 – May 2021

Designation: Civil Site Engineer

Project: Construction of Centrum Mall, Sahu Road, Muzaffarpur & Dr. R.P Estate Mega-Township, Muzaffarpur

Supervised civil construction of pile foundations, raft and superstructure for a commercial mall and a mega-township development.

Oversaw civil works for the township’s internal electrical substation / DG room and equipment foundations, coordinating inserts and cable-trench requirements.

Executed quality assurance for all civil works to ensure compliance with project specifications, relevant IS codes and approved drawings.

Inspected incoming materials, verified survey layout and supervised pile boring and foundation works.

Prepared bar-bending schedules, daily progress reports (DPR), contractor bills and other project documentation.

Ensured proper management of materials and workmanship at site.

Agrani Homes Pvt. Ltd. | Jun 2016 – Dec 2017

Designation: Site Engineer

Project: Construction of Commercial & Residential Buildings

Supervised civil construction of raft foundations and superstructure for commercial and residential buildings.

Verified survey layout, reinforcement and shuttering prior to concreting, and monitored concrete pouring and curing.

Executed quality assurance for civil works to ensure compliance with specifications, IS codes and approved drawings.

Prepared bar-bending schedules, daily progress reports (DPR) and contractor bills.

Ensured proper management of materials, manpower and workmanship at site.

Coordinated with senior engineers and contractors for smooth execution of daily activities.

SOFTWARE SKILLS

MS Office — MS Word, MS Excel, MS PowerPoint.

AutoCAD (Basics).

PERSONAL ATTRIBUTES

Honest and hardworking.

Effective communication skills.

Leadership qualities and adaptable to any working environment.

Co-operative and team-oriented attitude.

PERSONAL DETAILS

Name: Md Farhan

Father’s Name: Md Firoz

Date of Birth: 1st February 1994

Marital Status: Single

Gender: Male

Nationality: Indian

Languages Known: Hindi, English & Urdu

Passport: Valid Indian Passport (available on request)

I hereby declare that all the information and particulars given above are true and correct to the best of my knowledge and belief.

candidates.rawText:
PANKAJ DHAR DWIVEDI 
Senior Civil Engineer | Water & Sewerage Infrastructure Specialist 
Bhopal, Madhya Pradesh, India | Phone: +91-8770708179 | Email: 
dwivedipankaj109@gmail.com 
 
PROFESSIONAL SUMMARY 
A visionary and high-performing Senior Civil Engineering Professional with 12 years of 
distinguished expertise in steering mega-scale water, sewerage, and urban infrastructure 
projects valued at over ₹1,500+ Crores. Highly skilled in resident engineering, contract 
administration, and end-to-end project execution for Multi-Village Group Water Supply 
Schemes, Urban Water Networks, Integrated Sewerage Systems, and Turnkey Housing. 
Possesses elite technical command over high-capacity Intake Wells, Mega Water 
Treatment Plants (WTP), Sewage Treatment Plants (STP), cross-country Pumping Mains 
(RWPM/CWPM), and massive gravity-flow networks. 
Recognized for institutionalizing zero-tolerance QA/QC protocols, driving significant cost 
rationalization through precision material optimization (BBS), and executing rigorous 
technical/financial audits (R.A. Bills/MB). A strategic leader adept at managing multi-tier 
EPC contractors, resolving critical geological/logistical bottlenecks, and driving seamless 
stakeholder liaisoning with apex Government bodies (MPJNM, MPUADD, BMC, Jal Jeevan 
Mission) and project management consultants (PMCs) to deliver milestones ahead of 
schedule. 
 
CORE COMPETENCIES 
 Project Management: End-to-end execution of mega water supply and integrated 
sewerage projects under EPC/Turnkey modes, deep trench shoring, heavy foundations, 
pumping stations, and complex river/railway crossings. 
 Quality Assurance & Control: Implementation of Field Quality Plans (FQP/QAP), concrete 
mix designs, inward material inspection, BOQ compliance, pour cards, and RFI 
management. 
 Financial & Contract Audits: Scrutiny and certification of contractor R.A. bills, joint 
measurement recording in official Measurement Books (MB), and material reconciliation via 
Bar Bending Schedules (BBS). 
 Contract Administration: Interpretation of contractual clauses in compliance with FIDIC 
Conditions, General Conditions of Contract (GCC), and Extra Item Claims management. 

TECHNICAL SKILLS & TOOLS 
 Engineering, Planning & Estimation Software: AutoCAD, MS Project (MSP), Advanced 
MS Excel for Complex Quantity Surveying & Quantity Estimation, basic exposure to 
Primavera P6 and GIS mapping. 
 Infrastructure Domain Expertise: Trenchless Technology (HDD / Micro-Tunneling / Box 
Pushing Method), SCADA & Industrial Automation Integration, Hydraulic Surge Analysis, 
Air & Hydrostatic Pressure Testing, Pipeline Appurtenances (Kinetic Air, Scour, and 
Pressure Relief Valves). 
 Advanced Civil Engineering Skills: Advanced Foundations (Under-water Rafts & Piles), 
Cofferdam Engineering, Dewatering Mechanics, Reinforced Cement Concrete (RCC) Water 
Retaining Structural Designs, Structural Forensic Engineering (Anomalies Detection), 
Concrete Mix Technology, and Mass Concrete Pouring. 
 EHS, Risk & Compliance Frameworks: Zero-Harm Safety Policies, Hazard Identification 
& Risk Assessment (HIRA), Incident Reporting, and Statutory Labor Law/Environmental 
Compliance Management. 
 
PROFESSIONAL EXPERIENCE 
RESIDENT ENGINEER | Nov 2024 – Mar 2026 
Intratech Civil Solutions & Consultant | Project Cost: ₹322.98 Cr. 
 Project: Meda Multi-Village Scheme, District Betul & Chhindwara, Madhya Pradesh. 
 Client / Funding: MPJNM PIU Chhindwara | Jal Jeevan Mission (Central & State 
Government). 
 Infrastructure Scope: 33.67 MLD RCC Intake Well, 28.00 MLD WTP, 5.925 Km RWPM 
(1300 mm Dia), 89.650 Km CWPM, 605.950 Km CWGM Grid, 620 Km Distribution 
Network, 6 MBRs, 77 OHSRs, and 10,034 Household Connections (HSCs). 
 Key Responsibilities & Deliverables: 
o Strategic Site Steering: Governed cross-functional engineering teams, site supervisors, 
and laboratory technicians to execute high-capacity Intake Wells and WTP blocks strictly 
adhering to structural tolerance levels. 
o Design Integrity & Forensic Audit: Critically analyzed multi-disciplinary structural designs, 
preempted structural deflection and alignment anomalies, and formulated practical design 
rectifications for Technical Leads. 
o Contractual Risk & RFI Management: Moderated the Request for Information (RFI) matrix 
to expedite decisions, resolved technical contradictions between BOQ and drawings, and 
closed site queries to maintain velocity. 
o Advanced Quality Assurance: Instituted a zero-tolerance Field Quality Plan (FQP); 
evaluated raw structural material compliance, certified concrete trial mixes, and 
institutionalized systematic non-destructive and destructive testing (daily cube tests). 

o Hydro-Testing & Asset Commissioning: Supervised hydrostatic field pressure testing at 
high operating bars for large-diameter pumping mains; managed structural dewatering, 
pipeline flushing, and successful commissioning under strict timelines. 
o Executive Stakeholder Reporting: Authored comprehensive Monthly Progress Reports 
(MPR) and Earned Value Analysis dashboards for high-level technical evaluation by 
Government and PMC officials. 
 
ASSISTANT ENGINEER | Jan 2023 – Sep 2024 
Ln Malviya Infra Projects Pvt. Ltd. | Project Cost: ₹1,025 Cr. 
 Project: Gandhi Sagar-1 Multi-Village Scheme, District Mandsaur & Ratlam, Madhya 
Pradesh. 
 Client: MPJNM PIU Mandsaur | Central & State Government Partnership. 
 Infrastructure Scope: 143.75 MLD Intake Well (172.50 MLD Peak), 115.00 MLD Mega 
WTP, 18.300 Km RWPM (1300 mm Dia), 39.600 Km CWPM, 1,709.900 Km CWGM Grid, 
2,703.700 Km Pipeline Network, 6 MBRs, 276 OHSRs, and 154,364 Household 
Connections (HSCs). 
 Key Responsibilities & Deliverables: 
o Critical Path Optimization: Directed a network of field engineers using Critical Path 
Method (CPM) analytics, adjusting labor and machinery deployment dynamically to arrest 
schedule slippages. 
o Financial Auditing & Valuations: Audited and processed multi-crore contractor Running 
Account (R.A.) bills, enforced exact quantity surveys, reconciled material balances, and 
certified monthly interim payment certificates. 
o Statutory Measurement Logs: Spearheaded physical measurement mapping campaigns 
with Departmental Officers, ensuring bulletproof, dispute-free log entry into official legal 
Measurement Books (MB). 
o Structural Supervision & Handover: Checked high-accuracy layouts, evaluated 
shuttering stability and reinforcement distribution schedules, and formally validated "As-
Built" drawings for final asset handover. 
o Heavy Construction Safety (HSE): Supervised heavy marine lifting, deep crane 
maneuvers, and technical staging at the river-based intake well, enforcing strict zero-
accident HSE standards. 
 
FIELD ENGINEER (Water Supply & Sewerage Specialist) | Apr 2017 – Sep 2022 
WAPCOS Limited (A Government of India Undertaking) 
 Projects Supervised: Extended Area Water Supply Scheme (₹284 Cr.), Bhopal Capital 
City Integrated Sewerage Scheme (₹350+ Cr.), Storm Water Drainage Scheme (₹139.8 
Cr.), and Bagh Multi-Village Water Supply Scheme (₹55.26 Cr.). 
 Client / Location: MPUADD, Bhopal Municipal Corporation (BMC) & MPJNM | Bhopal & 
Dhar, Madhya Pradesh. 
 

 Key Responsibilities & Deliverables: 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
oCross-Country Grid Infrastructure: Managed pipeline alignment, deep corridor trenching, 
structural bedding, and jointing compliance (MS automatic welding, DI Tyton push-fit) for 
cross-country distribution grids.
oMarine & Underwater Civil Engineering: Commanded structural execution of the 50 MLD 
Intake Well inside deep water bodies, controlling complex sheet-pile cofferdam sealing and 
underwater tremie concrete pouring.
oDeep Trench Geotechnical Execution: Executed deep-trench excavations (down to 6 
meters) under challenging urban topographies; designed heavy timber/steel trench shoring 
networks and maintained micro-gradients via automatic laser levels for gravity flows.
oTrenchless Highway & 
Rail Crossings: Supervised Horizontal Directional Drilling (HDD) 
and Box Pushing operations under high-traffic National Highways and active Central 
Railway corridors with zero structural settlement.
oSpecialized STP/WTP Structural Civil Works: Controlled reinforcement integrity, 
formwork stripping times, and water-tight concrete pouring for complex SBR Basins, Wet 
Wells, Screen Channels, Clariflocculators, and Rapid Sand Gravity Filters.
oSurge Control & 
SCADA Readiness: Checked installation of smart surge-protection 
appurtenances (Air/Kinetic relief valves) to counteract water-hammer effects, and drove 
infrastructure mapping for SCADA automation integration.
SITE ENGINEER | Oct 2014 – Mar 2017
M.V Omni Projects (India) Limited
oProject: Housing for All under Pradhan Mantri Awas Yojna (PMAY) – 12 Slum Cluster 
Sites, Bhopal.
oInfrastructure Scope: Turnkey civil supervision of 32 Multi-Storey Residential Blocks 
(MIG, LIG, and EWS categories).
oKey Responsibilities & Deliverables:
 
o Precision Material Optimization: Created automated, high-fidelity Bar Bending Schedules 
(BBS) for massive foundation rafts, shear walls, columns, and beams, dropping structural 
steel scrap rates significantly. 
o Inventory Financial Control: Calculated daily raw inventory requirements (cement, 
aggregates, steel) via look-ahead schedules, maintaining lean supply chains and saving 
unnecessary working capital costs. 
o Deployment Dynamics: Controlled daily structural line layouts, validated formwork 
alignment/plumb, and optimized daily labor and subcontractor assignment across multiple 
housing clusters. 
o Progress Tracking & Pour Cards: Maintained strict concrete pour card history, performed 
physical spot measurements, and compiled clear MIS reports for executive project reviews. 
 

EDUCATIONAL QUALIFICATIONS 
 
 
 
 
B.Tech in Civil Engineering | RGPV Bhopal, Madhya Pradesh (Graduated: 2014) | Score: 
68.8%
Higher Secondary (12th) | M.P. Board (Completed: 2010) | Score: 70.0%
High School (10th) | M.P. Board (Completed: 2008) | Score: 76.0% 
 
PERSONAL DOSSIER 
 
 
 
 
 
Languages Known: English (Excellent), Hindi (Excellent)
Total Career Experience: 12 Years | Core Water & Sewerage Experience: 8.5+ Years
Key Associated Clients: MPJNM (MP Jal Nigam), MPUADD, BMC (Bhopal Municipal 
Corporation), and AMRUT Mission Initiatives
Date of Birth: 10.07.1993 | Nationality: Indian

CURRICULUM VITAE (CV) FOR PROPOSED PROFESSIONAL STAFF

1. Proposed Position

Senior Civil Engineer / Resident Engineer — Trenchless (HDD) Pipeline Crossings & Water Supply and Sewerage Infrastructure

2. Name of Firm

Tranzenergy Global LLC

3. Name of Staff

Pankaj 

4. Date of Birth

10 July 1993

5. Nationality

Indian

6. Place of Domicile

Bhopal, Madhya Pradesh, India

7. Education

B.Tech (Civil Engineering) — Rajiv Gandhi Proudyogiki Vishwavidyalaya (RGPV), Bhopal, Madhya Pradesh, India, 2014. Aggregate 68.8%.

Higher Secondary (12th Standard) — Board of Secondary Education, Madhya Pradesh, 2010. Aggregate 70.0%.

High School (10th Standard) — Board of Secondary Education, Madhya Pradesh, 2008. Aggregate 76.0%.

8. Membership of Professional Associations

[To be confirmed by the candidate — e.g. Institution of Engineers (India), Indian Water Works Association.]

9. Other Training / Technical Proficiency

Trenchless technology methods: Horizontal Directional Drilling (HDD), micro-tunnelling and box pushing for highway, railway and watercourse crossings.

Hydraulic surge analysis; air and hydrostatic pressure testing of large-diameter pumping mains; pipeline appurtenance selection (kinetic air valves, scour valves, pressure relief valves).

Advanced foundations — underwater rafts and piles, sheet-pile cofferdam engineering, dewatering mechanics, tremie and mass concrete pouring, RCC water-retaining structural design.

Quality systems — Field Quality Plans (FQP/QAP), concrete mix design and trial mixes, destructive and non-destructive testing, RFI and pour-card control.

EHS frameworks — Hazard Identification and Risk Assessment (HIRA), incident reporting, statutory labour and environmental compliance.

Software — AutoCAD, MS Project, advanced MS Excel for quantity surveying and estimation; working exposure to Primavera P6 and GIS mapping.

10. Countries of Work Experience

India (Madhya Pradesh — Bhopal, Betul, Chhindwara, Mandsaur, Ratlam, Dhar).

11. Languages

Language

Speaking

Reading

Writing

English

Excellent

Excellent

Excellent

Hindi

Excellent

Excellent

Excellent

12. Employment Record

Total professional experience: 12 years (2014 to date). Core water supply and sewerage experience: 8.5+ years, including trenchless (HDD / box pushing) crossings of national highways, active railway corridors and watercourses on cross-country transmission mains and gravity sewer networks.

12.1 November 2024 – March 2026

Employer

Intratech Civil Solutions & Consultant

Position Held

Resident Engineer

Project

Meda Multi-Village Water Supply Scheme, Districts Betul and Chhindwara, Madhya Pradesh, India

Client / Funding

MPJNM PIU Chhindwara — Jal Jeevan Mission (Government of India / Government of Madhya Pradesh)

Project Cost

INR 322.98 Crore

Main Features

33.67 MLD RCC intake well; 28.00 MLD water treatment plant; 5.925 km raw water pumping main (1300 mm dia); 89.650 km clear water pumping main; 605.950 km clear water gravity main grid; 620 km distribution network; 6 MBRs; 77 OHSRs; 10,034 household service connections.

Detailed Tasks Assigned:

Trenchless crossings (HDD / box pushing) across the cross-country transmission alignment — supervised entry/exit pit preparation, bore alignment and settlement monitoring where the RWPM, CWPM and gravity grid intersected state highways, canals, watercourses and railway land, and enforced restoration of crossed assets to authority standards.

Directed cross-functional engineering, supervisory and laboratory teams for execution of the 33.67 MLD intake well and 28.00 MLD WTP blocks within specified structural tolerances; reviewed multi-disciplinary structural designs, pre-empted deflection and alignment anomalies, and issued practical rectification proposals to the design leads.

Administered the Request for Information (RFI) matrix, resolved technical contradictions between BOQ and issued-for-construction drawings, and closed site queries to protect the construction programme.

Instituted a zero-tolerance Field Quality Plan — inward material inspection, certification of concrete trial mixes, and systematic destructive and non-destructive testing including daily cube testing.

Supervised hydrostatic field pressure testing of large-diameter pumping mains at design operating pressures, together with structural dewatering, pipeline flushing, disinfection and commissioning; authored Monthly Progress Reports and earned-value dashboards for Government and PMC review.

12.2 January 2023 – September 2024

Employer

Ln Malviya Infra Projects Pvt. Ltd.

Position Held

Assistant Engineer

Project

Gandhi Sagar-1 Multi-Village Water Supply Scheme, Districts Mandsaur and Ratlam, Madhya Pradesh, India

Client / Funding

MPJNM PIU Mandsaur — Central and State Government partnership

Project Cost

INR 1,025 Crore

Main Features

143.75 MLD intake well (172.50 MLD peak); 115.00 MLD water treatment plant; 18.300 km raw water pumping main (1300 mm dia); 39.600 km clear water pumping main; 1,709.900 km clear water gravity main grid; 2,703.700 km total pipeline network; 6 MBRs; 276 OHSRs; 154,364 household service connections.

Detailed Tasks Assigned:

Supervised trenchless and special crossing works on the 18.300 km RWPM, 39.600 km CWPM and gravity grid — coordinated method statements, permissions and reinstatement for crossings of highways, canals and railway corridors, and monitored ground settlement and pipe alignment during and after installation.

Directed a network of field engineers using Critical Path Method analytics, dynamically re-deploying labour and plant to arrest schedule slippage across a multi-district alignment.

Audited and processed multi-crore contractor Running Account bills — enforced exact quantity surveys, reconciled material balances against Bar Bending Schedules, and certified monthly interim payment certificates.

Led joint physical measurement campaigns with departmental officers, ensuring dispute-free entries in the statutory Measurement Books.

Checked high-accuracy setting-out, evaluated shuttering stability and reinforcement distribution, validated as-built drawings for asset handover, and enforced zero-accident HSE standards during heavy marine lifting and staging at the river-based intake well.

12.3 April 2017 – September 2022

Employer

WAPCOS Limited (A Government of India Undertaking)

Position Held

Field Engineer (Water Supply & Sewerage)

Projects

Extended Area Water Supply Scheme (INR 284 Crore); Bhopal Capital City Integrated Sewerage Scheme (INR 350+ Crore); Storm Water Drainage Scheme (INR 139.8 Crore); Bagh Multi-Village Water Supply Scheme (INR 55.26 Crore)

Client / Location

MPUADD, Bhopal Municipal Corporation and MPJNM — Bhopal and Dhar, Madhya Pradesh, India

Main Features

Urban water transmission and distribution grids; integrated sewerage network with SBR-based treatment; storm water drainage; 50 MLD intake well constructed within a deep water body; trenchless crossings of National Highways and active Central Railway corridors.

Detailed Tasks Assigned:

Supervised Horizontal Directional Drilling (HDD) and box pushing operations under high-traffic National Highways and live Central Railway corridors — reviewed method statements and drilling profiles, supervised entry and exit pit construction, pilot bore, reaming and pull-back sequences, monitored drilling-fluid management and spoil disposal, and verified zero structural settlement of the crossed asset through the drilling and reinstatement cycle.

Managed cross-country grid installation — pipeline alignment and profile control, deep corridor trenching, structural bedding, and jointing compliance for MS automatic welding and DI Tyton push-fit systems.

Executed deep-trench geotechnical works to 6 m depth in congested urban topography, designing timber and steel trench shoring systems and holding micro-gradients for gravity sewers using automatic laser levels.

Commanded marine and underwater civil execution of the 50 MLD intake well inside a deep water body — sheet-pile cofferdam sealing, dewatering control and underwater tremie concrete pouring.

Controlled reinforcement integrity, formwork stripping and water-tight concrete for SBR basins, wet wells, screen channels, clariflocculators and rapid sand gravity filters; verified installation of surge-protection appurtenances (kinetic air and relief valves) against water-hammer, and drove infrastructure mapping for SCADA integration.

12.4 October 2014 – March 2017

Employer

M.V. Omni Projects (India) Limited

Position Held

Site Engineer

Project

Housing for All under Pradhan Mantri Awas Yojana (PMAY) — 12 slum cluster sites, Bhopal, Madhya Pradesh, India

Main Features

Turnkey civil supervision of 32 multi-storey residential blocks (MIG, LIG and EWS categories), including associated internal services and utility trenching.

Detailed Tasks Assigned:

Prepared high-fidelity Bar Bending Schedules for foundation rafts, shear walls, columns and beams, materially reducing structural steel scrap rates.

Calculated daily raw material requirements (cement, aggregate, steel) from look-ahead schedules, maintaining lean supply chains and controlling working capital.

Controlled daily structural setting-out, validated formwork alignment and plumb, and optimised labour and subcontractor deployment across multiple housing clusters.

Supervised excavation and laying of internal water supply, sewer and utility lines within the housing clusters, including trench shoring, bedding and reinstatement.

Maintained concrete pour-card history, performed physical spot measurements, and compiled MIS reports for executive project review.

13. Detailed Tasks Assigned on the Proposed Assignment

[To be completed against the Terms of Reference of the assignment — the tasks listed in the ToR for the proposed position are to be reproduced here.]

14. Work Undertaken That Best Illustrates Capability to Handle the Tasks Assigned

Name of Assignment

Bhopal Capital City Integrated Sewerage Scheme and Extended Area Water Supply Scheme — trenchless crossings of National Highway and Central Railway corridors

Year

2017 – 2022

Location

Bhopal, Madhya Pradesh, India

Client

MPUADD / Bhopal Municipal Corporation, through WAPCOS Limited

Main Project Features

Integrated sewerage network with SBR treatment facilities and an urban water transmission grid, requiring multiple crossings of live National Highway and Central Railway alignments where open-cut excavation was not permissible; deep gravity sewers to 6 m depth in dense urban fabric.

Position Held

Field Engineer (Water Supply & Sewerage)

Activities Performed

Directed the trenchless work package from method statement review to reinstatement — assessed subsurface conditions and drilling profiles against the design alignment, and coordinated crossing permissions with highway and railway authorities.

Supervised HDD execution: entry and exit pit construction, pilot bore, sequential reaming, product pipe stringing and pull-back, with continuous monitoring of drilling fluid, annular pressure and spoil handling.

Supervised box pushing operations beneath the active railway corridor, holding line and level within tolerance and monitoring the crossed asset for settlement throughout the drive and after commissioning.

Verified post-installation integrity through hydrostatic and air pressure testing of the crossing sections, and certified the crossings for handover with zero recorded structural settlement.

Integrated the crossing works into the wider gravity network by maintaining micro-gradients with automatic laser levels either side of each crossing, safeguarding hydraulic performance of the sewer grid.

15. Certification

I, the undersigned, certify that to the best of my knowledge and belief, this CV correctly describes myself, my qualifications, and my experience. I understand that any wilful misstatement described herein may lead to my disqualification or dismissal, if engaged.

Signature of staff member — Pankaj 

_________________________________________ Date: ______________

Signature of authorised representative of the firm

Full name of authorised representative: ______________________________________

Feedback Infra Pvt. Ltd.

Positions held and Description of Duties

Name of Project: Procurement of Consulting Services for Project Management Consultant (PMC) to support JUSNL in implementation of World Bank Funded Transmission Line & Sub-station Contracts in Zone-I (Ranchi) and Zone-II (Dumka) under Package-1, JPSIP scheme.

Location: Ranchi, Jharkhand

Client: JUSNL (Jharkhand Urja Sancharan Nigam Limited)

Major Features Of the project: World Bank funded transmission project comprising 12 Grid Substations of 2X50 MVA each and 1030 CKM of 132 kV Transmission Lines in Ranchi & Dumka Zone; personally handling approx. 550 CKM of lines, 6 substations and 2 bay extensions in Ranchi Zone.

Position Held: Assistant Manager (Project Execution)

Responsibilities:

Directed the complete field execution of 132 kV EHV transmission lines, covering route survey, profiling, tower foundation casting, tower erection and conductor stringing in line with approved drawings.

Monitored erection and commissioning activities at 132/33 kV AIS grid substations, verifying installation of power transformers, switchgear, isolators and protection relays before energisation.

Reviewed contractor construction methodology, checked joint measurements and certified running account bills against actual site progress and BOQ provisions.

Enforced Field Quality Plans, safety protocols and environmental safeguards across every stage of civil and electrical works to keep the project audit-compliant.

Liaised with Railways, National Highways, Forest and Telecom authorities to obtain crossing permissions and statutory clearances, preventing right-of-way delays.

Period

Employer

From Mar 2022 to Oct 2022

Tetra Tech (on contract with Ohm Encon Pvt. Ltd., Vadodara)

Positions held and Description of Duties

Name of Project: Procurement of Consulting Services for Project Management Consultant (PMC) to support JUSNL in implementation of World Bank Funded Transmission Line & Sub-station Contracts in Zone-III (Jamshedpur) and Zone-IV (Daltonganj) under Package-2.

Location: Jamshedpur, Jharkhand

Client: JUSNL (Jharkhand Urja Sancharan Nigam Limited)

Major Features Of the project: PMC assignment for 12 Grid Substations of 2X50 MVA each and 1214 CKM of 132 kV Transmission Lines in Jamshedpur & Daltonganj Zone; individually responsible for approx. 650 CKM of lines, 6 substations and 2 bay extensions in Jamshedpur Zone.

Position Held: Technical Assistant to Project Director

Responsibilities:

Supervised on-site construction of 132 kV EHV transmission lines from survey and foundation work through to tower assembly and stringing, ensuring conformance with technical specifications.

Oversaw installation and pre-commissioning checks of transformers, switchgear and protection systems at 132/33 kV air-insulated substations.

Coordinated procurement schedules, vendor deliveries and site logistics so that critical line and substation materials were available on time.

Carried out technical troubleshooting of civil and electrical issues arising in the field to keep construction milestones on track.

Followed up with Railways, Highways, Forest and Telecom departments for line-crossing approvals and monitored contractor adherence to quality and safety standards.

Period

Employer

From Feb 2021 to Mar 2022

Fabritech Construction and Services Pvt. Ltd.

Positions held and Description of Duties

Name of Project: Industrial electrification works at Mahindra Vehicles Manufacturing Limited (Paint Shop) with Sterling & Wilson, and at John Deere Technology Center (Fire Alarm System) with Schneider Electric.(132KV/33KV internal) 

Location: Pune, Maharashtra

Client: MVML & John Deere

Major Features Of the project: Execution and management of industrial and commercial electrification, including 132 KV substation including, transformers, panels, cabling and and others.

Position Held: Project In-charge

Responsibilities:

Planned and executed 132 KV/33KV substation control cabling works, including laying, glanding and termination of cables across varied sizes and cores.

Managed installation of 11 kV/0.44 kV and 22 kV/0.44 kV dry-type distribution transformers together with bus ducts, breakers and associated earthing and neutral works.

Supervised erection of cable trays, earthing networks and support structures fabricated to suit prevailing site conditions.

Commissioned UPS systems, HT & LT panels and lighting installations, verifying connections and functional readiness before handover.

Enforced site safety discipline and quality checks throughout electrical execution while coordinating with client and vendor teams for smooth progress.

Period

Employer

From Nov 2019 to Feb 2021

KPM Infra Pvt. Ltd.

Positions held and Description of Duties

Name of Project: Construction of substation bays, GIS substation and distribution lines for DVC and JBVNL in Jharkhand and West Bengal.

Location: Jharkhand

Client: DVC & JBVNL

Major Features Of the project: Bay construction at 220/132/33 kV substations and powerhouse switchyards under DVC; construction of 33/11 kV GIS substation (2X10 MVA) under JSBAY scheme; overhead and underground 33 kV & 11 kV cabling for Dhanbad town.

Position Held: Project Engineer

Responsibilities:

Executed construction of bays at 220/132/33 kV substations and powerhouse switchyards, including structure erection and equipment placement.

Handled installation and commissioning of a 33/11 kV GIS substation of 2X10 MVA capacity, supervising switchgear assembly and transformer positioning.

Laid overhead and underground 33 kV and 11 kV distribution lines, ensuring correct routing, jointing and terminations.

Checked erection quality, earthing and clearances against approved drawings and applicable standards before energisation.

Coordinated with utility clients and contractors on material reconciliation, site progress and compliance with safety requirements.

Period

Employer

From July 2015 to Nov 2019

Raj Shyama Constructions Pvt. Ltd.

Positions held and Description of Duties

Name of Project: Construction, retrofitting and commissioning of substations and transmission lines across Uttarakhand under PSDF, IPDS, DDUGJY and Char Dham road schemes.

Location: Uttarakhand

Client: PTCUL & UPCL

Major Features Of the project: Bay construction and retrofitting at 400/220/132/33 kV substations; LILO works on 132 kV and 220 kV lines; 220 kV D/C Twin Zebra line (12.3 CKT KM); 33/11 kV GIS substation under IPDS; feeder separation under DDUGJY.

Position Held: Project Engineer

Responsibilities:

Constructed and retrofitted bays at 400/220/132/33 kV substations at multiple Uttarakhand sites, integrating new equipment into live switchyards.

Executed LILO and D/C transmission line works, including 220 kV Twin Zebra stringing, from survey through erection to final commissioning.

Performed testing and commissioning of 132 kV and 33 kV SF6 gas circuit breakers and associated switchyard equipment.

Built a 33/11 kV GIS substation under the IPDS scheme and carried out agricultural/non-agricultural feeder separation under DDUGJY.

Ensured all works met drawings, technical specifications, quality benchmarks and safety norms while coordinating with utility clients and authorities.
