candidates.rawText:
KEY PERSONNEL CV

Sushant Nigam

Proposed Role: Design Engineer – Electrical (EHV Substations & BESS)

Nationality

Indian

Qualification

B.Tech – Electrical Engineering, Babu Banarasi Das Institute of Technology & Management (2020–2024)

Total experience

4+ years (plus academic internship at RDSO, Ministry of Railways)

Relevant experience

~2 years, wholly on EHV/AIS substation and BESS detailed engineering – the closest direct match on the team to this assignment’s scope

Software

AutoCAD, DIALux, MS Excel, MS Office, Adobe Acrobat

Standards exposure

CEA, IEC, IS, APTRANSCO specifications; IS 3043 & IEEE 80 (earthing)

RELEVANT TO THIS ASSIGNMENT

Direct, current experience on 400 kV, 220 kV and 33 kV AIS substation and switchyard detailed engineering – plan & section layouts, EKDs, protection SLDs, cable trench layouts.

Engineering-side experience on the same three NTPC BESS projects referenced in this offer’s track record – Bongaigaon (75/150 MW), Khargone (160 MW/320 MWh) and Gadarwara (125 MW/250 MWh) – covering GPL, AC/DC SLDs, cable and conductor sizing, earthing and illumination.

Hands-on with the same activity set proposed in Section 5 of the offer: EKD, earthing (IS 3043/IEEE 80), DIALux illumination, cable trench and sizing, battery/charger and CT-PT sizing.

EMPLOYMENT RECORD

Apr 2026 – Present | TranzEnergy Global LLP

Role: Electrical Design Engineer

Detailed engineering and design of EHV substations (33/220/400 kV).

Preparation of SLDs, plan & section layouts, EKDs and cable trench layouts.

Cable sizing, conductor sizing, battery & charger sizing, DG and HVAC calculations.

Earthing layout design and earth-mat calculations per IS 3043 and IEEE 80.

Coordination with clients, consultants and vendors for document approvals.

Sep 2024 – Apr 2026 | Srex Power India Pvt. Ltd., Noida

Project: 75/150 MW BESS, Bongaigaon (NTPC); 160 MW/320 MWh BESS, Khargone; 125 MW/250 MWh BESS, Gadarwara; 400/33 kV PSS, Kurnool (APTRANSCO); 220 kV Pooling SS, Bhadla-2; 33/220 kV AIS Pooling SS, SECI-III & SECI-V, Fatehgarh; 220/33 kV AIS SS, Jamnagar (NTPC-REL)

Role: Electrical Design Engineer

General Plan Layouts and AC/DC SLDs for BESS containers, PCS and step-up transformer arrangement.

Conductor, cable and AC distribution sizing; battery, DG and UPS capacity calculations.

Earthing system design and earth-mat calculations; illumination layouts in DIALux.

Cable trench, equipment foundation and MCR panel layouts; CT/PT sizing for protection and metering.

HVAC load calculations and fire alarm/firefighting system layout per NFPA/IS.

INTERNSHIP

Research Designs & Standards Organization (RDSO), Ministry of Railways – Jul–Aug 2023: assisted with traction installation, OHE design and power-supply commissioning for railway projects.

KEY PERSONNEL CV

Nitin Singhal

Proposed Role: Senior Design Engineer – BESS Interfaces, Auxiliary Systems & DC/UPS Sizing

Nationality

Indian

Qualification

B.Tech – Electrical Engineering (Power Systems), Dr. B.R. Ambedkar NIT, Jalandhar (2014–2018); Diploma in Project Management, IIBMS Mumbai (2018–2019)

Total experience

~8 years, across BESS/BMS/EMS solutioning, grid automation and substation-linked control/power-distribution design

Certification

Project Management Professional (PMI-PMP), valid to 10 Sep 2025

Software

AutoCAD, MATLAB Simulink, EMTP, SAP, MS Project, MS Office suite

RELEVANT TO THIS ASSIGNMENT

Strongest fit on the team for auxiliary-system sizing (DC system, battery/charger, UPS) and BESS/control-system interfaces – directly relevant to the auxiliary transformer, DC system and UPS sizing under item (c) of the SoW.

Direct experience on a PGCIL BESS and on grid-automation packages (SCADA/AGC/DRPC, CRP/SAS) for NTPC and KPTCL while at KEC International – utility-grade projects with EHV interfaces, though not EHV switchyard physical-layout design itself.

PMP-certified; proposed to support project planning, scheduling and reporting alongside the design role, and as a second point of technical coordination with the Client.

Profile is weighted toward BMS/EMS, battery technology and power-quality solutioning rather than AIS switchyard civil/electrical layout (EKD, DSLP, cable-trench design); on this assignment he is proposed against the auxiliary-system and BESS-interface activities rather than the yard-layout activities (a), (d), (e) and (f).

EMPLOYMENT RECORD

Oct 2024 – Present | Exicom Tele-Systems Ltd

Role: Solution Lead – BESS (R&D)

Design and solutioning of Battery Energy Storage Systems.

Development of Product Requirements Documents with specifications and compliance requirements.

Bill of materials for performance and cost improvement.

Project management and integration support.

Battery cube and container development; defect analysis.

Apr 2023 – May 2024 | Mercedes Benz R&D India Pvt Ltd

Role: Sr. System Engineer – BMS (R&D)

Design and solutioning of Battery Management Systems.

PRD development with features, specifications and compliance requirements.

BOM production for performance and cost improvement.

Project management and integration support.

Error handling and defect analysis.

Mar 2022 – Apr 2023 | VFlowTech India Private Limited

Project: Battery Energy Storage System – SUNSEAP (EPC: VFlowTech Pte. Ltd., Singapore)

Role: Sr. Power System Engineer (R&D) / Project Electrical Design Engineer

Design and solutioning of BESS and auxiliary control system power-distribution architecture.

PRD development, BOM production, battery sizing and selection.

Solutioning for off-grid and on-grid projects.

BMS algorithm and project execution support.

Project management and integration support.

Apr 2021 – Nov 2021 | NEWEN Systems Pvt. Ltd., Vadodara

Project: BESS for CEL (EPC: Raychem RPG); BESS for HYGENCO (Solution Architect)

Role: Solution Architect – BESS & Power Quality (R&D)

Utility-scale stand-alone and PV-coupled BESS sizing, layouts and SLDs from origination.

Scope of works, component selection and vendor bid evaluation.

Testing and commissioning of BESS, ensuring integration of EMS with other equipment.

EMS algorithm writing for BESS applications.

Project management and execution support.

Jul 2018 – Apr 2021 | KEC International Limited

Project: AGC & DRPC – NTPC; BESS – PGCIL; 220/66 kV GIS Substations – KPTCL

Role: Associate – Solutions / Project Engineer

Design and solutioning of grid-automation solutions (CRP/SAS, SCADA, AGC).

Control/data-centre power-distribution architecture: sizing, load segregation, UPS and DG backup calculation.

Battery sizing and selection.

Solution design and vendor selection; component integration with master EMS controller.

Project management and integration support; led a 2-engineer execution team.

KEY PERSONNEL CV

Ramarajan R

Proposed Role: Lead Electrical Engineer – Substation Design (EKD, Primary Equipment & Design Calculations)

Nationality

Indian

Date of birth

3 November 1986

Qualification

M.E. (Applied Electronics), Arunai Engineering College, Anna University, Tiruvannamalai (2013); B.E. (Electronics & Communication Engineering), SKP Engineering College, Anna University (2010); Diploma in Information Technology, Kumaran Polytechnic College (2006)

Total experience

~12.5 years (since Jan 2014), wholly in substation and transmission-line design and detail engineering, with EPC contractors and design consultancies

Voltage levels covered

AIS substations and tenders up to 345 kV; GIS substation tenders up to 115 kV; EHV overhead lines designed up to 230 kV and tendered up to 400 kV; distribution lines at 11/33 kV; BESS with evacuation substations up to 600 MWh

Countries of work experience

India, Indonesia; design and tender engineering also delivered for United States projects 

Languages

English (excellent); 

Software

AutoCAD (2007, 2010, 2016), BricsCAD Pro 2014, Calculux, CG Lux, DIALux, MS Office

RELEVANT TO THIS ASSIGNMENT

Closest match on the team to the switchyard’s core scope – 12.5 years producing exactly the item (a)–(e) deliverables of the SoW: key/protection SLDs, substation layout plan and section, clearance diagrams, EKD, earthing layout and earth-mat design, lightning protection layout and calculation, strung/rigid bus conductor sizing, short-circuit force calculation and sag-tension analysis.

Direct AIS design experience up to 345 kV (Sankaraperi, Amba, Poovani) and bay-addition experience at operating grid substations (Kamachipuram, Tarkera) – the same bay-type and interface discipline as this one-and-a-half breaker switchyard.

Currently performs independent QA/QC checking of substation and BESS layouts, bills of material, equipment ratings, earth-mat design and conductor/cable fault-current withstand against IEC/BIS/IS at Linxon – directly applicable to the checking discipline this assignment requires up to Code-A.

BESS evacuation-substation experience up to 600 MWh (Nightpeak, ENI, Aypa, Southern California Edison, Greenport, ERCOT) adds cross-relevant exposure to battery-linked substation bay design, alongside the team’s existing NTPC BESS track record.

EMPLOYMENT RECORD

Jul 2021 – Present | 

Role: Substation Project Engineer 

Proposal, tender and base engineering for AIS and GIS substations and for BESS and their evacuation substations.

Preparation of RFQ packages, technical specifications, single line diagrams, layout drawings and master material lists.

Quality assurance checking of BESS and substation layouts and bills of material against IEC, BIS and IS standards.

Checking of equipment ratings, earth-mat design, and conductor/cable fault-current withstand.

Projects: 300 MW Cholla AIS substation and New Gardenville/Willow GIS substations (USA); BESS evacuation substations from 10 MW/20 MWh to 300 MW/600 MWh for Nightpeak, ENI, Aypa, Southern California Edison and Available Power.

Jan 2014 – Jul 2021 | KNR Engineers (India) Private Ltd

Role: Substation and Transmission Line Design Engineer (India, Indonesia)

Substation deliverables: key and protection/metering SLDs; layout plan, section and clearance diagrams; lightning-protection and earthing layouts; cable trench, foundation and control-room layouts; erection key diagrams; ACDB/DCDB SLDs.

Design calculations: strung and rigid bus conductor sizing; earth-mat design; illumination, lightning-protection, sag-tension and short-circuit force calculations; cable sizing and bills of quantities.

Transmission line deliverables: feasibility-stage paper survey and route comparison; routing layout; sag-tension calculation and sag template; tower/pole spotting profile; electrical BOQ.

Projects up to 400 kV (tender) and 345 kV (AIS design) including Sankaraperi, Amba and Poovani substations, and bay additions at operating substations (Kamachipuram, Tarkera).

Transmission lines from 400 kV double circuit (MRPL/PTC) down to 33 kV (NTPC/ABB, Odisha Mega Lift Irrigation Project).
